title: S-PLM-TM enables fast and accurate sequence-based search for remote homologs
zh_title: S-PLM-TM：基于序列的远程同源蛋白快速检索
summary: 预印本提出基于结构感知蛋白语言模型的纯序列远程同源检索工具，在远程同源检测与结构分类上优于所测序列方法。
key_points: 用跨模态流匹配与对比学习将结构信息注入序列表示
序列即可输出结构比对，无需检索时使用结构
在远程同源检测与功能一致邻居检索上表现优于所测基线
reason: 方法有新意且有基线对比，但为预印本、证据有限，属值得一看
abstract: Protein structures and functions can remain conserved after extensive sequence divergence, but detecting these distant relationships across large databases remains challenging. Here we present S-PLM-TM, a sequence-only remote homology search tool based on a structure-aware protein language model. Cross-modal flow matching and contrastive learning incorporate structural information into sequence representations. A lightweight calibration head enables structural-similarity search with the frozen encoder, while a residue-level alignment head generates structural alignments directly from sequence. S-PLM-TM outperforms the tested sequence-based methods in remote homology detection, rivals structure-based methods in structural classification and retrieves the most functionally consistent neighbors. It also retrieves distantly related enzymes with shared catalytic functions at a level comparable to the best-performing structure-based methods. In large-scale database search, S-PLM-TM achieves the highest average precision among both sequence-based and alignment-free methods, with speed approaching the fastest sequence-alignment tools. Together, these results establish S-PLM-TM as a practical tool that combines sensitive and biologically informative remote homology search with the speed required for database-scale retrieval.
zh_abstract: 在广泛的序列分化之后，蛋白质结构和功能仍可保持保守，但在大型数据库中检测这些远缘关系仍然具有挑战性。在此我们提出 S-PLM-TM，这是一种仅基于序列的远程同源搜索工具，建立在结构感知的蛋白质语言模型之上。跨模态流匹配和对比学习将结构信息纳入序列表示。轻量级校准头（calibration head）使冻结编码器能够进行结构相似性搜索，而残基级比对头（alignment head）可直接从序列生成结构比对。S-PLM-TM 在远程同源检测中优于所测试的基于序列的方法，在结构分类中可与基于结构的方法相媲美，并检索出功能最一致的邻居。它还能以与表现最佳的基于结构的方法相当的水平，检索出具有共同催化功能的远缘相关酶。在大规模数据库搜索中，S-PLM-TM 在基于序列和无比对方法中均取得最高平均精度，速度接近最快的序列比对工具。总之，这些结果确立了 S-PLM-TM 作为一种实用工具，将灵敏且具有生物学信息量的远程同源搜索与数据库规模检索所需的速度结合起来。

title: Impact of Pretraining Length, Model Size, and Annotation Budget on Downstream Clinical Tasks of Foundation Models in Radiotherapy
zh_title: 预训练时长、模型规模与标注预算对放疗基础模型下游任务的影响
summary: 在约15万例三维放疗CBCT上预训练视觉Transformer，分析预训练规模与微调策略同下游临床表现的关系。
key_points: 约15万例CBCT掩码图像建模预训练
下游任务含饲管存在分类与临床终点
追踪验证损失、有效秩与线性探针等指标
reason: 大规模预训练与多下游任务分析具新意，但为预印本且未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Cone-beam CT (CBCT) scans acquired during radiotherapy capture changes such as tumor shrinkage and radiation-induced tissue changes, offering great potential for foundation models that help monitor individual treatment responses. However, to our knowledge, no large-scale pretrained models for radiotherapy CBCT exist, and evaluating modeling choices is difficult since downstream tasks are not known in advance. We examine how pretraining length, model size, and finetuning strategy relate to downstream clinical performance, and how metrics tracked during pretraining correlate with it. We pretrain vision transformer encoders with masked image modeling on about 150,000 raw 3D radiotherapy CBCT scans, tracking representation quality via validation loss, effective rank, and linear probing. Downstream tasks are classification of feeding tube presence ($n=51,135$ CBCTs, $1,562$ patients) and clinical characteristics (T-, N-stage, sex, age, tumor site; $n=1,278$ patients) in head and neck cancer. We compare low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and full finetuning against no pretraining, varying annotated dataset size. Pretext validation loss was the most consistent predictor of downstream performance; effective rank and linear probing were also associated, but not consistently across model sizes and finetuning methods. LoRA performed comparably to full finetuning while training only 0.5-2.5% of the parameters. Fully finetuned models consistently outperformed models without pretraining across all sizes, with AUROC 0.91-0.97 vs. 0.58-0.85 for feeding tube classification and 0.99-1.00 vs. 0.71-0.97 for sex classification. Model size had only a small, inconsistent effect, suggesting smaller models suffice at lower computational cost. Code and pretrained models (non-commercial license): https://github.com/alexCortinaU/RT-CBCT_SSL
zh_abstract: 放疗期间采集的锥形束 CT（CBCT）扫描可捕捉肿瘤缩小和辐射诱导的组织改变等变化，为帮助监测个体治疗反应的基础模型提供了巨大潜力。然而，据我们所知，尚无用于放疗 CBCT 的大规模预训练模型，且由于下游任务并非预先已知，评估建模选择较为困难。我们考察了预训练时长、模型规模和微调策略与下游临床性能的关系，以及预训练期间跟踪的指标与其相关性。我们在约 150,000 例原始三维放疗 CBCT 扫描上，以掩码图像建模预训练视觉 Transformer 编码器，并通过验证损失、有效秩和线性探测跟踪表征质量。下游任务为头颈癌中喂养管存在的分类（$n=51,135$ 例 CBCT，$1,562$ 例患者）和临床特征分类（T 分期、N 分期、性别、年龄、肿瘤部位；$n=1,278$ 例患者）。我们比较了低秩适配（LoRA）和全参数微调与无预训练，并改变标注数据集规模。代理任务验证损失是下游性能最一致的预测指标；有效秩和线性探测也相关，但在不同模型规模和微调方法间并不一致。LoRA 仅训练 0.5-2.5% 的参数，表现与全参数微调相当。全参数微调模型在所有规模上均持续优于无预训练模型，喂养管分类的 AUROC 为 0.91-0.97 对 0.58-0.85，性别分类的 AUROC 为 0.99-1.00 对 0.71-0.97。模型规模仅产生较小且不一致的影响，提示在更低计算成本下较小模型即可足够。代码和预训练模型（非商业许可）：https://github.com/alexCortinaU/RT-CBCT_SSL

title: Sequence-based models predict TF binding with negligible contributions from motif cooperativity
zh_title: 序列模型预测转录因子结合：基序协同贡献可忽略
summary: 利用约2000个ENCODE转录因子结合谱训练的BPNet模型评估基序协同性，发现其对全基因组结合预测贡献极小。
key_points: 基于约2000个ENCODE TF结合谱训练BPNet模型
协同性在个别位点可见，但全基因组贡献可忽略
模型仍能区分基序偏好相似TF的结合差异
reason: 大规模ENCODE数据+模型系统评估，但属预印本方法学研究，证据有限
abstract: How transcription factors (TFs) selectively recognize their genomic targets among numerous sites containing similar DNA motifs remains an open question. Cooperative binding at neighboring motif sites is widely considered a key mechanism of TF specificity, yet its genome-wide contribution remains unclear. Machine learning models can now predict TF binding directly from DNA sequence, providing opportunities to investigate its underlying determinants. Here, we leveraged BPNet models trained on ~2,000 ENCODE TF binding profiles to systematically assess motif cooperativity. Although detected at individual loci, cooperativity made a negligible contribution to genome-wide binding predictions. Nevertheless, the models captured differences in binding preferences between TFs with similar motif preferences, even within the same cellular environment. These findings highlight the need to critically assess prevailing assumptions and explore alternative mechanisms underlying selective TF binding.
zh_abstract: 转录因子（TF）如何在众多含有相似 DNA 基序的位点中选择性识别其基因组靶点，仍是一个未解问题。邻近基序位点的协同结合被广泛认为是 TF 特异性的关键机制，但其在全基因组范围内的贡献仍不清楚。机器学习模型如今能够直接从 DNA 序列预测 TF 结合，为研究其潜在决定因素提供了机会。在此，我们利用在约 2,000 个 ENCODE TF 结合谱上训练的 BPNet 模型，系统评估基序协同性。尽管在单个位点可检测到协同性，但其对全基因组结合预测的贡献可忽略不计。尽管如此，这些模型捕捉到了具有相似基序偏好的 TF 之间结合偏好的差异，甚至在同一细胞环境中也是如此。这些发现凸显了批判性评估既有假设并探索选择性 TF 结合背后替代机制的必要性。

title: Where Does Hindsight Enter Clinical Agent Benchmarks? An Audit of Simulators and Case Construction
zh_title: 临床智能体基准中的后见信息泄漏审计
summary: HindAudit在MIMIC-IV 27,489例急诊入院中拆解三类后见信息通道，发现病例文本影响最大。
key_points: 区分模拟器诊断、回顾性上下文与病例文本三通道
给模拟器诊断对检验结果影响可忽略
基准式摘要显著抬高评分，提示泄漏
reason: 大规模回顾数据+方法学审计有新意，但为预印本且无外部验证
abstract: Benchmarks for LLM diagnostic agents are built from retrospective records: the case an agent reads is rewritten from discharge summaries, and unrecorded test results are generated by a simulator that often sees the final diagnosis. HindAudit separates three hindsight channels (the diagnosis given to the simulator, the retrospective context it conditions on, and the agent-facing case text) and measures each with judges trained only on real data. On 27,489 emergency admissions from MIMIC-IV, five registered tests found no leakage into simulated laboratory results: providing the diagnosis to five simulators had a negligible effect, and prompted gatekeepers diluted the diagnostic signal, although exploratory results suggest they can raise agent scores. The largest effect lay in the case text. Against a presentation-time reconstruction from triage records, benchmark-style summaries raised the zero-shot accuracy of four LLMs from 25.4% to 39.7% and discharge histories to 45.3%, and raised six interactive agents' scores while barely changing their ranking. The exploratory gap was reproduced in a registered replication on held-out patients. Masking diagnosis names left it unchanged. Because MIMIC lacks a contemporaneous bedside history, the gap is an upper bound on hindsight. We report all registered outcomes and recommend construction practices.
zh_abstract: 用于 LLM 诊断智能体的基准测试由回顾性记录构建：智能体阅读的病例是由出院小结改写的，未记录的检测结果由模拟器生成，而该模拟器常常能看到最终诊断。HindAudit 分离出三种事后信息（hindsight）通道（提供给模拟器的诊断、其作为条件的回顾性上下文，以及面向智能体的病例文本），并用仅在真实数据上训练的评判器分别测量每一通道。在来自 MIMIC-IV 的 27,489 例急诊入院中，五项注册测试未发现向模拟实验室结果的泄漏：向五个模拟器提供诊断的影响可忽略不计，而加入提示的守门器（gatekeepers）削弱了诊断信号，尽管探索性结果提示它们可以提高智能体得分。最大的效应位于病例文本。与基于分诊记录的表现时点重建相比，基准风格的摘要将四个 LLM 的零样本准确率从 25.4% 提高到 39.7%，将出院病史提高到 45.3%，并提高了六个交互式智能体的得分，而几乎未改变其排名。该探索性差距在留出患者上的注册重复实验中得到再现。遮蔽诊断名称未使其改变。由于 MIMIC 缺乏同期床旁病史，该差距是事后信息影响的上界。我们报告所有注册结局并推荐构建实践。

title: Casanovo-TMT: deep learning-based de novo sequencing of TMTpro-labeled peptides and phosphopeptides
zh_title: Casanovo-TMT：TMTpro标记肽段深度学习从头测序
summary: 扩展Casanovo词表并微调2100万谱图，实现TMTpro标记肽与磷酸肽的从头测序，在两个外部公开数据集上验证。
key_points: 在残基词表中加入TMTpro标记与磷酸化并微调
按实测前体质量重排beam候选提升准确率
测试集84.7%精确肽形式，两外部数据集87.4%/79.6%
reason: 方法清晰且有两个外部公开数据集验证，但为预印本、限于测序任务，属值得一看档
abstract: De novo peptide sequencing reads peptides directly from tandem mass spectra, but none of the released deep learning models can sequence peptides labeled with isobaric tags such as TMTpro, which are widely used for multiplexed quantitative proteomics. We extended the residue vocabulary of Casanovo with TMTpro tags and phosphorylation, fine-tuned it on 21 million spectra from our laboratory, most of them TMTpro-labeled, and re-ranked the candidates in the beam by their agreement with the measured precursor mass. The resulting model, Casanovo-TMT, predicted the exact peptidoform for 84.7% of the TMTpro-labeled spectra in our test set and for 87.4 and 79.6% of the spectra in two public global-proteome datasets from other laboratories, whereas the extended vocabulary without fine-tuning gave 0.3%. Discarding the lowest-scoring predictions raised precision to 95% while retaining 81.7% of the test spectra. Casanovo-TMT also predicted the exact peptidoform for 69.2% of the spectra in a public phosphopeptide-enriched dataset and for 66 to 72% of the phosphopeptide spectra in three phosphoproteomic studies from our laboratory that were not used for training. In these studies, it identified numbers of phosphopeptides comparable to or larger than those of database search engines, and proportionally more where database search identified fewer. For the phosphopeptides identified only by Casanovo-TMT, entrapment estimated that more than 90% were correct, and an independent search engine assigned the same sequence to 95 to 98% of the spectra that it identified with confidence. Casanovo-TMT can therefore extend database search in TMTpro-based quantitative proteomics, particularly in studies in which database search identifies few phosphopeptides.
zh_abstract: 从头肽段测序可直接从串联质谱图中读取肽段，但已发布的深度学习模型中尚无可对用TMTpro等等重标签标记的肽段进行测序的模型，而这类标签广泛用于多重定量蛋白质组学。我们用TMTpro标签和磷酸化扩展了Casanovo的残基词表，用来自我们实验室的2100万张质谱图（其中大多数为TMTpro标记）对其进行微调，并根据候选物与实测前体质量的一致性，对beam中的候选物重新排序。所得模型Casanovo-TMT在我们的测试集中为84.7%的TMTpro标记质谱图预测出确切的肽段形式（peptidoform），在来自其他实验室的两个公共全局蛋白质组数据集中分别为87.4%和79.6%的质谱图预测出确切的肽段形式，而仅扩展词表而未微调时为0.3%。丢弃得分最低的预测使精确率提高到95%，同时保留81.7%的测试质谱图。Casanovo-TMT还在一个公共磷酸肽富集数据集中为69.2%的质谱图预测出确切的肽段形式，并在来自我们实验室、未用于训练的三项磷酸化蛋白质组研究中为66%至72%的磷酸肽质谱图预测出确切的肽段形式。在这些研究中，其鉴定出的磷酸肽数量与数据库搜索引擎相当或更多，并且在数据库搜索鉴定较少的情况下，其鉴定数量按比例更多。对于仅由Casanovo-TMT鉴定出的磷酸肽，诱捕（entrapment）估计超过90%是正确的，并且一个独立搜索引擎在其有把握鉴定的质谱图中，有95%至98%被赋予了相同序列。因此，Casanovo-TMT可扩展基于TMTpro的定量蛋白质组学中的数据库搜索，尤其是在数据库搜索仅鉴定出少量磷酸肽的研究中。

title: DiagTrace: An Interactive Benchmark for Clinical Decision Making
zh_title: DiagTrace：临床决策交互式基准
summary: 构建含 510 例、8 个专科的交互式基准，考察大模型能否通过渐进信息获取重建病例诊断轨迹。
key_points: 病例源自 PubMed Central 病例报告，附事件库与诊断参考
从临床病程对齐、交互质量与效率三方面评估 4 个模型
225 例用于模型评估
reason: 新交互式基准具新意且有基线对比，但为预印本、证据有限
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on medical question answering and diagnostic reasoning benchmarks. However, existing evaluations typically provide all patient information upfront and assess only the final diagnosis or rationale. This setup ignores the need to acquire diagnostic evidence incrementally from incomplete information in real-world diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we introduce DiagTrace, a source-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can reconstruct the documented diagnostic trajectory through interactive information seeking. Each benchmark instance is built from a PubMed Central case report and includes an initial presentation, an event bank, a clinical course, and diagnostic references. DiagTrace contains 510 cases across eight specialties, with 225 used to evaluate four LLMs on clinical-course alignment, interaction quality, and efficiency. Results reveal trade-offs in coverage, source-consistent ordering, and turn use.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在医学问答和诊断推理基准上表现出色。然而，现有评估通常预先提供全部患者信息，并且仅评估最终诊断或推理依据。这种设置忽略了在真实世界诊断中需要从信息不完整的状态逐步获取诊断证据的需求。为弥合这一差距，我们引入了DiagTrace，一个基于来源的基准，用于评估LLMs能否通过交互式信息检索重建有记录的诊断轨迹。每个基准实例均基于PubMed Central的一篇病例报告构建，包括初始表现、事件库、临床病程和诊断参考。DiagTrace包含八个专科的510例病例，其中225例用于在临床病程一致性、交互质量和效率方面评估四个LLMs。结果揭示了在覆盖度、来源一致排序和轮次使用方面的权衡。

title: HealthCLBench:Evaluating Context Learning in Health Conversations through Controlled Case Clusters
zh_title: HealthCLBench：中文健康对话上下文学习基准
summary: 构建328个受控病例簇、1103例、4931条评分标准的中文健康对话基准，评估上下文学习。
key_points: 含328个受控簇、1103例病例
4931条评分标准，70人医学团队标注
覆盖医疗咨询与日常健康管理场景
reason: 新发布且规模可观的中文医学基准，含人工标注，但为预印本
abstract: Complex health conversations require answers grounded in individual information and currently valid evidence. We evaluate health context learning: acquiring, integrating, and applying relevant context during inference with fixed model parameters to answer health questions and respond appropriately to changes in facts, evidence, or task goals. To our knowledge, Chinese-language medical benchmarks have yet to systematically combine explicit contextual difficulties, controlled case variations, and member-specific medical criteria for open-ended answers. We introduce HealthCLBench, comprising 328 controlled clusters, 1,103 cases, and 4,931 rubric criteria across medical consultation and everyday health management. Members share backgrounds while evidence, patient states, or task goals change; each has its own medical scoring requirements. A 70-person medical team annotates and reviews the simulated cases and their rubrics. Human review of 700 full-context responses from the original evaluation yields 90.5% pooled agreement with the original automated judgments at the rubric-item level. We report full-context and query-only results for seven general-purpose models and Ant Afu. Across the eight systems, full- query differences range from 11.83 to 31.76 case points and from 10.87 to 38.97 geometric cluster points. GPT-6-Astra leads both full-context metrics at 75.03 and 60.42, followed by Claude-Opus-5-5 and Ant Afu. Cross-condition differences describe score changes under the reported evaluation settings. Response comparisons reveal failures in checking historical information, expressing uncertainty when warranted, and ensuring recommendations respect required conditions. The resource supports model comparison and targeted follow-up evaluation.
zh_abstract: 复杂的健康对话需要基于个体信息和当前有效证据的回答。我们评估健康上下文学习：在模型参数固定的推理过程中获取、整合并应用相关上下文，以回答健康问题，并对事实、证据或任务目标的变化作出适当响应。据我们所知，中文医学基准尚未系统地将显式上下文难点、受控病例变化以及针对开放式回答的成员特定医学标准结合起来。我们提出 HealthCLBench，涵盖医学咨询和日常健康管理，包含 328 个受控簇、1,103 个病例和 4,931 条评分细则标准。成员共享背景，而证据、患者状态或任务目标发生变化；每个成员都有其自身的医学评分要求。一个 70 人医学团队对模拟病例及其评分细则进行标注和审核。对原始评估中 700 条完整上下文回答进行人工审核，在评分细则条目层面与原始自动判断的合并一致率为 90.5%。我们报告了七个通用模型和 Ant Afu 的完整上下文与仅查询结果。在八个系统中，完整上下文与仅查询之间的差异（full- query differences）范围为 11.83 至 31.76 个病例分，以及 10.87 至 38.97 个几何簇分。GPT-6-Astra 以 75.03 和 60.42 领先两项完整上下文指标，其次是 Claude-Opus-5-5 和 Ant Afu。跨条件差异描述了在报告评估设置下的分数变化。回答比较揭示了在核查历史信息、在有理由时表达不确定性以及确保建议遵守所需条件方面的失败。该资源支持模型比较和有针对性的后续评估。

title: Visual Harness Scales General VLMs to Medical Images
zh_title: 视觉工具框架将通用VLM扩展至医学影像
summary: 为通用视觉语言模型配备交互式视觉工具与无损证据记忆，在11项任务、4种影像模态上均提升表现。
key_points: 模型可交互探索图像并累积诊断证据
提交答案后获得遗漏与可靠性反馈
迭代智能体循环直至证据充分再修订
reason: 跨11任务4模态的一致提升，但为预印本且无临床结局验证
abstract: We show that an appropriate visual harness can substantially improve the performance of general vision-language models (VLMs) across diverse medical imaging tasks. We introduce \ours, a medical visual harness that equips general VLMs with interactive visual tools and systematic diagnostic evidence management. With \ours, general VLMs interactively explore medical images and progressively acquire diagnostic evidence, which is preserved in a lossless memory for subsequent retrieval and use. After submitting an initial answer, the VLM receives an assessment of potential omissions and the reliability of identified findings. This assessment guides further image inspection and measurement, followed by answer revision in an iterative agentic loop until sufficient evidence is obtained. Across 11 tasks and four imaging modalities, \ours improves performance on all tasks with Qwen3.8-27B, with notable gains in spleen measurement (63.3\% to 98.3\%), renal search (57.5\% to 71.2\%), and pulmonary nodule detection (0.0\% to 28.2\%). High-capability API-based VLMs achieve even higher performance with \ours. For example, GPT-6.1 Sol improves pulmonary nodule detection from 10.8\% to 69.2\% with \ours, demonstrating the complementary benefits of stronger model capabilities and an effective medical visual harness. Our results highlight the potential of visual harnesses as a new paradigm for scaling general VLMs to medical imaging tasks.
zh_abstract: 我们表明，适当的视觉 harness 能够显著提升通用视觉-语言模型（VLM）在多种医学影像任务中的性能。我们提出 \ours，一种医学视觉 harness，为通用 VLM 配备交互式视觉工具和系统化的诊断证据管理。借助 \ours，通用 VLM 交互式探索医学图像并逐步获取诊断证据，这些证据保存在无损记忆中，供后续检索和使用。在提交初始答案后，VLM 会收到对潜在遗漏以及已识别发现可靠性的评估。该评估指导进一步的图像检查和测量，随后在迭代式智能体循环中修订答案，直至获得足够证据。在 11 项任务和四种成像模态中，\ours 使 Qwen3.8-27B 在所有任务上的性能均有提升，其中脾脏测量（63.3% 至 98.3%）、肾脏搜索（57.5% 至 71.2%）和肺结节检测（0.0% 至 28.2%）的提升尤为显著。能力更强的基于 API 的 VLM 在使用 \ours 时取得更高性能。例如，GPT-6.1 Sol 使用 \ours 将肺结节检测从 10.8% 提升至 69.2%，表明更强的模型能力与有效的医学视觉 harness 具有互补优势。我们的结果凸显了视觉 harness 作为将通用 VLM 扩展至医学影像任务的新范式的潜力。

title: MedGuardBench: A Patient-Oriented Benchmark for Personalized Guardrail Development
zh_title: MedGuardBench：面向患者的个性化安全护栏基准
summary: 发布面向用药安全的患者条件化护栏基准，含87种药物、5001个场景，并提出个性化推理护栏方法。
key_points: 提出患者条件化用药护栏任务，输出安全判定与17类风险
基准覆盖87种药物、5001个场景，按药物切分
发现标准护栏依赖措辞等表面线索，而非患者事实
reason: 新发布中等规模公开基准，任务设定有新意，但为预印本且证据有限
abstract: Safety is personal: the same action can be safe for one person but unsafe for another. Yet current guardrails judge content without considering who is affected. Using medication safety, we introduce \textit{patient-conditioned medication guarding}, which predicts a safety verdict and 17 risk categories from a patient profile and prescription. We release \textbf{MedGuardBench}, a drug-disjoint benchmark of 5{,}001 scenarios across 87 medications. We find that standard guardrails rely on surface cues, such as wording and profile presence, rather than patient facts. To address this, we develop \textit{personalized reasoning guardrails} with three components. \textbf{Personalized Reasoning Distillation} links risks to relevant patient fields. \textbf{Context Unrolling (CU)} makes models check each field themselves, reducing false alarms on most backbones; controls show that providing the check does not yield the same benefit. A \textbf{rule-based reward (guided GRPO)} improves unsafe recall and complex-risk detection, including allergies and adverse reactions, on some backbones, but increases false alarms on others. Our models outperform base models and matched no-profile controls in accuracy, while reducing false alarms relative to no-profile controls. Profile removal and swapping confirm that gains come from patient information, not fine-tuning alone.
zh_abstract: 安全性是个体化的：同一行动对一个人可能安全，对另一个人可能不安全。然而，当前的护栏（guardrails）判断内容时并未考虑谁受到影响。利用用药安全，我们引入患者条件化用药防护（patient-conditioned medication guarding），它从患者档案和处方预测安全性判定和17个风险类别。我们发布 MedGuardBench，一个跨87种药物、包含5,001个场景的药物不重叠基准。我们发现标准护栏依赖表面线索，如措辞和档案是否存在，而非患者事实。为解决此问题，我们开发了包含三个组件的个性化推理护栏（personalized reasoning guardrails）。个性化推理蒸馏（Personalized Reasoning Distillation）将风险与相关患者字段关联。上下文展开（Context Unrolling, CU）使模型自行检查每个字段，在大多数骨干模型上减少误报；对照实验表明，仅提供该检查并不能带来相同收益。一种基于规则的奖励（guided GRPO）在部分骨干模型上改善不安全召回和复杂风险检测（包括过敏和不良反应），但在其他骨干模型上增加误报。我们的模型在准确率上优于基础模型和匹配的无档案对照，同时相对于无档案对照减少误报。移除和交换档案证实收益来自患者信息，而不仅是微调。

title: MI-Hyper: Generating Multiple Instance Models for Weight Space Transfer Learning in Histopathology via Mixed Tasks Pretrained HyperNetwork
zh_title: MI-Hyper：病理WSI零样本权重生成
summary: 提出跨混合任务预训练的超网络MI-Hyper，为病理WSI零样本预测生成MIL聚合与分类权重。
key_points: 在52个病理数据集308项任务上评测
较MI-Zero平均AUC提升1.85个百分点
生成任务权重可在病例间复用
reason: 跨52个病理数据集308任务，规模可观但预印本且增益有限，属值得一看档。
abstract: Zero-shot whole-slide image (WSI) prediction aims to generalize to new pathology tasks without parameter updates at deployment. MI-Zero makes these predictions by pooling patch-text similarities. Conditional weight generation, combined with supervision from diverse pathology tasks, offers an alternative: learning to construct predictive rules from task descriptions. We introduce MI-Hyper, a hypernetwork pretrained across mixed tasks to generate the aggregation and classification weights of multiple instance learning (MIL) models. We first train the generator and a shared MIL basis jointly using source labels. We then freeze the basis and refine the generator. The generated task weights are reused across cases. Across 308 tasks from 52 pathology datasets, MI-Hyper improves mean AUC, balanced accuracy and macro-F1 over MI-Zero by 1.85, 1.17 and 0.57 percentage points, respectively. On some molecular prediction tasks, both AUC and balanced accuracy improve by more than 20 points. These results support task-conditioned weight generation as a promising approach to weight-space transfer for long-sequence modeling.
zh_abstract: 零样本全切片图像（whole-slide image, WSI）预测旨在部署时无需参数更新即可泛化到新的病理任务。MI-Zero 通过汇聚图像块-文本相似度来做出这些预测。条件权重生成结合来自多样化病理任务的监督，提供了一种替代方案：学习从任务描述构建预测规则。我们提出 MI-Hyper，一种在混合任务上预训练的超网络，用于生成多实例学习（multiple instance learning, MIL）模型的聚合权重和分类权重。我们首先使用源标签联合训练生成器和共享 MIL 基座。然后冻结该基座并微调生成器。生成的任务权重在不同病例间复用。在来自 52 个病理数据集的 308 个任务上，MI-Hyper 相比 MI-Zero 将平均 AUC、平衡准确率和 macro-F1 分别提高 1.85、1.17 和 0.57 个百分点。在一些分子预测任务上，AUC 和平衡准确率均提高超过 20 个百分点。这些结果支持任务条件权重生成作为一种面向长序列建模的权重空间迁移的有前景方法。

title: When Do Histology Foundation Models Need Geometric Test-Time Augmentation?
zh_title: 组织学基础模型何时需要几何测试时增强
summary: 基准9个组织学基础模型与6个通用模型，考察D4测试时增强在病理任务中的收益变化。
key_points: 覆盖4个patch级与2个WSI数据集
D4 TTA收益在组织学FM降至+0.50pp
提出熵路由以降低TTA计算开销
reason: 多模型多数据集基准，发现TTA收益递减，但为预印本，属值得一看档。
abstract: Test-time augmentation (TTA) aggregates model predictions across multiple transformed views of an input during inference. Because histology images lack a canonical orientation, $D_4$ TTA---pooling across the 8 rotations and reflections of a square---is a standard default in computational pathology. However, the rise of self-supervised histology foundation models (FMs) with inherent rotational invariance calls its continued utility into question. We benchmark 9 histology FMs and 6 general-purpose models across four patch-level and two whole-slide image (WSI) datasets. We find that $D_4$ TTA remains a reliable post hoc improvement, but benefits diminish from $+1.98$ percentage points (pp) for general-purpose backbones to $+0.50$ pp for histology FMs on TCGA-UT, and shrink further for the largest models. To eliminate computational overhead, our experiments demonstrate that entropy routing---applying TTA selectively to uncertain predictions---recovers most of the gain while augmenting only ${\sim}13\%$ of samples. Finally, we show that patch-level TTA improvements do not transfer to slide-level multiple instance learning (MIL). Code: https://github.com/lars-chen/histology-tta
zh_abstract: 测试时增强（test-time augmentation，TTA）在推理期间聚合模型对输入多个变换视图的预测。由于组织学图像缺乏规范方向，D4 TTA——对一个正方形的8种旋转和反射进行池化——是计算病理学中的标准默认做法。然而，具有固有旋转不变性的自监督组织学基础模型（foundation models，FMs）的兴起，使其持续有效性受到质疑。我们在四个图像块级数据集和两个全切片图像（whole-slide image，WSI）数据集上对9个组织学FM和6个通用模型进行了基准测试。我们发现，D4 TTA仍是一种可靠的事后改进，但收益从通用骨干模型的+1.98个百分点（pp）降至TCGA-UT上组织学FM的+0.50 pp，并且对最大的模型进一步缩小。为消除计算开销，我们的实验表明，熵路由——仅对不确定预测选择性应用TTA——可恢复大部分收益，同时仅对约13%的样本进行增强。最后，我们表明图像块级TTA改进不能迁移到切片级多实例学习（multiple instance learning，MIL）。代码：https://github.com/lars-chen/histology-tta

title: What You Post Is What You Symptom: Estimating Psychometric Networks from Social Media Discourse
zh_title: 社交媒体话语估计精神症状网络
summary: 提出从社交媒体文本估计症状级心理测量网络，并在抑郁与进食障碍三个语料上验证。
key_points: 抑郁表达分数与BDI-II总分相关ρ=0.434
21个条目中20个达FDR显著，分半信度0.935
在三个独立语料复现跨诊断语言标记
reason: 三语料跨数据集验证，但为预印本且非临床诊断研究，属值得一看档。
abstract: Symptom networks in psychopathology are estimated almost exclusively from self-report questionnaires, restricting inference to whatever symptom set a given instrument covers. We introduce a framework for symptom-resolved network estimation directly from social media discourse and apply the framework to depression and eating disorders, with a third anorexia corpus as cross-dataset validation. To our knowledge, we are the first to estimate symptom-resolved psychometric networks from social media text, compare them to clinical co-endorsement networks, and replicate transdiagnostic linguistic markers across 3 independently recruited corpora spanning 2 disorders simultaneously. For depression, expression scores correlate with BDI-II totals at $ρ{=}0.434$, 20 of 21 items reach FDR significance, and split-half reliability is 0.935. The Network Comparison Test detects few edge differences between modalities (3-5\% of edges), while bridge symptoms diverge. For eating disorders, the item-level results are exploratory. Identified linguistic features replicate the same direction across all 3 corpora, and they cluster in three construct families.
zh_abstract: 精神病理学中的症状网络几乎完全由自我报告问卷估计，这将推断限制在给定工具所覆盖的症状集合内。我们提出一个直接基于社交媒体话语进行症状解析网络估计的框架，并将该框架应用于抑郁症和进食障碍，并以第三个厌食症语料库作为跨数据集验证。据我们所知，我们是首批从社交媒体文本估计症状解析心理测量网络、将其与临床共同认可网络进行比较，并在同时涵盖2种障碍的3个独立招募语料库中重复验证跨诊断语言标记的研究。对于抑郁症，表达评分与BDI-II总分相关，ρ=0.434，21个条目中有20个达到FDR显著性，分半信度为0.935。网络比较检验（Network Comparison Test）检测到不同模态之间仅有少量边差异（3-5%的边），而桥症状存在分歧。对于进食障碍，条目级结果为探索性的。识别出的语言特征在所有3个语料库中重复出相同方向，并且它们聚类为三个构念家族。

title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
zh_title: System 1智能体：本地可靠快速工具调用
summary: 预印本提出本地System 1智能体，通过确定性编译器调用生物医学工具，避免生成文本与虚构参数。
key_points: 1952次请求覆盖157个生物医学工具
最佳智能体正确选工具或拒答达97.0%
无虚构内容，优于18种本地LLM智能体设置
reason: 预印本新智能体方法，有大规模工具调用基准与基线对比，证据限于临床外评测
abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%). The System 1 agent filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values. No System 1 call contained invented content, against 5.5-19.7% of LLM calls. The System 1 Agents framework is freely available as open-source software at https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents.
zh_abstract: 智能体人工智能（Agentic AI）可自动化分析敏感临床数据，但当前的智能体依赖大型语言模型（LLM）。云端LLM会暴露患者数据。本地LLM会产生幻觉，而工具调用中虚构的数值会传播到后续每一个步骤。在此我们提出一种构建System 1智能体的方法：即不生成文本而直接调用工具的本地智能体。一个确定性编译器将每个工具的schema和请求转换为多项选择题，选项来自请求和schema，然后由单遍决策模型作答。在针对157个生物医学工具的1,952个请求中，最佳System 1智能体在97.0%的请求中选择了正确工具或正确拒绝，显著领先于所有18种本地LLM智能体设置（最佳为95.2%）。该System 1智能体填入了6,056个明确给出的参数值中的97.0%。没有任何System 1调用包含虚构内容，而LLM调用中有5.5%–19.7%包含虚构内容。System 1 Agents框架作为开源软件可在https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents免费获取。

title: PlainPairs: A Corpus Pairing the Prescriber and Patient Texts of U.S. Prescription Medicine Labels
zh_title: PlainPairs：美国处方药说明书中医生版与患者版文本配对语料
summary: 基于openFDA说明书构建开放语料，含35,177份带患者文本的处方标签及可读性指标，另附NCI双语摘要。
key_points: 含35,177份处方标签、21,416份患者文本
250,829个患者文本片段按监管标题匹配医生章节
加入NCI 756份专业版与患者版、英西双语摘要
reason: 新发布公开大规模语料，但为预印本且任务较专门
abstract: A prescription medicine in the United States comes with labeling written for prescribers, and many medicines also carry a text written for patients: a Medication Guide or a patient package insert. The two texts describe the same medicine for two readers, yet public resources rarely hold them side by side. I present PlainPairs, an open corpus built from the openFDA drug label files. Version 0.1.0 holds 35,177 prescription labels that carry a patient text, 21,416 distinct patient texts, 250,829 patient-text segments matched to prescriber sections through their regulatory headings, reading-level measures on both sides, and rule-based counts of plain-language wording. A second source, the National Cancer Institute's cancer information summaries, adds 756 summaries in health-professional and patient versions, in English and Spanish. Measured on the structure of the label, the median Medication Guide reads at grade 8.7 by Flesch-Kincaid and at grade 11.1 by SMOG. The same guides measured on the flattened text that the bulk files serve read about two grades higher, a difference that comes from lost list and heading boundaries. Patient texts address the reader in 41 of every 100 sentences, against 0.2 in prescriber sections. A blind hand check of 100 pairs supports the heading-based alignment for seven of ten heading types. The corpus, its code and its documents are public, and the release keeps texts that show a company copyright mark out of the text tables.
zh_abstract: 在美国，处方药附有面向处方者的标签，许多药物还附有面向患者的文本：用药指南（Medication Guide）或患者包装说明书（patient package insert）。这两份文本面向两类读者描述同一种药物，但公共资源很少将它们并排呈现。我介绍 PlainPairs，这是一个基于 openFDA 药品标签文件构建的开放语料库。版本 0.1.0 包含 35,177 份带有患者文本的处方标签、21,416 份不同的患者文本、250,829 个通过其监管标题与处方者部分匹配的患者文本片段、两侧的阅读难度指标，以及基于规则的通俗语言措辞计数。第二个来源是美国国家癌症研究所（National Cancer Institute）的癌症信息摘要，增加了 756 份摘要，涵盖卫生专业人员版和患者版、英语和西班牙语。基于标签结构测量，中位用药指南按 Flesch-Kincaid 为 8.7 年级阅读水平，按 SMOG 为 11.1 年级阅读水平。同样的指南在批量文件所提供的扁平化文本上测量时，阅读年级约高两个年级，这一差异源于列表和标题边界丢失。患者文本每 100 句中有 41 句直接称呼读者，而处方者部分为 0.2。对 100 对文本的盲法人工核查显示，十种标题类型中有七种支持基于标题的对齐。该语料库、其代码和文档均公开，且该发布版将带有公司版权标记的文本排除在文本表之外。

title: A deep learning-based linear system for liver station in EUS (with video).
zh_title: 超声内镜肝脏八站扫描深度学习系统
summary: 基于9403张EUS肝脏图像训练站点分类模型，内部验证含2780张图像与26段视频，并开展人机竞赛。
key_points: 构建肝脏EUS八站标准化检查方案
内部验证含2780张图像与26段视频
340张图像人机竞赛及交叉设计评估
reason: 样本量可观的回顾性研究并含人机对比，但仅内部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Endoscopic ultrasound] With the widespread adoption of endoscopic techniques, the integration of EUS into hepatology has become an inevitable trend. This study aimed to develop a system that can conduct a comprehensive inspection of liver segments through scanning imaging at 8 stations. A standardized EUS examination protocol for the liver comprises 8 stations. We developed a deep learning-based station classification model using a dataset of 9403 EUS liver images. Internal validation was performed on 2780 EUS images and 26 EUS video clips. To further evaluate the model's clinical utility, a human-machine competition involving 340 liver images was conducted. The same set of 26 video clips in internal video validation was also employed for a crossover study to evaluate the system's effectiveness in reducing the difficulty of interpreting liver EUS images. For station classification, the model achieved an accuracy of 92.52% on image validation and a per-frame accuracy of 85.98% on video validation. In the human-machine comparison, the overall classification accuracy reached 88.53%, which was comparable to the average accuracy of the EUS experts (84.56%, P = 0.064). In the crossover study, trainees' station recognition accuracy improved significantly, with an increase of 16.36% (95% confidence interval, 11.43%-21.29%; P < 0.05). The system demonstrates high accuracy in liver station localization and achieves a classification performance comparable to EUS experts. It shows promise for facilitating standardized hepatic EUS examinations and may contribute to shortening the learning curve for trainees in the future.
zh_abstract: 【内镜超声】随着内镜技术的广泛采用，将 EUS 整合到肝病学中已成为必然趋势。本研究旨在开发一个系统，能够通过在 8 个站点进行扫描成像，对肝段进行全面检查。肝脏标准化 EUS 检查方案包括 8 个站点。我们使用包含 9403 幅 EUS 肝脏图像的数据集开发了基于深度学习的站点分类模型。在 2780 幅 EUS 图像和 26 段 EUS 视频片段上进行内部验证。为进一步评估模型的临床实用性，开展了涉及 340 幅肝脏图像的人机竞赛。内部视频验证中的同一组 26 段视频片段也被用于交叉研究，以评估该系统在降低肝脏 EUS 图像判读难度方面的有效性。对于站点分类，模型在图像验证上达到 92.52% 的准确率，在视频验证上达到 85.98% 的逐帧准确率。在人机比较中，总体分类准确率达到 88.53%，与 EUS 专家的平均准确率（84.56%，P = 0.064）相当。在交叉研究中，受训者的站点识别准确率显著提高，增加了 16.36%（95% 置信区间，11.43%-21.29%；P < 0.05）。该系统在肝脏站点定位方面表现出高准确率，并达到与 EUS 专家相当的分类性能。它显示出促进标准化肝脏 EUS 检查的前景，并可能有助于未来缩短受训者的学习曲线。

title: The Evolving Role of Artificial Intelligence in Facial Plastic Surgery: From Education and Research to EHR-Embedded Applications.
zh_title: 面部整形外科中AI角色演变综述
summary: 叙述性综述梳理AI在面部整形外科教育、科研及电子病历内嵌工作流中的应用与负责任采用。
key_points: 涵盖教学内容生成、手术技能评估与面部测量
EHR内嵌：病历摘要、环境记录、患者消息起草

reason: 叙述性综述，仅评估可行性与内容质量，无结局证据，属增量档
abstract: [Facial plastic surgery : FPS] Aims and Backgrounds Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly relevant to facial plastic surgery. This narrative review examines applications in education, research, and clinical workflows, including tools embedded in the electronic health record (EHR), and discusses responsible adoption. Technology Applications include educational content generation, surgical skill assessment, facial measurement, research assistance, preoperative simulation and planning, decision support, chart summarization, ambient documentation, and patient-message drafting. Agentic workflows could coordinate clinical tasks. Current and Future Development Available evidence primarily evaluates feasibility, content quality, measurement agreement, and workflow effects rather than improved clinical outcomes. Hallucinations, readability, privacy, safety, and bias require attention. Priorities include external validation, outcome assessment, and governance with continued monitoring as systems change. Conclusions and Clinical Relevance AI should augment surgeons, with oversight proportionate to clinical risk, protection of patient information, and assessment across patient groups. Its value should be judged by demonstrated improvements in clinical work, patient experience, and meaningful outcomes.
zh_abstract: [面部整形外科：FPS]【目的与背景】人工智能（AI）与面部整形外科的相关性日益增强。本叙述性综述考察其在教育、研究和临床工作流程中的应用，包括嵌入电子健康记录（EHR）的工具，并讨论负责任地采用。【技术】应用包括教育内容生成、手术技能评估、面部测量、研究辅助、术前模拟与规划、决策支持、病历摘要、环境记录和患者消息起草。智能体工作流程可协调临床任务。【现状与未来发展】现有证据主要评估可行性、内容质量、测量一致性和工作流程影响，而非改善的临床结局。幻觉、可读性、隐私、安全性和偏倚需要关注。优先事项包括外部验证、结局评估，以及随着系统变化进行持续监测的治理。【结论与临床意义】AI 应增强外科医生能力，监督力度与临床风险相称，保护患者信息，并在不同患者群体中进行评估。其价值应通过临床工作、患者体验和有意义结局方面已证实的改善来评判。

title: "Pipe-Laying": A novel fusion of 3D MRI and health records for the early detection and diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease using deep learning.
zh_title: 融合3D MRI与健康档案的阿尔茨海默病早期诊断深度学习
summary: PLoS One论文提出融合3D MRI与临床健康档案的深度学习方法，用于阿尔茨海默病早期检测与诊断。
key_points: 融合影像与文本健康档案的单一模型
针对分模态分类器拼接效果不佳的问题
目标为提升AD早期诊断准确性
reason: 回顾性方法研究，摘要未示外部验证与样本量，属增量改进
abstract: [PloS one] Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a prevalent form of dementia that impacts brain cells. Although its likelihood increases with age, there is no transitional period between its stages. In order to enhance diagnostic precision, physicians rely on clinical judgments derived from interpreting health data, considering demographics, clinical history, and laboratory results to detect AD at an early stage. While patient cognitive tests and demographic information are primarily presented in text, brain scan images are presented in graphic formats. Researchers typically use different classifiers for each data format and then merge the classifier outcomes to maximize classification accuracy and utilize all patient-related data for the final decision. However, this approach leads to low performance, diminishing predictive abilities and model effectiveness. We propose an innovative approach that combines diverse textual health records (HR) with three-dimensional structural magnetic resonance imaging (3D sMRI) to achieve a similar objective in computer-aided diagnosis, utilizing a novel deep learning technique. Health records, encompassing demographic features like age, gender, apolipoprotein gene, and mini-mental state examination score, are fused with 3D sMRI, enabling a graphic-based deep learning strategy for early AD detection. The fusion of data is accomplished by representing textual information as graphic pipes and integrating them into 3D sMRI, a method referred to as the "pipe-laying" method. This unified approach enables simultaneous processing of textual health records and 3D sMRI data within a single convolutional framework. Experimental results from over 4000 sMRI scans of 780 patients in the AD Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) dataset demonstrate that the pipe-laying method enhances recognition accuracy rates for Early Mild Cognitive Impairment (EMCI) and Late Mild Cognitive Impairment (LMCI) patients, accurately classifying all AD patients. In a 4-class AD diagnosis scenario, encompassing AD, LMCI, EMCI, Cognitively Normal (CN) accuracy improved from 86.87% when only 3D images were used to 90.00% when 3D sMRI and patient health records were included. Thus, the positive impact of combining 3D sMRI with HR on 4-class AD diagnosis was established.
zh_abstract: [PloS one] 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种影响脑细胞的常见痴呆症。尽管其可能性随年龄增长而增加，但其各阶段之间没有过渡期。为了提高诊断精度，医生依赖通过解读健康数据得出的临床判断，综合考虑人口学特征、临床病史和实验室结果，以在早期阶段检测 AD。患者的认知测试和人口学信息主要以文本形式呈现，而脑扫描图像以图形格式呈现。研究人员通常针对每种数据格式使用不同的分类器，然后合并分类器结果，以最大化分类准确率，并利用所有患者相关数据作出最终决策。然而，这种方法导致性能较低，削弱了预测能力和模型有效性。我们提出一种创新方法，利用一种新颖的深度学习技术，将多样化的文本健康记录（HR）与三维结构磁共振成像（3D sMRI）相结合，以在计算机辅助诊断中实现类似目标。健康记录涵盖年龄、性别、载脂蛋白基因和简易精神状态检查评分等人口学特征，将其与 3D sMRI 融合，从而形成一种基于图形的深度学习策略，用于早期 AD 检测。这种数据融合通过将文本信息表示为图形管道并将其整合到 3D sMRI 中来实现，该方法被称为“pipe-laying”方法。这种统一方法能够在单一卷积框架内同时处理文本健康记录和 3D sMRI 数据。来自 AD Neuroimaging Initiative（ADNI，阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议）数据集中 780 名患者的 4000 多幅 sMRI 扫描的实验结果表明，pipe-laying 方法提高了早期轻度认知障碍（EMCI）和晚期轻度认知障碍（LMCI）患者的识别准确率，并准确分类了所有 AD 患者。在涵盖 AD、LMCI、EMCI 和认知正常（CN）的 4 类 AD 诊断场景中，准确率从仅使用 3D 图像时的 86.87% 提高到纳入 3D sMRI 和患者健康记录时的 90.00%。因此，确立了将 3D sMRI 与 HR 结合对 4 类 AD 诊断的积极影响。

title: AI-Assisted Management of Diabetes and Hypertension in Primary Care
zh_title: 基层糖尿病与高血压AI辅助管理试验注册
summary: 江苏泰州人民医院注册村医主导数字化管理模式的整群随机试验，计划入组9245例，尚无结果。
key_points: 整群随机对照，村卫生室分组
计划入组9245名60岁以上患者
尚未开始招募，无结果数据
reason: 大样本前瞻性随机设计为加分项，但仅注册、无结果，属值得一看档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Jiangsu Taizhou People's Hospital; conditions: Type 2 Diabetes (T2DM), Hypertension; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 9245; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Brief Summary: Many older adults in rural areas suffer from both type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure. Managing these two conditions at the primary care level is often challenging. This study aims to find out if a new "village doctor-led digital management model" can help improve patient health compared to the current standard care. Who can participate? Adults aged 60 or older who have been diagnosed with both type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure, whose current blood sugar or blood pressure is not well-controlled, and who receive care at local village clinics. How does the study work? Village clinics will be randomly assigned to one of two groups: Usual Care Group: Patients receive standard national primary health services. Integrated Care Group: In addition to standard care, village doctors will use an Artificial Intelligence (AI) system. This system provides clinical suggestions to the village doctors, helps arrange remote consultations with hospital specialists if needed, and gives patients personalized advice on diet and exercise. What are we measuring? We will follow participants for up to 3 years. The main goals are to see if the new AI-assisted model improves the control of blood sugar, blood pressure, and cholesterol at 12 months, and whether it reduces the risk of severe cardiovascular events (like heart attacks or strokes) over 36 months.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：江苏省泰州市人民医院；疾病：2型糖尿病（Type 2 Diabetes, T2DM）、高血压；类型：干预性（INTERVENTIONAL）；分期：NA；入组人数：9245；状态：尚未开始招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 简要摘要：农村地区许多老年人同时患有2型糖尿病和高血压。在初级保健层面管理这两种疾病通常具有挑战性。本研究旨在了解与当前标准照护相比，一种新的“乡村医生主导的数字管理模式”是否有助于改善患者健康。谁可以参加？年龄在60岁或以上、已被诊断同时患有2型糖尿病和高血压、当前血糖或血压控制不佳，并在当地村卫生室接受照护的成年人。研究如何开展？村卫生室将被随机分配到两组之一：常规照护组：患者接受国家标准的初级卫生服务。整合照护组：除标准照护外，乡村医生将使用人工智能（Artificial Intelligence, AI）系统。该系统向乡村医生提供临床建议，在需要时帮助安排与医院专科医生的远程会诊，并向患者提供个性化的饮食和运动建议。我们测量什么？我们将对参与者随访最长3年。主要目标是观察这种新的AI辅助模式是否在12个月时改善血糖、血压和胆固醇的控制，以及是否在36个月内降低严重心血管事件（如心脏病发作或卒中）的风险。

title: Artificial intelligence-based finish-line detection and margin-related accuracy in fixed prosthodontic digital workflows: A systematic review and functional meta-synthesis.
source: PubMed · The Journal of prosthetic dentistry
zh_title: 固定修复数字化流程中AI边缘线检测的系统综述
summary: 系统综述与功能性证据整合，评估牙科固定修复数字化流程中AI边缘线检测及与边缘相关精度的证据。
key_points: 检索PubMed、Scopus、Embase至2026年5月
按AI功能角色分类整合并评估偏倚风险
指出边缘处理与冠精度证据仍异质
reason: 系统综述但纳入研究异质、结论不明确，属增量档
abstract: [The Journal of prosthetic dentistry] Artificial intelligence (AI) has been increasingly incorporated into fixed prosthodontic digital workflows, but evidence regarding finish-line detection, margin handling, and margin-related crown accuracy remains heterogeneous. The purpose of this systematic review was to evaluate AI-based finish-line detection, margin-line extraction, and margin-related accuracy in tooth-supported fixed prosthodontic workflows using a functional meta-synthesis. The PubMed, Scopus, and Embase databases were searched through May 2026. Studies evaluating AI, machine learning, or deep learning for finish-line detection, margin extraction, crown design, margin-aware crown generation, or margin-related accuracy were included. Findings were synthesized according to the functional role of AI, and risk of bias and applicability were assessed using an adapted quality framework. A total of 17 studies were included. AI demonstrated measurable performance for margin detection and supported crown-design workflows, frequently reducing design time. Marginal and internal adaptation were generally clinically acceptable or comparable with conventional workflows, although superiority was inconsistent. Quantitative pooling was precluded by substantial methodological and outcome heterogeneity. AI showed technical feasibility for margin-sensitive fixed prosthodontic workflows, but current evidence remains heterogeneous, predominantly early-stage, and insufficient to establish consistent clinical superiority.
zh_abstract: [The Journal of prosthetic dentistry] 人工智能（AI）已被越来越多地纳入固定修复数字化工作流程，但关于终止线检测、边缘处理和边缘相关牙冠准确性的证据仍存在异质性。本系统综述的目的是使用功能性荟萃整合，评估牙支持的固定修复工作流程中基于AI的终止线检测、边缘线提取和边缘相关准确性。检索了PubMed、Scopus和Embase数据库，截至2026年5月。纳入评估AI、机器学习或深度学习用于终止线检测、边缘提取、牙冠设计、边缘感知的牙冠生成或边缘相关准确性的研究。研究结果按AI的功能角色进行综合，并使用改编的质量框架评估偏倚风险和适用性。共纳入17项研究。AI在边缘检测方面表现出可测量的性能，并支持牙冠设计工作流程，常可减少设计时间。边缘适配和内部适配通常临床可接受或与传统工作流程相当，但优越性并不一致。由于方法和结局存在显著异质性，无法进行定量合并。AI在对边缘敏感的固定修复工作流程中显示出技术可行性，但当前证据仍存在异质性，主要处于早期阶段，不足以确立一致的临床优越性。

title: Ontology pre-training improves machine learning-based predictions for metabolites.
zh_title: 本体预训练提升代谢物机器学习预测
summary: 将生物本体分类层级嵌入深度模型作为中间预训练步骤，在代谢物功能与活性预测上提升性能并缩短训练时间。
key_points: 提出通用可迁移的“本体预训练”中间训练步骤
在代谢物功能、活性等多类任务上性能提升
同时减少训练时间
reason: 同行评审方法学研究，性能与效率均有改进，但属增量改进档
abstract: [PLoS computational biology] Deep learning has recently led to multiple breakthroughs in longstanding biological problems. Recent advances have shown that integration of expert knowledge can improve deep learning model predictive performance in complex domains such as biology. Bio-ontologies offer a rich source of curated biological knowledge that can be harnessed to this end. Here, we describe an intuitive and generalisable approach to embed the knowledge contained in a classification hierarchy derived from a bio-ontology into a deep learning model as an intermediate training step between general-purpose pre-training and task-specific fine-tuning: a process that we call'ontology pre-training'. We show that this approach leads to an improvement in predictive performance and a reduction in training time for a broad range of prediction tasks related to metabolite functions, activities and properties in living systems, using a range of datasets derived from MoleculeNet. We see the biggest improvement for regression tasks, e.g., prediction of lipophilicity and aqueous solubility of molecules, and a robust improvement for most classification tasks. Our approach can be adapted for a wide range of knowledge sources, models and prediction tasks.
zh_abstract: [《PLoS计算生物学》] 深度学习最近在长期存在的生物学问题上带来了多项突破。近期进展表明，整合专家知识可提高深度学习模型在生物学等复杂领域的预测性能。生物本体提供了经过整理的生物学知识丰富来源，可用于此目的。在此，我们描述一种直观且可推广的方法，将源自生物本体的分类层级中所含知识嵌入深度学习模型，作为通用预训练与任务特定微调之间的中间训练步骤：我们将这一过程称为“本体预训练”。我们使用一系列源自MoleculeNet的数据集表明，该方法在与活系统中代谢物功能、活性和性质相关的广泛预测任务中提高了预测性能并缩短了训练时间。我们在回归任务中看到最大改善，例如预测分子的亲脂性和水溶性，并在大多数分类任务中看到稳健改善。我们的方法可适用于广泛的知识来源、模型和预测任务。

title: Commercially available multimodal LLMs for EEG-based prognostication after cardiac arrest.
zh_title: 商用多模态大模型用于心脏骤停后EEG预后
summary: 前瞻性队列33例昏迷患者，测试两款商用多模态大模型基于EEG图像预测神经预后。
key_points: 单份10秒EEG以PNG图像输入模型
比较ChatGPT与Claude及5种提示策略
样本仅33例，未提及外部验证
reason: 小样本探索性研究，无外部验证，属增量档，选题新颖略加分
abstract: [Resuscitation] Machine-learning and deep-learning approaches have been successfully applied to EEG-based prognostication in comatose patients after cardiac arrest (CA), but typically rely on task-specific signal processing, feature extraction, and model development. Here, we investigated whether two commercially available multimodal large language models (LLMs) could predict neurological outcome directly from EEG images. Thirty-three comatose patients on the first day after CA from a prospective cohort were included. For each patient, a single 10-second EEG segment displayed using a longitudinal bipolar montage was rendered as PNG image. ChatGPT 5.4. and Claude Opus 4.7 were instructed to estimate the probability for favorable outcome for each case based on the EEG and a generic information block describing conditions of recordings. Five different prompting strategies were used, including few-shot prompting where four exemplary EEGs (not from the 33 patients) were provided. Predictive performance was quantified using AUC and accuracy. Across prompting strategies, the AUC ranged from 0.86 to 0.99 for ChatGPT and from 0.74 to 1.00 for Claude. The highest accuracy achieved by both models was 93.9% using few-shot prompting. As reference, a previously published dedicated deep-learning model achieved 100% on the same cohort. In this exploratory study of a small cohort, multimodal LLMs showed variable but potentially promising discrimination for predicting favorable outcome from single EEG image in comatose patients after CA. Performance depended substantially on prompt design. These findings require confirmation in a larger cohort.
zh_abstract: [Resuscitation] 机器学习和深度学习方法已成功应用于心脏骤停（CA）后昏迷患者基于EEG的预后判断，但通常依赖于任务特定的信号处理、特征提取和模型开发。在此，我们研究了两种市售多模态大语言模型（LLMs）能否直接从EEG图像预测神经学结局。纳入来自一项前瞻性队列的33例心脏骤停后第1天的昏迷患者。对每例患者，将单个10秒EEG片段以纵向双极导联组合显示并渲染为PNG图像。指示ChatGPT 5.4.和Claude Opus 4.7根据EEG以及描述记录条件的一般信息块，估计每例患者获得良好结局的概率。使用了五种不同的提示策略，包括提供四份示例EEG（非来自这33例患者）的少样本提示。预测性能用AUC和准确率量化。在不同提示策略中，ChatGPT的AUC范围为0.86至0.99，Claude为0.74至1.00。两种模型使用少样本提示时达到的最高准确率均为93.9%。作为参照，先前发表的一种专用深度学习模型在同一队列上达到100%。在这项小队列探索性研究中，多模态LLMs从单张EEG图像预测CA后昏迷患者良好结局方面表现出可变但可能有一定前景的区分能力。性能在很大程度上取决于提示设计。这些发现需要在更大队列中确认。

title: When Expert Disagreement Hurts: Prestige and Selectivity in LLM Decision Revision
zh_title: 专家异议何时有害：LLM决策修订审计
summary: 对五个模型1,989条医学、科学与法律决策做两轮审计，专家标注的异议均未达选择性修订门槛，准确率最多降16.1分。
key_points: 仅改变修订语境：中立反思、匿名异议、专家异议
选择性门槛：错误反转须高于正确反转a/(1-a)倍
专家标签这一声望线索使四个模型出现更多反转
reason: 预印本，多模型对照设计清晰，但非医学专属且无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: When language models revise a decision after another agent disagrees, neither reversal counts nor final accuracy shows whether they are fixing mistakes or abandoning correct answers. We introduce a controlled two-pass audit that holds the question, the evidence, and the model's initial answer fixed and varies only the revision context: neutral reflection, anonymous disagreement, or disagreement attributed to a domain expert. For binary decisions the accounting is exact: revision raises accuracy only if it is selective enough, reversing wrong answers more than a/(1-a) times as often as correct ones, where a is initial accuracy (nine times at 90%). Across five models and 1,989 evidence-grounded decisions in medicine, science, and law, no model clears this bar under expert disagreement, and accuracy falls by up to 16.1 points. The expert label, a prestige cue, adds reversals for four of the five models, yet its effect on accuracy ranges from a 5.2-point loss to a 2.4-point gain, so reversal counts are a poor proxy for harm. With identical arguments from both sources, the label still raises reversal for three proprietary models and in a pooled analysis of four newer models. Models also respond to stated source reliability. Revision pipelines should therefore be evaluated with paired, conditional metrics, per model and protocol.
zh_abstract: 当语言模型在另一个智能体表示不同意后修改决策时，反转次数和最终准确率都不能表明它们是在纠正错误还是在放弃正确答案。我们引入一种受控的两轮审计，固定问题、证据和模型的初始答案，仅改变修订情境：中性反思、匿名不同意，或归因于领域专家的不同意。对于二分类决策，这种核算精确：只有当修订具有足够选择性，即反转错误答案的频率超过反转正确答案频率的 a/(1-a) 倍时，修订才会提高准确率，其中 a 为初始准确率（在 90% 时为九倍）。在医学、科学和法律领域的五个模型和 1,989 个有证据依据的决策中，没有模型在专家不同意的情况下达到这一标准，准确率最多下降 16.1 个百分点。专家标签作为一种声望线索，使五个模型中的四个反转增加，但其对准确率的影响从下降 5.2 个百分点到上升 2.4 个百分点不等，因此反转次数是危害的不良替代指标。当两个来源提供相同论据时，该标签仍使三个专有模型以及四项较新模型的汇总分析中的反转增加。模型还会对明确陈述的来源可靠性作出反应。因此，修订流程应按模型和方案，使用配对的条件指标进行评估。

title: Uncovering the Invisible in Routine Radiology: Cross-Modal Detection of MRI-Verified Soft-Tissue Pathologies from CBCT via Physics-Guided 3D Self-Supervised Learning
zh_title: 物理引导自监督学习从常规CBCT中检出MRI证实的软组织病变
summary: 预印本：以颞下颌关节212对CBCT-MRI为模型，用物理引导两阶段3D自监督流程从常规CBCT中检出亚视觉软组织病变。
key_points: 212对配对CBCT-MRI关节数据，配对数据极少
先在6550例无标注CBCT上预训练3D掩码自编码器
目标为机会性筛查软组织病变，仍需外部验证
reason: 预印本新方法有新意但样本212例、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Routine X-ray modalities like cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) are optimized for high-contrast mineralized tissues, leaving soft-tissue abnormalities buried beneath photon noise and below human visual perception. Thus, detecting non-calcified pathologies requires secondary magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). We demonstrate that sub-visual radiographic signatures of soft-tissue pathology are physically preserved within routine CBCT scans and can be extracted for opportunistic screening using a targeted, physics-guided deep learning pipeline, even under extreme paired-data scarcity. Using the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) as a model system (N = 212 paired CBCT-MRI joints), we address the severe overfitting of high-capacity 3D networks through a two-stage framework. First, we employ a frozen full-grid 3D masked autoencoder (BertsWin) pre-trained on 6,550 unlabeled CBCT volumes via the GradientConductor (GCond) optimizer and an anatomy-aware objective (PhysLoss) redirecting gradient flow into the [-300, 300] HU soft-tissue window. Second, automated localization of the condylar zenith drives a deterministic 3D cropping that eliminates 81% of background osseous variance. Evaluated via a patient-isolated 3x10-fold stratified cross-validation protocol, a statistically robust sub-visual signal for MRI-verified synovial effusion (ROC AUC = 0.793) emerges exclusively from representations pre-trained with the PhysLoss and GCond regime. Crucially, only this setup captures true 3D anatomical chirality (p < 0.001) and high intra-patient structural consistency (0.791) over inter-patient noise; conversely, identical architectures pre-trained with standard L2 loss or unmasked variance decomposition (MVC) collapse to random guessing. These findings establish a generalizable paradigm for repurposing routine, low-contrast radiographic scans into opportunistic screening tools for occult soft-tissue disease.
zh_abstract: 诸如锥形束计算机断层扫描（cone-beam computed tomography, CBCT）之类的常规X射线模态针对高对比度矿化组织进行了优化，使得软组织异常被淹没在光子噪声之下并低于人类视觉感知。因此，检测非钙化病变需要二次磁共振成像（MRI）。我们证明，软组织病理的亚视觉放射学特征在物理上保留在常规CBCT扫描中，并且即使在极端配对数据稀缺的情况下，也可以使用靶向的、物理引导的深度学习流程将其提取出来用于机会性筛查。以颞下颌关节（temporomandibular joint, TMJ）作为模型系统（N = 212个配对的CBCT-MRI关节），我们通过两阶段框架解决高容量三维网络的严重过拟合。首先，我们采用冻结的全网格三维掩码自编码器（BertsWin），其通过GradientConductor（GCond）优化器和解剖感知目标函数（PhysLoss）在6,550个未标注CBCT体数据上预训练，该目标函数将梯度流重定向到[-300, 300] HU软组织窗。其次，髁突顶点的自动定位驱动确定性三维裁剪，消除81%的背景骨性方差。通过患者隔离的3×10折分层交叉验证方案评估，一个在统计上稳健的、经MRI验证的滑膜积液亚视觉信号（ROC AUC = 0.793）仅从使用PhysLoss和GCond方案预训练的表征中出现。关键的是，只有这种设置捕获了真实的三维解剖手性（p < 0.001）以及高于患者间噪声的高患者内结构一致性（0.791）；相反，使用标准L2损失或未掩码方差分解（unmasked variance decomposition, MVC）预训练的相同架构退化为随机猜测。这些发现确立了一个可推广的范式，可将常规低对比度放射学扫描重新用于隐匿性软组织疾病的机会性筛查工具。

title: CAST: Calibrating Correspondences for Training-Free Biomedical In-Context Segmentation
zh_title: CAST：免训练生物医学上下文分割校准
summary: 提出免训练框架CAST，基于冻结DINOv3校准生物医学图像上下文分割中的细粒度对应关系。
key_points: 免训练，仅用少量标注示例指定新结构
稳定性与一致性测试提升对应可靠性
针对邻近结构相似及跨受试者差异
reason: 预印本方法，思路清晰但未见外部验证或临床结局，属值得一看档。
abstract: Biomedical image segmentation must keep up with new anatomical structures, subjects, imaging modalities, and acquisition protocols, yet dense expert annotations are scarce and models trained on one cohort often struggle to transfer. In-context segmentation (ICS) offers a way out: a new structure is specified by a few annotated exemplars at inference time. However, reliable correspondence remains challenging in biomedical images, where adjacent structures often share similar appearances, and variations across subjects and imaging conditions further obscure their distinctions. We introduce CAST, a training-free framework built on a frozen DINOv3 backbone to calibrate fine-grained correspondences. Its stability test improves feature reliability at both global and patch-specific levels, while its coherence test assesses whether candidate correspondences are supported by consistent local structural context. Together, these tests enable more reliable correspondence across diverse anatomical structures and imaging conditions. Across eight biomedical benchmarks spanning 2D and 3D segmentation, cross-subject, and cross-modality transfer, CAST outperforms the strongest overall baseline by 12.34 percentage points in Dice and ranks first across all six volumetric settings. The versatility of CAST further opens up opportunities for challenging biomedical applications, including 2D-to-3D segmentation and atlas label transfer.
zh_abstract: 生物医学图像分割必须跟上新的解剖结构、受试者、成像模态和采集方案，然而密集的专家标注稀缺，且在一个队列上训练的模型往往难以迁移。上下文分割（in-context segmentation, ICS）提供了一条出路：在推理时通过少量带标注的示例来指定新结构。然而，在生物医学图像中建立可靠对应关系仍然具有挑战性，因为相邻结构往往具有相似外观，而受试者和成像条件之间的变化进一步模糊了它们的区别。我们提出 CAST，一种基于冻结 DINOv3 主干的免训练框架，用于校准细粒度对应关系。其稳定性测试在全局和特定图像块层面提高特征可靠性，而其一致性测试评估候选对应关系是否得到一致的局部结构上下文支持。这些测试共同作用，使得在多样化解剖结构和成像条件下实现更可靠的对应关系。在涵盖二维和三维分割、跨受试者和跨模态迁移的八个生物医学基准上，CAST 在 Dice 上比最强的总体基线高出 12.34 个百分点，并在所有六个体数据设置中排名第一。CAST 的多功能性进一步为具有挑战性的生物医学应用开辟了机会，包括二维到三维分割和图谱标签迁移。

title: Pathology Randomization for Synthetic Priors and Zero-Shot Detection
zh_title: PathoDraw：脑 MRI 病理合成与零样本检测
summary: 预印本提出生成式模型 PathoDraw，将病灶分布绘入标签图后做对比度无关渲染，实现跨对比度零样本异常检测。
key_points: 以健康解剖为条件生成病灶标签图
对比度无关渲染支持跨模态
单网络估计健康解剖与强度偏差
reason: 有新意的生成式预印本方法，临床验证信息有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Hospital brain imaging archives hold a diverse array of pathology at sample sizes beyond prospective studies, particularly for underrepresented populations and diseases. To unlock uncurated clinical data and scale analysis, methods are needed to detect abnormalities across contrasts and resolutions. Synthetic data has provided robust, contrast-agnostic models for a variety of human neuroimaging tasks in healthy anatomy, but pathology detection and other tasks in clinical settings still require real patient data, contrast-specific models, or disease-specific generators. We propose PathoDraw, a generative model of brain MRI with pathology. A conditional distribution of lesions given the healthy anatomy is drawn into the label map before contrast-agnostic rendering, and a single network estimates healthy anatomy with exact signed intensity deviation of any input scan. The contrast-agnostic 3D UNet learns the healthy labels under the lesion and the signed deviation directly and identifies pathology via robust tissue statistics and learned features, despite no training on real pathology. We show zero-shot detection on public stroke, tumor, and white matter hyperintensity datasets as well as archived clinical data, spanning $T_1$w, FLAIR and $T_2$w at various resolutions under a recent unsupervised anomaly detection benchmark protocol. Our single model exceeds or performs comparably to contrast-specific anomaly detectors trained on real scans and keeps healthy anatomy intact. The same generator trains networks for super-resolution and for registration in the presence of pathology. Our model, robust across acquisition and disease, enables the use of uncurated, archived data for clinical analysis. Our code is available at https://github.com/agr78/Pathology-Randomizer.
zh_abstract: 医院脑影像档案包含多种病理，其样本量超出前瞻性研究，尤其是针对代表性不足的人群和疾病。为了利用未整理的临床数据并扩大分析规模，需要能够在不同对比度和分辨率下检测异常的方法。合成数据已在健康解剖结构的多种人类神经影像任务中提供了稳健的、对比度无关的模型，但临床环境中的病理检测和其他任务仍需要真实患者数据、对比度特异性模型或疾病特异性生成器。我们提出 PathoDraw，一种带病理的脑 MRI 生成模型。在对比度无关渲染之前，将给定健康解剖结构的病灶条件分布绘制到标签图中；单一网络估计健康解剖结构，并给出任意输入扫描的精确有符号强度偏差。这种对比度无关的 3D UNet 直接学习病灶下方的健康标签和有符号偏差，并通过稳健的组织统计量和学习到的特征识别病理，尽管未在真实病理上训练。我们展示了在公开的卒中、肿瘤和白质高信号数据集以及存档临床数据上的零样本检测，涵盖不同分辨率下的 $T_1$w、FLAIR 和 $T_2$w，并在近期一项无监督异常检测基准协议下进行评估。我们的单一模型超过或性能相当于在真实扫描上训练的对比度特异性异常检测器，并保持健康解剖结构完整。同一生成器可训练用于超分辨率和存在病理时的配准的网络。我们的模型在不同采集和疾病条件下均稳健，使得未整理的存档数据可用于临床分析。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/agr78/Pathology-Randomizer 获取。

title: OICycle: Observe, Infer, and Intervene Cycle for Belief-State Learning in Longitudinal Clinical Decision Making
zh_title: OICycle：面向纵向临床决策的信念状态学习闭环
summary: 预印本提出OICycle，从回顾性轨迹直接学习随机信念状态，建模观察-推断-干预闭环。
key_points: 将临床决策形式化为POMDP信念状态更新问题
用循环算子融合既往信念与新多模态观察
无需人工指定离散状态空间与转移模型
reason: 方法有新意但仅预印本，未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Clinical care is a closed loop: clinicians observe partial evidence, infer the patient's state, and intervene, and each intervention determines what is observed next. This makes clinical decision making a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), in which a belief over a latent patient state must be updated from irregular, multimodal, and incomplete records. Yet most deep clinical models predict from a single snapshot or from coarsely aggregated history, while POMDP-based clinical methods need hand-specified discrete state spaces and transition models that real electronic health records cannot supply. We introduce OICycle (Observe, Infer, and Intervene Cycle), which learns a stochastic belief state directly from retrospective trajectories. At every episode, a learned recurrent operator fuses a sample of the previous belief with the new multimodal observations and the intervention that produced them. The resulting Gaussian belief is trained to predict clinicians' next interventions, the time to the next episode, and next-episode mortality. To enable reproducible evaluation, we release a benchmark derived from MIMIC-IV, MIMIC-IV-Note, and MIMIC-CXR that organizes 72,075 hospital admissions (5.4M laboratory, microbiology, radiology, prescription, and note records) into temporally ordered therapeutic--diagnostic episodes. Compared with an otherwise identical history-free model, OICycle improves next-intervention adaptive recall from 0.253 to 0.347, time-to-next-episode macro-F1 from 0.293 to 0.351, and next-episode mortality macro-F1 from 0.585 to 0.649. Analysis shows that the learned belief encodes intervention type and trajectory position and evolves smoothly across episodes, and that the benefit of history is concentrated in interventions whose ordering depends on prior findings.
zh_abstract: 临床照护是一个闭环：临床医生观察部分证据，推断患者状态并进行干预，而每次干预决定接下来观察到什么。这使临床决策成为一个部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（partially observable Markov decision process, POMDP），其中必须根据不规则、多模态和不完整的记录来更新对潜在患者状态的信念。然而，大多数深度临床模型从单一快照或从粗粒度聚合的历史中进行预测，而基于POMDP的临床方法需要手工指定的离散状态空间和转移模型，真实电子健康记录无法提供这些。我们提出 OICycle（Observe, Infer, and Intervene Cycle，观察-推断-干预循环），它直接从回顾性轨迹中学习随机信念状态。在每个 episode，一个学习到的循环算子将先前信念的一个样本与新的多模态观察以及产生这些观察的干预融合。由此得到的高斯信念被训练用于预测临床医生的下一次干预、到下一个 episode 的时间以及下一个 episode 的死亡率。为实现可重复评估，我们发布了一个基于 MIMIC-IV、MIMIC-IV-Note 和 MIMIC-CXR 的基准，将 72,075 次住院（5.4M，即 540 万条实验室、微生物学、放射学、处方和记录）组织为按时间排序的治疗—诊断 episode。与一个其他方面完全相同但无历史的模型相比，OICycle 将下一次干预的自适应召回率从 0.253 提高到 0.347，将到下一个 episode 的时间的宏 F1 从 0.293 提高到 0.351，并将下一个 episode 死亡率的宏 F1 从 0.585 提高到 0.649。分析表明，学习到的信念编码了干预类型和轨迹位置，并在 episode 之间平滑演化；历史信息的益处集中在那些其顺序取决于先前发现的干预上。

title: Savant: A Fast, Structure-Free Binding Affinity Predictor For Protein-Ligand Drug Screening
zh_title: Savant：免结构的蛋白-配体结合亲和力预测器
summary: 预印本提出Savant，仅用蛋白序列与配体文本结构快速预测解离常数，用于药物筛选。
key_points: 无需共折叠即可打分，降低算力与耗时
输入为蛋白氨基酸序列与配体线性表示
面向生成化学与按需化合物库的筛选瓶颈
reason: 药物发现方法类预印本，有明确效率动机但证据有限
abstract: Protein-ligand binding affinity determines which of many candidate molecules is worth synthesizing and assaying, making it the central measurement in early drug discovery. Binding affinity is commonly expressed as the dissociation constant, an equilibrium measure that indicates how easily a complex separates into its components. AI-based generative chemistry and make-on-demand chemical catalogs now produce molecules faster than rigorous method can evaluate them. Leading computational methods co-fold the complex before scoring the binding affinity between the protein and the ligand, which provides high accuracy but requires a graphics processing unit (GPU) and substantial time for every pair evaluated.Here we present Savant, a machine learning model that estimates the dissociation constant using only the protein's amino acid sequence and the ligand's structure written as a line of text (SMILES). Savant needs no 3-dimensional folded structure, no docking, and no GPU. To test Savant fairly, we built a benchmark designed to prevent any training data to leak into the testing set, drawing only on measurements published after the training data was assembled and on molecules chemically unlike anything the model had seen. On an independent benchmark, Savant ranks ahead of every other 3-dimensional structure-free method.Savant is designed to rank compounds against a single protein, and performs as well as other methods that require a GPU, while running only on a central processing unit (CPU). Thus, Savant can screen libraries of 100,000 compounds in minutes with commodity hardware.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质-配体结合亲和力决定许多候选分子中哪一个值得合成和检测，使其成为早期药物发现中的核心测量指标。结合亲和力通常表示为解离常数，这是一种平衡指标，表明复合物解离成其组分的容易程度。基于 AI 的生成化学和按需制造化合物目录现在产生分子的速度快于严格方法评估它们的速度。领先的计算方法在评分蛋白质与配体之间的结合亲和力之前先共折叠复合物，这提供高准确性，但每评估一对都需要图形处理单元（GPU）和大量时间。在此我们提出 Savant，一种机器学习模型，仅使用蛋白质的氨基酸序列和以一行文本（SMILES）表示的配体结构来估计解离常数。Savant 不需要三维折叠结构、不需要对接，也不需要 GPU。为公平测试 Savant，我们构建了一个基准，旨在防止任何训练数据泄漏到测试集中，仅使用训练数据汇编之后发表的测量值以及化学上与模型所见任何分子都不同的分子。在一个独立基准上，Savant 排名领先于所有其他无三维结构方法。Savant 设计用于针对单一蛋白质对化合物进行排序，并且仅在中央处理器（CPU）上运行，表现与需要 GPU 的其他方法一样好。因此，Savant 可以用普通硬件在几分钟内筛选 100,000 个化合物的库。

title: Evaluation of System One Models on Biomedical Texts
zh_title: System One模型在生物医学文本任务上的评估
summary: 预印本在7个数据集8项任务上比较小型专用模型与通用大模型的表现、成本与置信度路由。
key_points: 覆盖问答、错误检测、结构化抽取与病历评估
最强小型模型成本低于Opus不到1%
基于校准的置信度路由可降低开销
reason: 多任务多数据集对比评估，但为预印本且无外部临床验证
abstract: Objective To compare the performance and cost of System One models (SOMs) with general-purpose large language models (LLMs) on biomedical tasks and evaluate confidence-based routing. Materials and Methods We evaluated three SOMs and three LLMs across seven datasets and eight endpoints covering question answering, error detection, structured extraction, and clinical-note assessment. Outcomes included task-specific performance, recorded inference cost and latency, and confidence calibration. Calibration data determined routing schemes and confidence thresholds to evaluate test predictions, with cost-matched random referral as a comparator. Results Claude Opus 5.5 had the highest primary performance on all eight endpoints. The strongest SOM, Jev, had competitive performance with the evaluated LLMs and cost less than 1% of Opus on most datasets. Three selected SOM-to-LLM routes reduced costs by 30.0%-71.7% relative to the receiving LLM, with modest reductions in performance. On one benchmark, SOM-to-SOM routing achieved 91.1% accuracy, compared with 82.3% and 82.2% for the individual models. Discussion SOMs offered favorable performance-cost tradeoffs for most tasks. The magnitude of the advantages depended on task structure and prompting requirements. Confidence-based routing between SOMs and LLMs can leverage complementary model strengths and offers additional flexibility in performance-cost tradeoffs. The price advantages offered by SOMs can facilitate experimentation and development of workflows. This warrants further evaluation on closed datasets. Conclusion For biomedical tasks with predefined choices, SOMs represent a competitive stand-alone or first-stage approach.
zh_abstract: 【目的】在生物医学任务上比较 System One 模型（SOMs）与通用大语言模型（LLMs）的性能和成本，并评估基于置信度的路由。【材料与方法】我们在七个数据集和八个终点上评估了三个 SOM 和三个 LLM，涵盖问答、错误检测、结构化抽取和临床记录评估。结局指标包括任务特异性性能、记录的推理成本和延迟，以及置信度校准。校准数据确定路由方案和置信度阈值，以评估测试预测，并以成本匹配的随机转介作为比较器。【结果】Claude Opus 5.5 在全部八个终点上具有最高的主要性能。最强的 SOM，Jev，与所评估的 LLMs 相比具有竞争力，并且在大多数数据集上成本低于 Opus 的 1%。三条选定的 SOM 到 LLM 路由相对于接收 LLM 降低成本 30.0%-71.7%，性能略有下降。在一个基准上，SOM 到 SOM 路由达到 91.1% 准确率，而单个模型分别为 82.3% 和 82.2%。【讨论】SOM 在大多数任务上提供了有利的性能-成本权衡。优势幅度取决于任务结构和提示要求。基于置信度的 SOM 与 LLM 之间的路由可以利用互补的模型优势，并在性能-成本权衡中提供额外灵活性。SOM 提供的价格优势可以促进工作流的实验和开发。这值得在封闭数据集上进一步评估。【结论】对于具有预定义选项的生物医学任务，SOM 代表一种有竞争力的独立或第一阶段方法。

title: OmniTongue: A Comprehensive MLLM Benchmark for Automated Tongue Diagnosis in Traditional Chinese Medicine
zh_title: OmniTongue：中医舌诊多模态大模型基准
summary: arXiv 预印本发布首个细粒度中医舌诊视觉问答基准，含 1351 张图像与 21616 条指令对。
key_points: 1351 张专家校验图像、21616 条指令对
设 16 个临床维度与部位标注
覆盖 66 项细粒度舌象特征
reason: 新发布细粒度基准，但为预印本且未说明开放获取，属值得一看档
abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have excelled in Western medical imaging, yet their potential in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) tongue diagnosis remains systematically unevaluated. Tongue diagnosis requires sophisticated global and local perception, serving as a rigorous touchstone for assessing the visual understanding depth of MLLMs. However, existing datasets are limited by single dimensions, coarse granularity, and ambiguous labels, hindering the evaluation of authentic clinical capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniTongue, the first comprehensive, fine-grained Visual Question Answering benchmark for TCM tongue diagnosis. This benchmark integrates 1,351 expert-validated images and 21,616 instruction pairs. Its core design features 16 clinical dimensions for multidimensional evaluation, region-specific annotations for pathological localization, and 66 fine-grained labels for precise diagnostic representation. Extensive evaluations of existing MLLMs reveal significant performance gaps, demonstrating that medical-specific models lack domain advantages, while universally poor Macro-F1 scores expose a reliance on statistical shortcuts rather than genuine understanding of tongue pathology. These findings not only highlight the current limitations of MLLMs in interpreting regional medical features but also underscore OmniTongue's significance for developing robust automated tongue diagnosis models. The code and dataset will be made publicly available in a future release.
zh_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在西方医学影像中表现优异，但其在中医（TCM）舌诊中的潜力仍未得到系统评估。舌诊需要复杂的全局与局部感知，是评估 MLLMs 视觉理解深度的严格试金石。然而，现有数据集受限于维度单一、粒度粗糙和标签模糊，阻碍了对真实临床能力的评估。为弥合这一差距，我们推出 OmniTongue，这是首个面向中医舌诊的综合、细粒度视觉问答基准。该基准整合了 1,351 幅经专家验证的图像和 21,616 个指令对。其核心设计包括用于多维评估的 16 个临床维度、用于病理定位的区域特异性标注，以及用于精确诊断表示的 66 个细粒度标签。对现有 MLLMs 的广泛评估揭示了显著性能差距，表明医学专用模型缺乏领域优势，而普遍较差的 Macro-F1 分数暴露出其依赖统计捷径而非真正理解舌部病理。这些发现不仅突显了 MLLMs 目前在解释区域医学特征方面的局限，也强调了 OmniTongue 对开发稳健自动化舌诊模型的重要性。代码和数据集将在未来发布中公开。

title: Deciphering the Biological Function of Tandem Mass Spectra Using a Dual-Modal Metabolite Language Model
zh_title: 双模态代谢物语言模型解析串联质谱的生物学功能
summary: 预印本提出Spec2Function框架，无需先验结构鉴定即可从MS2谱推断生物学功能，核心为谱-文本双编码器Spec2Biotext。
key_points: 面向未注释代谢物的“功能暗物质”问题
推理阶段无需查询谱的结构鉴定
以已表征的谱-文本配对训练双编码器
reason: 方法有新意但为预印本，摘要未体现外部验证与基线对比细节
abstract: Liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry untargeted metabolomics captures thousands of metabolic peaks from biological samples. Conventional identification-dependent metabolomics workflows require confident structural annotation before identified features can enter downstream pathway or functional analysis. However, only a small fraction of detected metabolic features can be assigned confident structural annotations, leaving a large fraction difficult to incorporate into downstream biological interpretation, a form of "functional dark matter". Here, we introduce Spec2Function, a function-centric framework that infers biological functions from tandem mass spectrometry (MS2) spectra. Spec2Function is trained using characterized spectrum-text pairs but does not require prior structural identification of the query spectra at inference time. At its core is Spec2Biotext, a dual-encoder contrastive model that embeds MS2 spectra and curated multi-aspect natural language functional texts into a unified functional space. Combined with a retrieval-augmented generation framework grounded in curated databases and biomedical literature, Spec2Function retrieves evidence-grounded biological knowledge and produces coherent functional summaries for individual spectra or groups of spectra. Across metabolite- and pathway-level benchmarks, Spec2Function achieved higher similarity to reference functional descriptions than the evaluated comparators and expanded the fraction of the metabolome accessible to functional interpretation. Application to a human liver cirrhosis cohort recapitulated known metabolic alterations and identified additional literature-supported functional modules. Applying Spec2Function to a 30-organ macaque aging atlas revealed organ-specific metabolic functions and previously unreported functional modules that were supported by independent human and mouse datasets. Together, these results position Spec2Function as a function-centric framework for scalable biological interpretation of structurally unannotated MS2 spectra.
zh_abstract: 液相色谱-串联质谱非靶向代谢组学可从生物样本中捕获数千个代谢峰。传统的依赖鉴定的代谢组学工作流程要求已识别特征在进入下游通路或功能分析之前具有可信的结构注释。然而，只有一小部分检测到的代谢特征能够被赋予可信的结构注释，导致很大一部分难以纳入下游生物学解释，这是一种“功能暗物质”。在此，我们介绍 Spec2Function，一个从串联质谱（MS2）谱推断生物学功能的以功能为中心的框架。Spec2Function 使用已表征的谱-文本对进行训练，但在推断时不需要对查询谱进行事先结构鉴定。其核心是 Spec2Biotext，一个双编码器对比模型，将 MS2 谱和整理好的多方面自然语言功能文本嵌入统一的功能空间。结合以整理数据库和生物医学文献为基础的检索增强生成框架，Spec2Function 可检索有证据依据的生物学知识，并为单个谱或谱组生成连贯的功能摘要。在代谢物水平和通路水平基准中，Spec2Function 与参考功能描述的相似性高于所评估的对照方法，并扩大了可用于功能解释的代谢组比例。应用于人类肝硬化队列时，重现了已知代谢改变，并识别出额外的有文献支持的功能模块。将 Spec2Function 应用于 30 个器官的猕猴衰老图谱，揭示了器官特异性代谢功能以及此前未报道的功能模块，这些模块得到独立的人类和小鼠数据集支持。总之，这些结果使 Spec2Function 成为一个以功能为中心的框架，用于对结构未注释的 MS2 谱进行可扩展的生物学解释。

title: VITAL: A Framework for Validating Agentic AI in Pharmaceutical Drug Development and Clinical Trial Operations
zh_title: VITAL：药物研发与临床试验运营中智能体验证框架
summary: 通过文献与监管标准梳理、专家访谈提出VITAL框架，用于智能体在药物临床开发中的按用途验证与全生命周期治理。
key_points: 整合用途情境、控制点、行为验证与生命周期证据
应用于流行病学分析、中心选择、入组救援等场景
强调检索与推理失败可能在合理输出下被掩盖
reason: 预印本方法学框架，有应用案例但无量化验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Current assurance approaches do not establish whether evidence is sufficient to validate, monitor and govern agentic artificial intelligence (AI) within a pharmaceutical context of use. Plausible outputs may conceal failures in retrieval, reasoning, orchestration or human-control points, where reference standards are unavailable. We developed and operationalised VITAL (Validation by Intended use, Traceability, Autonomy and Lifecycle evidence), a validation framework for agents in clinical development, through landscape analysis, regulatory and standards mapping, expert interviews and multi-stakeholder refinement. VITAL integrates context of use, controls, behavioural validation and lifecycle evidence within a risk-adjusted framework. We applied VITAL across epidemiology and treatment-landscape analysis, site selection, enrolment rescue and trial-design trade-off support to translate autonomy, reversibility, transparency and patient impact into proportionate validation activities, evidence requirements and auditable reconstruction of system behaviour. VITAL may inform evidence requirements and lifecycle accountability for higher-risk pharmaceutical uses; evaluation should assess reproducibility across assessors, organisations and system configurations.
zh_abstract: 当前的保证方法无法确定证据是否足以在制药使用情境中验证、监测和治理代理式人工智能（agentic artificial intelligence，AI）。看似合理的输出可能掩盖检索、推理、编排或人类控制点的失败，而在这些地方参考标准不可用。我们通过全景分析、监管与标准映射、专家访谈和多利益相关方完善，开发并实施了 VITAL（Validation by Intended use、Traceability、Autonomy and Lifecycle evidence），这是一个用于临床开发中代理（agents）的验证框架。VITAL 在风险调整框架内整合了使用情境、控制、行为验证和生命周期证据。我们将 VITAL 应用于流行病学和治疗全景分析、中心选择、入组挽救和试验设计权衡支持，以将自主性、可逆性、透明性和患者影响转化为相称的验证活动、证据要求以及可审计的系统行为重构。VITAL 可为更高风险的制药用途提供证据要求和生命周期问责方面的参考；评估应评价评估者、组织和系统配置间的可重复性。

title: Efficient Self-Supervised Adaptation of 3D Abdominal Vision-Language Model for Institution-Specific HCC Classification via Full Fine-Tuning and PEFT
zh_title: 3D腹部视觉语言模型跨机构适配分类HCC
summary: 用外院腹部CT与报告微调预训练3D医学视觉语言模型分类肝细胞癌，比较全量微调与PEFT。
key_points: 比较全量微调与参数高效微调两种策略
PEFT达AUC 0.79、F1 0.70
全量微调AUC 0.82，跨机构域偏移下仍有效
reason: 有新意的适配方法预印本，基线对比有限、单机构任务
abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) capture cross-modal relationships between image and text, yet their adaptation to institution-specific clinical tasks remains underexplored. In this study, we fine-tuned a pretrained 3D medical VLM for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) classification using paired abdominal CT scans and radiology reports from a different institution with acquisition characteristics that differ from the model's original pretraining corpus. We compared two adaptation strategies: full fine-tuning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), motivated by the common use of PEFT to reduce computational cost and enable adaptation under limited-data constraints. Both approaches achieve strong downstream HCC classification performance despite the cross-institutional domain shift, with PEFT reaching an AUC of 0.79 and F1 of 0.70, and full fine-tuning achieving an AUC of 0.82 and F1 of 0.71. Although these results remain below the performance reported by supervised HCC classification approaches, our method achieves improvements over the pretrained model through CT-report contrastive learning without requiring lesion-level annotations or HCC classification labels as training targets. Full fine-tuning converges rapidly but overfits within a few epochs, whereas PEFT (ConvLoRA for the image encoder and LoRA for the text encoder) attains comparable performance while updating approximately 1% of the model parameters, although requiring more training steps. We also examine the role of contrastive temperature, observing that temperature initialization significantly affects classification performance. This study demonstrates that a 3D medical VLM can be efficiently adapted to institution-specific HCC classification using self-supervised CT-report contrastive learning, while highlighting the practical trade-offs between full fine-tuning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
zh_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）捕获图像与文本之间的跨模态关系，但其对机构特定临床任务的适应仍研究不足。在本研究中，我们使用来自另一机构的配对腹部CT扫描和放射学报告，对预训练的3D医学VLM进行微调，用于肝细胞癌（HCC）分类，这些数据的采集特征与模型原始预训练语料不同。我们比较了两种适应策略：全量微调和参数高效微调（PEFT），其动机是PEFT常用于降低计算成本并在有限数据约束下实现适应。尽管存在跨机构域偏移，两种方法均取得较强的下游HCC分类性能，PEFT达到AUC 0.79和F1 0.70，全量微调达到AUC 0.82和F1 0.71。尽管这些结果仍低于监督式HCC分类方法所报告的性能，但我们的方法通过CT-报告对比学习在无需病灶级标注或HCC分类标签作为训练目标的情况下，较预训练模型取得改进。全量微调收敛迅速，但在几个epoch内过拟合，而PEFT（图像编码器使用ConvLoRA，文本编码器使用LoRA）在更新约1%模型参数的情况下达到相当性能，尽管需要更多训练步骤。我们还考察了对比温度的作用，观察到温度初始化显著影响分类性能。本研究表明，3D医学VLM可利用自监督CT-报告对比学习高效适应机构特定HCC分类，同时突出了全量微调与参数高效微调之间的实际权衡。

title: Machine Learning Prediction of Antibiotic Resistance Genes: Performance, Interpretability, and Cross-Database Redundancy
zh_title: 机器学习预测耐药基因：性能与跨库冗余
summary: 基于CARD训练XGBoost识别耐药基因，AUROC达0.982，并检验两个独立数据库间的一致性与跨库泛化。
key_points: 氨基酸三肽频率与理化特征训练的XGBoost
打乱标签基线降至随机，支持信号真实
SHAP显示KTG三肽等可解释特征，并评估跨库冗余
reason: 方法规范且有可解释性分析，但单库训练、预印本证据有限
abstract: Antibiotic resistance gene (ARG) classifiers are typically developed and evaluated within a single curated database, leaving open how much two independently curated databases agree and what that implies for apparent cross-database generalization. We trained an XGBoost classifier on amino acid trigram frequencies and physicochemical descriptors using the Comprehensive Antibiotic Resistance Database (CARD), the field's largest curated ARG resource. The model separated resistance genes from non-resistance proteins with near-ceiling accuracy (AUROC = 0.982, MCC = 0.886); a label-shuffling null baseline collapsed to chance (AUROC = 0.508) and bootstrap confidence intervals were narrow, confirming genuine signal rather than data leakage or overfitting. SHAP analysis attributed this performance to biologically interpretable features, notably the trigram KTG, isoelectric point, and aromaticity, each consistent with known catalytic motifs in resistance enzymes. Before testing the classifier against ResFinder, one of CARD's most widely used counterparts, we assessed database independence by clustering sequences with CD-HIT, finding that 96.8-98.7% of ResFinder sequences shared substantial protein identity with CARD even at a permissive 50% identity threshold, indicating the two databases largely represent the same sequence population, with direct implications for how cross-database generalization should be measured. On the small subset of ResFinder sequences genuinely non-redundant with CARD (40-100 sequences, depending on threshold), the classifier failed completely, never classifying any as resistance genes; SHAP traced this failure to sequence length, as non-redundant sequences are nearly three times longer than training proteins, and length is among the model's most influential features. The same pattern emerged by resistance mechanism: the model achieved perfect accuracy on beta-lactamases, compact single-domain enzymes well represented in training (100%, n = 351), but correctly identified only 38.5% of efflux pump components (n = 13), a mechanism built from large, multi-domain transporters rather than compact catalytic enzymes. Together, these results describe a capable, interpretable ARG classifier alongside a quantified methodological caution: cross-database redundancy must be measured rather than assumed, and when a sequence-composition classifier fails, the failure is often explained by protein architecture rather than database origin.
zh_abstract: 抗生素耐药基因（ARG）分类器通常在单一 curated 数据库内开发和评估，这使得两个独立 curated 数据库之间的一致性程度以及这对表观跨数据库泛化意味着什么仍不清楚。我们使用该领域最大的 curated ARG 资源——综合抗生素耐药数据库（CARD），基于氨基酸三联体频率和理化描述符训练了一个XGBoost分类器。该模型以接近上限的准确率将耐药基因与非耐药蛋白区分开（AUROC = 0.982，MCC = 0.886）；标签打乱的空基线降至随机水平（AUROC = 0.508），且bootstrap置信区间较窄，确认了真实信号而非数据泄漏或过拟合。SHAP分析将这一性能归因于具有生物学可解释性的特征，尤其是三联体KTG、等电点和芳香性，每项均与耐药酶中已知的催化基序一致。在针对ResFinder（CARD最广泛使用的对应数据库之一）测试该分类器之前，我们通过CD-HIT对序列聚类评估数据库独立性，发现即使采用宽松的50%一致性阈值，96.8-98.7%的ResFinder序列仍与CARD具有显著蛋白一致性，表明这两个数据库在很大程度上代表同一序列群体，这对如何衡量跨数据库泛化具有直接影响。在ResFinder中与CARD真正非冗余的小部分序列（40-100条序列，取决于阈值）上，分类器完全失败，从未将任何序列分类为耐药基因；SHAP将此失败追溯至序列长度，因为非冗余序列几乎比训练蛋白长三倍，而长度是模型最具影响力的特征之一。按耐药机制也出现相同模式：模型在β-内酰胺酶上达到完美准确率，这类紧凑的单结构域酶在训练中代表性良好（100%，n = 351），但仅正确识别了38.5%的外排泵组分（n = 13），该机制由大型多结构域转运体而非紧凑催化酶构成。总之，这些结果描述了一个有能力且可解释的ARG分类器，同时给出量化的方法学警示：跨数据库冗余必须被测量而非假定，并且当序列组成分类器失败时，失败往往由蛋白结构而非数据库来源解释。

title: Beyond Acuity Accuracy: A Multidimensional Framework for Evaluating Patient-Facing Emergency Triage AI Tools
zh_title: SAFE-Triage：面向患者的急诊分诊AI多维评估框架
summary: 提出整合人工复核、自动指标、LLM评审与模拟测试的分诊AI评估框架，并在MIMIC-IV情景与万例分析中应用。
key_points: 框架覆盖临床表现、患者交互、医生摘要质量
提示式LLM分诊ESI准确率57.5%，低于分诊率13.1%
规则增强版输出更短更稳定、可读性更高
reason: 提出有新意的评估框架并有万例分析，但为预印本、非前瞻临床结局，属值得一看档
