abstract: Patient-facing AI triage tools may support care-seeking and emergency department prioritization, but require evaluation beyond acuity accuracy alone. We developed SAFE-Triage, a framework integrating human review, automated metrics, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and simulation testing across clinical performance, patient interaction, and clinician-facing summary quality. We applied SAFE-Triage to 40 MIMIC-IV-derived emergency vignettes and a 10,030-case acuity analysis comparing prompted LLM triage (PLT) with rule-augmented prompted LLM triage (rPLT). PLT achieved higher emergency severity index (ESI) accuracy (57.5% vs 42.8%, $P < 0.001$), lower undertriage (13.1% vs 29.8%, $P < 0.001$), and higher clinician ratings across all domains. rPLT produced shorter and more stable outputs with higher automated readability scores. SAFE-Triage identified trade-offs between acuity accuracy, undertriage risk, communication quality, readability, and summary quality, supporting pre-deployment refinement and ongoing monitoring by showing where triage tools are efficient, need improvement, or need clinician oversight.
zh_abstract: 面向患者的人工智能分诊工具可能支持就医行为和急诊科优先级排序，但需要超越病情严重程度准确性 alone 的评估。我们开发了SAFE-Triage，这是一个整合人工审核、自动化指标、LLM作为评审器的评估以及跨越临床性能、患者互动和面向临床医生的摘要质量的模拟测试的框架。我们将SAFE-Triage应用于40个源自MIMIC-IV的急诊情景案例，以及一项10,030例病情严重程度分析，比较提示式大语言模型分诊（prompted LLM triage, PLT）与规则增强的提示式大语言模型分诊（rule-augmented prompted LLM triage, rPLT）。PLT获得了更高的急诊严重程度指数（ESI）准确性（57.5% vs 42.8%，$P < 0.001$）、更低的分诊不足（13.1% vs 29.8%，$P < 0.001$），以及所有维度上更高的临床医生评分。rPLT产生的输出更短、更稳定，自动化可读性评分更高。SAFE-Triage识别出病情严重程度准确性、分诊不足风险、沟通质量、可读性和摘要质量之间的权衡，通过显示分诊工具在何处高效、需要改进或需要临床医生监督，支持部署前优化和持续监测。

title: Who Pays for Byzantine Robustness? Validity, Data-Share Dictatorships, and Fairness When Only a Few Hospitals Collaborate
zh_title: 少数医院协作下拜占庭鲁棒聚合的有效性与公平性审计
summary: 在 3 个医疗联邦学习数据集上执行 54,214 次训练，审计 8 种拜占庭鲁棒聚合规则的权重与公平性问题。
key_points: 使用 FLamby 的 3 个跨机构医疗数据集（4—6 家机构）
比较不加权与按样本量加权两种聚合变体
以精确孪生留出对照拆分诚实数据损失与攻击损害
reason: 针对少机构场景的大规模实证审计，有基准对照但为预印本、无临床验证
abstract: Clinical federated learning (FL) collaborations typically connect only three to six hospitals, yet Byzantine-robust aggregation rules are designed and benchmarked on synthetic partitions across dozens of equal-sized clients. We conduct an empirical audit of eight standard aggregation rules: FedAvg, coordinate-wise median, trimmed mean, Krum, Multi-Krum, Bulyan, geometric median (GeoMed), and Centered Clipping (CC). We evaluate both unweighted and sample-size-weighted variants across three cross-silo medical datasets from the FLamby benchmark: Fed-Heart-Disease ($n = 4$ hospitals), Fed-TCGA-BRCA ($n = 6$ regions), and Fed-ISIC2019 ($n = 6$ centres). We execute 54,214 training runs across enumerated attacker coalitions ($f \in \{1, 2\}$) paired with exact-twin leave-out controls that decompose performance drops into honest data loss versus adversarial attack damage. We report three findings. First, client-count validity checks fail to capture breakdown in skewed medical consortia: while $n = 6, f = 1$ satisfies every count condition except Bulyan's, assigning sample-size weights turns median and GeoMed into a clean-model dictatorship whenever a single hospital holds more than half the training data, and causes weighted median, GeoMed, and CC to collapse when that dominant centre attacks. Second, exact-twin leave-out controls reveal that when the largest hospital attacks, the apparent failure of count-based robust rules is predominantly caused by the loss of honest training data (7.5 to 10.4 points on ISIC) rather than adversarial perturbation (2.3 to 3.8 points on ISIC). Conversely, weight-dependent rules suffer large true attack damage (16.1 to 25.1 points on ISIC). Third, unweighted robust rules consistently discount whichever institution generates the most atypical parameter updates, penalizing the smallest hospital on Heart but penalizing larger institutions on TCGA and ISIC.
zh_abstract: 临床联邦学习（FL）协作通常只连接三到六家医院，然而拜占庭鲁棒聚合规则却是在数十个等规模客户端的合成划分上设计和基准测试的。我们对八种标准聚合规则进行实证审计：FedAvg、坐标中位数、截尾均值、Krum、Multi-Krum、Bulyan、几何中位数（GeoMed）和 Centered Clipping（CC）。我们在来自 FLamby 基准的三个跨孤岛医学数据集上评估未加权和按样本量加权的变体：Fed-Heart-Disease（n = 4 家医院）、Fed-TCGA-BRCA（n = 6 个地区）和 Fed-ISIC2019（n = 6 个中心）。我们在枚举的攻击者联盟（f ∈ {1, 2}）上执行 54,214 次训练运行，并配以精确孪生留出对照，将性能下降分解为诚实数据损失与对抗攻击损害。我们报告三项发现。第一，客户端数量有效性检查未能捕捉偏斜医学联盟中的失效：虽然 n = 6、f = 1 满足除 Bulyan 之外的所有计数条件，但当单家医院持有超过一半训练数据时，分配样本量权重会使中位数和 GeoMed 变成干净模型独裁，并且当该主导中心发起攻击时，会使加权中位数、GeoMed 和 CC 崩溃。第二，精确孪生留出对照揭示，当最大医院发起攻击时，基于计数的鲁棒规则的明显失败主要由诚实训练数据损失（ISIC 上 7.5 至 10.4 个点）而非对抗扰动（ISIC 上 2.3 至 3.8 个点）导致。相反，依赖权重的规则遭受较大的真实攻击损害（ISIC 上 16.1 至 25.1 个点）。第三，未加权鲁棒规则会一致地折减产生最异常参数更新的机构，在 Heart 上惩罚最小医院，但在 TCGA 和 ISIC 上惩罚较大的机构。

title: Call-Efficient ICD-10 Code Prediction via Supervised Candidate Generation and Selective LLM Invocation
zh_title: 高效调用大模型的ICD-10编码预测流程
summary: 提出结合Transformer嵌入、树模型候选生成、重排序与门控大模型辅助的ICD-10编码流程，锁定测试集Top-1为74.32%。
key_points: 监督式父类候选生成Top-10覆盖率达93.05%
采用无泄漏验证：折外预测选阈值，锁定测试集报告
门控机制仅在必要时调用大模型以控制成本
reason: 预印本新方法，有基线对比与锁定测试集，但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Automatic assignment of ICD-10 codes from short clinical diagnosis text is a practical medical text classification and normalization task. The task is difficult because diagnosis phrases are short and noisy, the ICD-10 label space is hierarchical, and the class distribution is strongly imbalanced. This paper presents a call-efficient ICD-10 code prediction pipeline that combines transformer embeddings, tree-based supervised candidate generation, candidate-level reranking, and a gated LLM assistance. The evaluation uses a leakage-safe validation protocol: model and threshold selection are based on out-of-fold cross-validation predictions, while final reporting is performed on a locked test set with no shared source-file groups. The supervised conditional parent-code candidate generator reaches 74.32% Top-1 accuracy on the locked test set and 93.05% Top-10 candidate coverage. A direct zero-shot GPT-5.6-Sol baseline reaches 81.01% Top-1 accuracy, but requires an invocation of this large model for every diagnosis. The final deployable system, Pre-LLM fusion, reaches 81.24% OOF-CV accuracy and 83.19% locked-test accuracy while calling the LLM for only 31.97% of cases. This improves the locked-test error rate from 25.68% for the supervised parent-code baseline to 16.81%, corresponding to a 34.5% relative error reduction. The results show that the most effective role of the LLM is controlled reranking on uncertain examples rather than unrestricted coding or full-dataset invocation.
zh_abstract: 从简短临床诊断文本中自动分配ICD-10代码是一项实用的医学文本分类与规范化任务。该任务较为困难，因为诊断短语简短且含噪声，ICD-10标签空间具有层次结构，且类别分布严重不平衡。本文提出了一种调用高效的ICD-10代码预测流程，结合Transformer嵌入、基于树的监督式候选生成、候选级别重排序和门控LLM辅助。评估采用防泄漏验证方案：模型和阈值选择基于折外交叉验证预测，而最终报告在无共享源文件组的锁定测试集上进行。监督式条件父代码候选生成器在锁定测试集上达到74.32%的Top-1准确率和93.05%的Top-10候选覆盖率。直接零样本GPT-5.6-Sol基线达到81.01%的Top-1准确率，但需要对每个诊断调用该大型模型。最终可部署系统Pre-LLM fusion达到81.24%的OOF-CV准确率和83.19%的锁定测试准确率，同时仅对31.97%的病例调用LLM。这将锁定测试错误率从监督式父代码基线的25.68%改善至16.81%，相当于相对错误率降低34.5%。结果表明，LLM最有效的作用是对不确定样本进行受控重排序，而不是无限制编码或全数据集调用。

title: Flexible Multi-Stack Super-Resolution of Clinical Brain MRI Using Hetero-Orientation Variational Encoding: Expert Reader Evaluation in a Nigerian Cohort
zh_title: 异向变分编码的多堆栈脑MRI超分辨
summary: MS-HVED将不同方位脑MRI堆栈独立编码后融合实现灵活超分辨，并在尼日利亚队列做专家阅片评价。
key_points: 序列无关框架，支持轴位、冠状位、矢状位堆栈
用高斯积融合并抑制视野外区域贡献
在尼日利亚队列开展专家读者评价
reason: 预印本，含资源受限队列的专家阅片评价，但非前瞻性设计，属值得一看档
abstract: High-resolution brain MRI is important for neuroradiological assessment, yet routine clinical protocols often rely on fast, anisotropic 2D acquisitions, particularly in resource-constrained settings. These acquisitions may differ in orientation, alignment and anatomical coverage, resulting in partially overlapping image stacks. Existing learning-based super-resolution methods typically rely on single, under-constrained inputs or fixed multi-stack configurations with idealised acquisition geometry. We introduce MS-HVED, a sequence-agnostic framework for flexible multi-stack brain MRI super-resolution. Available axial, coronal and sagittal stacks are independently encoded into multi-scale Gaussian posteriors and fused using a field-of-view-aware Product-of-Gaussians formulation that limits contributions from unsupported regions. Physics-informed domain randomisation simulates heterogeneous clinical acquisition conditions, including obliqueness, partial coverage and imaging artefacts. MS-HVED achieved competitive or superior reconstruction fidelity across synthetic benchmarks and improved downstream tissue segmentation relative to low-resolution inputs. To assess generalisation beyond the training cohorts, we performed external clinical validation on 30 routine brain MRI examinations from a Nigerian cohort, representing an under-represented population in medical imaging research. These examinations formed the largest component of a blinded reader study involving 44 real cases and seven expert neuroradiologists. In the Nigerian cohort, MS-HVED was preferred over the supervised baseline for overall image quality in 187 of 210 paired assessments. Across all clinical cohorts, MS-HVED achieved higher overall-quality scores with all available inputs (5.93 vs. 4.49, p<.001), with the preference persisting when axial or coronal inputs were omitted (p<.001). Code at github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved
zh_abstract: 高分辨率脑MRI对神经影像学评估很重要，但常规临床方案常依赖快速各向异性2D采集，尤其是在资源受限环境中。这些采集可能在方向、对齐和解剖覆盖范围上不同，导致图像栈部分重叠。现有基于学习的超分辨率方法通常依赖单一、约束不足的输入，或依赖具有理想化采集几何的固定多栈配置。我们介绍MS-HVED，一种用于灵活多栈脑MRI超分辨率的序列无关框架。可用的轴位、冠状位和矢状位栈被独立编码为多尺度高斯后验，并使用视野感知的高斯乘积公式融合，该公式限制未支持区域的贡献。物理信息域随机化模拟异质临床采集条件，包括倾斜、部分覆盖和成像伪影。MS-HVED在合成基准上实现有竞争力或更优的重建保真度，并相对于低分辨率输入改善下游组织分割。为评估超出训练队列的泛化能力，我们对来自尼日利亚队列的30例常规脑MRI检查进行了外部临床验证，该队列代表医学影像研究中代表性不足的人群。这些检查构成一项盲法读者研究的最大组成部分，该研究涉及44例真实病例和7名专家神经放射科医师。在尼日利亚队列中，在210次配对评估中有187次在整体图像质量上更偏好MS-HVED而非监督基线。在所有临床队列中，MS-HVED在所有可用输入下获得更高的整体质量评分（5.93 vs. 4.49，p<.001），当省略轴位或冠状位输入时偏好仍然存在（p<.001）。代码见 github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved

title: A Visual Information Extraction System Using Multimodal Large Language Models for Scanned Cognitive and Behavioral Assessments
zh_title: 多模态大模型系统提取扫描版认知与行为评估表
summary: 提出模块化多模态大模型系统，从扫描版MMSE、MoCA、Mini-Cog及Vanderbilt量表提取字段与评分，认知评估端到端准确率88%。
key_points: 处理MMSE、MoCA、Mini-Cog与NICHQ Vanderbilt扫描量表
表单分类器加对应评分抽取器，输出结构化字段
双模型不一致时转人工，仅复核困难页
reason: 预印本系统工程，有端到端准确率与人机协作设计，但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Objective. Paper-based assessments are common in patient care, but handwriting and scanning artifacts make these forms difficult to process at scale. This study proposes a modular, multimodal LLM-based system with human oversight for extracting fields and scores. We conducted a qualitative analysis of the use of LLMs for hand-drawing analysis. Materials and Methods. The system processes cognitive assessments (i.e., MMSE, MoCA, Mini-Cog) and the NICHQ Vanderbilt Assessment using two modules: 1) a form classifier that assigns a scanned page to a form type, followed by a corresponding 2) score extractor that extracts fields and scores into a schema. A human-in-the-loop design utilizing dual-model validation engages human annotators when two LLMs disagree, limiting manual review to challenging pages only. Results. End-to-end accuracy for cognitive assessments was 88%, with most form types exceeding 90%. For the NICHQ Vanderbilt, overall accuracy reached 97.5%, with all form types above 96%. The human-in-the-loop design further improved cognitive assessment accuracy to 97.5% while reducing manual work by 63.8%. In the Mini-Cog Clock Drawing task, qualitative analysis showed that 62.3% of all extraction errors stemmed from ambiguous drawing, in which cases the LLM provided reasonable readings. Discussion. Compared to current manual data extraction, our LLM-based system reduces processing time by 10 to 20 times and costs by over 12 times. The modular design allows seamless expansion to additional form types. Conclusion. Our system provides an accurate, scalable, and cost-efficient solution for structuring data trapped in handwritten paper forms for clinical decision support.
zh_abstract: 【目的】纸质评估在患者照护中很常见，但手写和扫描伪影使这些表单难以大规模处理。本研究提出一种模块化、基于多模态LLM并带有人工监督的系统，用于提取字段和评分。我们对LLMs用于手绘图分析进行了定性分析。【材料与方法】该系统使用两个模块处理认知评估（即MMSE、MoCA、Mini-Cog）和NICHQ Vanderbilt评估：1）表单分类器，将扫描页面归入某种表单类型，随后由相应的2）评分提取器将字段和评分提取到模式中。采用双模型验证的人在回路设计，当两个LLMs不一致时引入人工标注者，从而将人工审核限制在具有挑战性的页面上。【结果】认知评估的端到端准确率为88%，大多数表单类型超过90%。对于NICHQ Vanderbilt，总体准确率达到97.5%，所有表单类型均高于96%。人在回路设计进一步将认知评估准确率提高到97.5%，同时将人工工作量减少63.8%。在Mini-Cog画钟任务中，定性分析显示，所有提取错误中有62.3%源于绘图歧义，在这些情况下LLM给出了合理的解读。【讨论】与当前人工数据提取相比，我们基于LLM的系统将处理时间减少10至20倍，成本降低超过12倍。模块化设计允许无缝扩展到其他表单类型。【结论】我们的系统提供了一种准确、可扩展且成本高效的解决方案，用于结构化困在手写纸质表单中的数据，以支持临床决策。

title: Not All Evidence Is Admissible: Evidence Governance for Tool-Augmented Medical Agents
zh_title: 工具增强医疗智能体的证据治理框架
summary: 指出医疗智能体默认采信工具输出会被“证据劫持”，提出将证据筛选与推理分离的治理框架。
key_points: 工具静默失败可把原本正确病例翻转为错误
用V-信息解释忽略权丧失带来的可用信息损失
按内容筛选证据才有效，而非单纯减少输入
reason: 预印本方法学与理论分析，有新意但无临床实证评估
abstract: Tool-augmented medical agents treat whatever their tools return as evidence. We show that this default is costly: medical tools fail silently, and a frozen reasoner cannot ignore what enters its context, so many cases it would have answered correctly are flipped to wrong once tool outputs are added. We call this evidence hijacking. $\mathcal{V}$-information explains the phenomenon: the reasoner has lost the option to ignore, so a tool output can carry negative usable information, and moving the decision of what to keep outside the reasoner restores that option. The theory further shows that part of any filtering gain comes merely from letting the reasoner see less, and only selection by content lets it see better. Building on this, we recast tool-augmented reasoning as evidence governance, which separates deciding what counts as evidence from the reasoner that answers, and propose context-independent evidence governance (CIEG), the first medical agent framework that rules, after acquisition, on whether each individual tool output may enter as evidence. Every tool output is written as a card that can be checked against the raw input; an independent checker that sees only the input and the cards decides which cards become evidence; and the reasoner answers from the admitted cards alone, with no training anywhere. On medical question answering, fundus glaucoma screening, and chest X-ray pneumonia classification, it achieves the highest accuracy among models of comparable scale, and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art tool-using agents and multi-agent systems built on the same backbone at lower cost.
zh_abstract: 工具增强的医疗智能体把工具返回的任何内容都当作证据。我们表明这种默认做法代价高昂：医疗工具会静默失败，而冻结的推理器无法忽略进入其上下文的内容，因此一旦加入工具输出，许多原本能正确回答的病例会被翻转为错误。我们将此称为证据劫持。V-信息解释了这一现象：推理器失去了忽略的选项，因此工具输出可能携带负的可用信息；将保留哪些内容的决策移到推理器之外可恢复该选项。该理论进一步表明，任何过滤增益的一部分仅仅来自让推理器看到更少内容，只有基于内容的选择才能让它看得更好。在此基础上，我们将工具增强推理重新表述为证据治理，即把决定什么算作证据与负责回答的推理器分离，并提出上下文无关的证据治理（CIEG），这是首个在获取之后裁定每个单独工具输出是否可作为证据进入的医疗智能体框架。每个工具输出都写成可对照原始输入进行检查的卡片；一个仅看到输入和卡片的独立检查器决定哪些卡片成为证据；推理器仅根据被接纳的卡片作答，且全程无需训练。在医学问答、眼底青光眼筛查和胸部X线肺炎分类上，它在同等规模模型中取得最高准确率，并以更低成本显著优于基于相同骨干网络的最先进工具使用智能体和多智能体系统。

title: SlideJev: Order-Stable and Tissue-Grounded Jev Decisions for Whole-Slide Pathology
zh_title: SlideJev：全切片病理的顺序稳定视觉问答
summary: 提出全切片病理VQA框架，分别用切片证据校验候选答案并降低对选项顺序与语言先验的依赖。
key_points: 针对VLM答案受选项顺序影响的问题
用支持与拒绝对数似然差给候选打分
并行评估候选并学习组织证据定位
reason: 病理VQA新方法预印本，问题定位清晰但证据范围有限
abstract: Whole-slide visual question answering (VQA) offers a natural-language interface to pathology, allowing diagnostic and phenotypic questions to be answered directly from tissue slides. However, current vision-language models (VLMs) rely heavily on linguistic priors: their answers are sensitive to the order of the candidate answers, and can be reached through shortcuts that bypass the tissue evidence. To address these challenges, we introduce SlideJev, a framework that separately verifies candidate answers against the slide and learns to ground these judgments in tissue evidence. To connect parallel candidate evaluation with visual evidence learning, we adopt Jev and score each candidate by the difference between support and rejection log-likelihoods from the original language-model head. We compute these scores in parallel using separate prompts with the same format and no option-position labels, then normalize them for answer selection. To ground these scores in tissue evidence, candidate-conditioned reading and comparison guide gated updates to visual tokens across decoder layers. With the backbone frozen, we train these visual modules through the same scores using question-answer and paired-image supervision. Across three whole-slide pathology VQA benchmarks, SlideJev achieves the highest mean overall accuracy and 100% answer consistency across four option orders. Image-control experiments further show that SlideJev achieves the largest average accuracy gains from correct images over mismatched and image-free inputs across the three datasets. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/leowu-ai/SlideJev.
zh_abstract: 全切片视觉问答（VQA）为病理学提供了自然语言接口，使诊断和表型问题可直接从组织切片得到回答。然而，当前视觉-语言模型（VLM）严重依赖语言先验：其答案对候选答案的顺序敏感，并可能通过绕过组织证据的捷径得出。为应对这些挑战，我们提出SlideJev，一个分别根据切片验证候选答案并学习将这些判断建立在组织证据上的框架。为将并行候选评估与视觉证据学习连接起来，我们采用Jev，并根据原始语言模型头给出的支持与拒绝对数似然之差为每个候选评分。我们使用格式相同且不含选项位置标签的独立提示并行计算这些分数，然后对其进行归一化以用于答案选择。为使这些分数建立在组织证据上，候选条件化的读取和比较引导跨解码器层对视觉token的门控更新。在骨干网络冻结的情况下，我们通过相同的分数，利用问答和配对图像监督训练这些视觉模块。在三个全切片病理VQA基准上，SlideJev取得最高平均总体准确率，并在四种选项顺序下达到100%答案一致性。图像控制实验进一步表明，在三个数据集上，SlideJev从正确图像相对于不匹配图像和无图像输入获得的平均准确率增益最大。我们的代码公开于 https://github.com/leowu-ai/SlideJev。

title: Compact and Decodable Electrocardiogram Text for Large Language Models
zh_title: 面向大语言模型的紧凑可解码心电文本编码
summary: 提出确定性心电编码：八个导联写作幅度字母与时间间隔，其余四个肢体导联代数恢复，兼顾词元预算与重建。
key_points: 26字母对数码本与10步容差调度
在PTB-XL共21388条记录上验证
以解码往返与波形重建误差评估
reason: 公开数据集上方法清晰、有重建评估，但属编码方案改进，值得一看
abstract: When a twelve-lead electrocardiogram is written as text for a large language model, the number of tokens has to be balanced against the information lost through compression. This paper presents a deterministic encoding that writes eight independent leads as amplitude letters and exact time gaps and recovers the remaining four limb leads algebraically. The key points are selected with a cardiac-cycle-dependent tolerance, the amplitudes are parameterized by a 26-letter logarithmic codebook learned from a training set, and a 10-step tolerance schedule keeps all records within a fixed token budget. The encoding was applied to 21,388 records from the public PTB-XL database and evaluated using an exact decode-and-re-encode round trip, waveform reconstruction error, and a paired comparison of convolutional classifiers trained with 5 different seeds on signals from the original and decoded databases. All records were contained in 4,080 tokens (average: 2,866 tokens, 64.3% fewer than a per-sample transcription), and all stored lead strings were exactly reproduced. The average correlation between the decoded and reference signals was 0.982. The macro-averaged area under the receiver operating characteristic curve was 0.9167 for the reference signals and 0.9157 for the decoded signals (paired difference -0.0010; 95% patient-level bootstrap interval, -0.0028 to 0.0007), within the pre-specified non-inferiority margin of -0.010; this is not a confirmatory result, because the test fold had been used during encoder development. The diagnostic content of a compact text can therefore be preserved, while the language model's ability to read the text is yet another matter.
zh_abstract: 当把十二导联心电图写成文本供大语言模型使用时，必须在 token 数量与压缩造成的信息损失之间取得平衡。本文提出一种确定性编码，将八个独立导联写为振幅字母和精确时间间隔，并通过代数方法恢复其余四个肢体导联。关键点依据心周期相关容差选取，振幅由从训练集学习得到的 26 字母对数码本参数化，10 步容差表使所有记录保持在固定 token 预算内。该编码应用于公共 PTB-XL 数据库的 21,388 条记录，并采用精确解码-再编码往返、波形重建误差，以及在原始数据库与解码数据库信号上以 5 个不同随机种子训练的卷积分类器的配对比较进行评估。所有记录均被容纳在 4,080 个 token 内（平均 2,866 个 token，比逐样本转录少 64.3%），且所有存储的导联字符串均被精确复现。解码信号与参考信号之间的平均相关系数为 0.982。宏平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积在参考信号为 0.9167，在解码信号为 0.9157（配对差值 -0.0010；95% 患者水平 bootstrap 区间 -0.0028 至 0.0007），处于预先设定的非劣效界值 -0.010 之内；这不是确证性结果，因为测试折在编码器开发期间已被使用。因此，紧凑文本的诊断内容可以得以保留，而语言模型读取该文本的能力则是另一回事。

title: RetiDual-Select: Reliability-Aware Specialist-Generalist Routing for Retinal OCT under Image-Quality Shift
zh_title: RetiDual-Select：图像质量变化下视网膜OCT的可靠性感知双分支路由
summary: 将视网膜专科模型RETFound与MedSigLIP图像编码器结合，提出可靠性感知的双分支路由与选择性复核框架。
key_points: 静态专家乘积融合在三套数据集的干净图像上达到最高或并列最高准确率
在2%错误率目标下，Kermany-4有94.3%图像被接受，选择性准确率99.89%
OCT-C8有92.4%被接受、98.65%选择性准确；两分支仅4.4%–6.2%图像一方正确
reason: 预印本方法有新意，比较充分，但主要是公开数据集内部评估，属值得一看档
abstract: Adaptive fusion can repair a static ensemble's errors, but can also overturn correct decisions. RetiDual-Select combines retinal specialist RETFound with the image encoder of the medical vision-language model MedSigLIP, separating candidate fusion, routing safety and predictive review. Calibrated product-of-experts (PoE) fusion is the static reference, a small gate proposes an alternative for each image, a validation-frozen harm guard decides whether that candidate may replace the reference, and a separate score prioritizes review. Static PoE reached the highest or joint-highest clean accuracy on all three datasets. At a clean 2% accepted-error target the review policy accepted 94.3% of Kermany-4 images at 99.89% selective accuracy, and 92.4% of OCT-C8 at 98.65%. Both branches were correct on 95.0% and 91.8% of clean images; only 4.4% and 6.2% had exactly one correct branch. Across 15 prespecified synthetic conditions, adaptive gains were concentrated in severe contrast reduction, where this routing opportunity widened roughly ninefold; percentile rescaling largely removed the effect, linking it to compressed dynamic range. In post-hoc validation-only analyses, gain was higher when the gate followed the more reliable branch, and a frozen guard cut the worst-condition OCT-C8 loss from 1.39 to 0.36 percentage points. Adaptive routing was useful when image quality created a reliability opportunity and the gate followed it; otherwise the system retained Static PoE or deferred for review. The findings are bounded by the synthetic perturbations evaluated and do not establish robustness to natural acquisition or scanner shift.
zh_abstract: 自适应融合可以修复静态集成模型的错误，但也可能推翻正确决策。RetiDual-Select 将视网膜专科模型 RETFound 与医学视觉-语言模型 MedSigLIP 的图像编码器相结合，分离候选融合、路由安全性和预测审查。校准的专家乘积（PoE）融合作为静态参考，一个小型门控为每张图像提出替代方案，一个在验证集上冻结的伤害防护器决定该候选是否可以替代参考，另一个独立分数用于确定审查优先级。静态 PoE 在全部三个数据集上达到最高或并列最高的干净准确率。在干净数据 2% 接受错误率目标下，审查策略接受了 Kermany-4 的 94.3% 图像，选择性准确率为 99.89%；接受了 OCT-C8 的 92.4%，选择性准确率为 98.65%。两个分支在 95.0% 和 91.8% 的干净图像上均正确；仅 4.4% 和 6.2% 的图像恰好只有一个分支正确。在 15 种预先设定的合成条件下，自适应增益集中在严重对比度降低的情形，此时该路由机会扩大约九倍；百分位重缩放基本消除了该效应，将其与压缩的动态范围联系起来。在仅验证集的事后分析中，当门控跟随更可靠的分支时增益更高，且冻结防护器将最差条件下 OCT-C8 的损失从 1.39 个百分点降至 0.36 个百分点。当图像质量创造出可靠性机会且门控跟随该机会时，自适应路由是有用的；否则系统保留静态 PoE 或推迟以供审查。这些发现受限于所评估的合成扰动，并不能确立对自然采集或扫描仪偏移的稳健性。

title: DAP-MR: Degradation-Aware Prompt-Magnitude Routing for Real-World Ultrasound Super-Resolution
zh_title: DAP-MR：超声超分辨率退化感知路由
summary: 针对真实超声超分辨率，提出退化感知提示-幅度路由DAP-MR，解耦退化类型与严重程度。
key_points: 不依赖通用语义文本提示
为每种退化类型设专用token并训练适配
避免单一提示纠缠退化类型与强度
reason: 预印本方法，聚焦超声图像复原但未见临床验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: When super-resolution models designed for natural images are used on ultrasound scans, relying on semantic text prompts can lead to unreliable results. The tags these models generate often do not match the actual restoration needs, and specialized medical terms may be misunderstood by general-purpose text encoders. Instead, prompts focused on common image degradations are more directly useful for guiding restoration. However, using a single prompt to describe both the type and severity of image degradation can entangle these factors, making it hard for the model to know how strong the degradation is. To address this limitation, we introduce Degradation-Aware Prompt--Magnitude Routing (DAP-MR). Each degradation type is represented by a dedicated token initialized from the contextualized EOS embedding of a degradation-oriented prompt and subsequently adapted during ultrasound SR training. A separate magnitude router predicts a continuous, input-dependent magnitude that modulates the corresponding token. Thus, language provides a degradation-aware initialization for what should be restored, while magnitude routing supplies an explicit signal for how strongly it should influence restoration. DAP-MR can be added to both one-step and multi-step diffusion super-resolution frameworks without changing their core structures. Our experiments--on synthetic datasets with both in-domain and under anatomical-domain shift, as well as unpaired real-world ultrasound data--show that DAP-MR delivers better restoration quality and generalizes more consistently across different domains.
zh_abstract: 当为自然图像设计的超分辨率模型用于超声扫描时，依赖语义文本提示可能导致不可靠的结果。这些模型生成的标签往往与实际恢复需求不匹配，且专业医学术语可能被通用文本编码器误解。相反，聚焦常见图像退化的提示更直接有助于引导恢复。然而，使用单一提示同时描述图像退化的类型和严重程度会使这些因素纠缠在一起，使模型难以知道退化有多强。为解决这一局限，我们提出退化感知提示—幅度路由（Degradation-Aware Prompt--Magnitude Routing, DAP-MR）。每种退化类型由专用 token 表示，该 token 从面向退化提示的上下文化 EOS 嵌入初始化，并在超声超分辨率（SR）训练期间随后进行适配。单独的幅度路由器预测连续的、依赖于输入的幅度，用于调制相应 token。因此，语言为应恢复什么提供了退化感知初始化，而幅度路由为应以多强程度影响恢复提供了显式信号。DAP-MR 可加入一步式和多步式扩散超分辨率框架，而无需改变其核心结构。我们在合成数据集（包括域内和存在解剖域偏移的情况）以及非配对真实超声数据上的实验表明，DAP-MR 提供更好的恢复质量，并在不同域之间更一致地泛化。

title: SRED: Sparse Regional Evidence Distillation Across Magnifications in Whole-Slide Imaging
zh_title: SRED：全切片跨放大稀疏区域证据蒸馏
summary: 提出SRED，在WSI分析中跨放大倍率蒸馏稀疏区域证据，无需切片级标签。
key_points: 用稀疏自编码器从20x教师特征学事件字典
逻辑或池化记录空间对齐区域的事件出现
迁移低倍输入可及的高层交互证据
reason: 预印本方法，面向计算病理计算效率，未见外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: In computational pathology, high-magnification whole-slide image analysis preserves tissue detail but requires encoding many patches, whereas lower magnification reduces computation by covering a higher field of view per patch while sacrificing detail. Existing cross-magnification distillation matches features that often encode detail unreachable by low-magnification input, sometimes requiring slide-level labels that limit scalability. To address those issues, we introduce Sparse Regional Evidence Distillation (SRED), which transfers regional event occurrences that encode reachable high-level interactions between details without slide-level labels. We use a sparse autoencoder (SAE) to learn an event dictionary from 20x teacher features. Logical OR pooling records whether each event is detected in any spatially aligned patch, retaining both localized and shared evidence within the corresponding 5x region. A pretrained 5x encoder is fine-tuned to predict these regional targets without slide-level labels. Visual analysis identifies dictionary components responsive to recognizable histological patterns, supporting target interpretation. Compared with native 5x features, SRED improves average macro-F1 by 1.1 points across seven classification and grading cohorts and average C-index by 1.7 points across five survival cohorts. Runtime matches native 5x, with an average 11.58x speedup over 20x.
zh_abstract: 在计算病理学中，高倍放大全切片图像分析可保留组织细节，但需要编码大量图像块；而较低放大倍数通过让每个图像块覆盖更大视野来减少计算，同时牺牲细节。现有的跨放大倍数蒸馏对齐的特征往往编码了低倍输入无法触及的细节，有时还需要切片级标签，从而限制了可扩展性。为解决这些问题，我们提出稀疏区域证据蒸馏（Sparse Regional Evidence Distillation，SRED），它迁移区域事件发生情况，这些事件编码了细节之间可触及的高层交互，且无需切片级标签。我们使用稀疏自编码器（sparse autoencoder，SAE）从20x教师特征中学习事件字典。逻辑或池化记录每个事件是否在任一空间对齐的图像块中被检测到，从而在相应的5x区域内同时保留局部证据和共享证据。预训练的5x编码器经过微调，以在无需切片级标签的情况下预测这些区域目标。视觉分析识别出对可识别组织学模式有响应的字典成分，支持目标解释。与原生5x特征相比，SRED在七个分类和分级队列中将平均macro-F1提高1.1个点，在五个生存队列中将平均C-index提高1.7个点。运行时间与原生5x相当，相较20x平均加速11.58倍。

title: Deep learning denoising and deep learning-augmented contrast enhancement improve ultra-high-resolution photon-counting-detector CCTA image quality.
zh_title: 深度学习去噪与增强改善超高分辨率光子计数CCTA图像质量
summary: 回顾性分析25例冠心病患者，评估深度学习去噪与碘对比增强对超高分辨率光子计数探测器CCTA图像质量的影响。
key_points: 25例患者回顾性分析，0.2 mm层厚重重建
三位放射科医师5分法主观评分
客观指标含SNR、CNR，样本量小且无外部验证
reason: 单中心小样本（25例）回顾性影像质量研究，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [European radiology experimental] Ultrahigh-resolution (UHR) coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) using a photon-counting detector (PCD) provides excellent spatial resolution but is limited by increased image noise. We evaluated whether deep learning (DL)-based denoising and contrast enhancement can further improve UHR-CCTA image quality. UHR-CCTA scans from 25 patients with coronary artery disease were retrospectively analyzed. Images were reconstructed at 0.2-mm slice thickness without and with quantum iterative reconstruction (QIR, Qoff-Q4), and subsequently processed using a DL tool for denoising and increasing iodine contrast enhancement. Subjective image quality (sharpness, noise, vessel wall delineation, and overall quality) was assessed by three radiologists using a 5-point Likert scale. Objective analysis included signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), and coronary wall sharpness. Differences between image sets were analyzed using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. DL-based CCTA demonstrated significantly superior subjective image quality across all parameters compared to standard reconstructions, with an overall median image quality ([interquartile interval, IQR]: 4 [3-5] versus 2 [2-3], p < 0.001). SNR and CNR were significantly higher for DL-based CCTA across all QIR levels (all p < 0.001). The highest values were observed for DL-based CCTAQ4 versus UHR-CCTAQ4 (SNR: 258.0 ± 147.5 versus 145.2 ± 50.1; CNR: 25.8 ± 17.1 versus 11.1 ± 4.5; both p < 0.001). Coronary wall sharpness was improved for DL-based CCTA for Q1-4 (all p < 0.027). DL-based denoising and iodine contrast enhancement effectively reduce noise and improve anatomic detail in UHR-CCTA, providing incremental value beyond vendor-specific reconstruction, particularly at high QIR strength levels. Question Deep learning reduces noise and enhances contrast in ultrahigh-resolution coronary CT angiography. Findings Image quality improves beyond standard iterative reconstruction methods, and vessel wall sharpness and diagnostic clarity significantly increase. Relevance statement This study aimed to determine at which levels of vendor-specific iterative reconstruction, DL-based denoising and contrast enhancement perform best in UHR CCTA, providing a foundation for future investigations on how these technical improvements may translate into diagnostic benefits.
zh_abstract: ［European Radiology Experimental］使用光子计数探测器（PCD）的超高分辨率（UHR）冠状动脉计算机断层摄影血管造影（CCTA）具有出色的空间分辨率，但受图像噪声增加的限制。我们评估了基于深度学习（DL）的去噪和对比度增强能否进一步改善 UHR-CCTA 图像质量。回顾性分析了 25 例冠状动脉疾病患者的 UHR-CCTA 扫描。图像以 0.2 mm 层厚在无和有量子迭代重建（QIR，Qoff-Q4）条件下重建，随后使用 DL 工具进行去噪和增强碘对比度。主观图像质量（锐利度、噪声、血管壁勾画和整体质量）由三名放射科医师使用 5 点 Likert 量表评估。客观分析包括信噪比（SNR）、对比噪声比（CNR）和冠状动脉壁锐利度。图像集之间的差异使用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验分析。与标准重建相比，基于 DL 的 CCTA 在所有参数上均显示出显著更优的主观图像质量，总体中位图像质量（［四分位间距，IQR］：4 ［3-5］对 2 ［2-3］，p < 0.001）。在所有 QIR 水平上，基于 DL 的 CCTA 的 SNR 和 CNR 均显著更高（均 p < 0.001）。最高值见于基于 DL 的 CCTA Q4 与 UHR-CCTA Q4 相比（SNR：258.0 ± 147.5 对 145.2 ± 50.1；CNR：25.8 ± 17.1 对 11.1 ± 4.5；均 p < 0.001）。对于 Q1-4，基于 DL 的 CCTA 的冠状动脉壁锐利度得到改善（均 p < 0.027）。基于 DL 的去噪和碘对比度增强可有效降低 UHR-CCTA 中的噪声并改善解剖细节，提供超越厂商特定重建的增量价值，尤其是在高 QIR 强度水平下。【问题】深度学习可降低超高分辨率冠状动脉 CT 血管造影中的噪声并增强对比度。【发现】图像质量超越标准迭代重建方法得到改善，血管壁锐利度和诊断清晰度显著提高。【相关性声明】本研究旨在确定在厂商特定迭代重建的哪些水平下，基于 DL 的去噪和对比度增强在 UHR CCTA 中表现最佳，为未来研究这些技术改进如何转化为诊断获益奠定基础。

title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare
zh_title: InclusionMed：面向包容性医疗的AI评测基准
summary: 开放医疗AI评测倡议，从388个候选基准中审核复现选出4个，并加入自建诊断推理基准，评测前沿大模型。
key_points: Atlas覆盖3种医疗角色×3种AI能力
首批5个基准含自建DxFiles
前沿模型指数得分17.5至49.1
reason: 开放基准有新意，覆盖有限、仅三格；预印本未经同行评审
abstract: Advancing medical AI for inclusive healthcare requires evaluation across diverse healthcare roles, tasks, and care settings, but benchmark coverage remains uneven. We introduce InclusionMed, an open medical AI evaluation initiative for inclusive healthcare. The InclusionMed Atlas organizes benchmarks across three healthcare roles and three AI capabilities. For the first release, we selected four public benchmarks from 388 candidates through structured audits and independent reproduction. With InclusionMed-DxFiles, our private diagnostic reasoning benchmark, the Atlas contains five benchmarks covering three of its nine role--capability cells. We evaluated frontier large language models on the Atlas and aggregated their results into the InclusionMed Index, with overall scores ranging from 17.5 to 49.1 out of 100. The Index also reports scores by healthcare role and AI capability, showing that a model's rank varied with the role or capability considered. A within-benchmark analysis using task-level tags showed that the ten highest-ranked models in the Index all scored higher on patient communication than on clinical decision-making. Models with similar Index scores also differed substantially in estimated inference cost. These findings highlight the need for evaluation covering more diverse healthcare needs and for context-specific model selection. Through open collaboration and community contributions, InclusionMed seeks to ensure that diverse healthcare needs worldwide shape how medical AI progress is defined and measured.
zh_abstract: 推进面向包容性医疗的医疗AI需要在多样化的医疗角色、任务和照护环境中进行评估，但基准覆盖仍不均衡。我们提出InclusionMed，这是一个面向包容性医疗的开放式医疗AI评估倡议。InclusionMed Atlas将基准按三类医疗角色和三类AI能力进行组织。首个发布版中，我们通过结构化审核和独立复现，从388个候选基准中选择了四个公开基准。加上我们的私有诊断推理基准InclusionMed-DxFiles，Atlas包含五个基准，覆盖其九个角色—能力单元中的三个。我们在Atlas上评估了前沿大语言模型，并将其结果汇总为InclusionMed指数，总分范围为100分中的17.5至49.1分。该指数还按医疗角色和AI能力报告分数，显示模型的排名会随所考虑的角色或能力而变化。使用任务级标签的基准内分析显示，指数中排名前十的模型在患者沟通上的得分均高于临床决策。指数分数相似的模型在估计推理成本上也存在显著差异。这些发现凸显了需要覆盖更多样化医疗需求的评估，以及针对具体情境的模型选择。通过开放协作和社区贡献，InclusionMed力求确保全球多样化的医疗需求能够塑造医疗AI进展的定义和衡量方式。

title: Towards wearable-scale, transition-aware sleep staging for clinical populations
zh_title: 面向临床人群的可穿戴尺度睡眠分期
summary: 提出教师-学生框架：用25%患者标签微调的SleepGPT监督轻量CNN-GRU，实现跨临床队列的可穿戴睡眠分期。
key_points: 卒中、iRBD等三队列觉醒频率为健康人2-3倍
136M教师模型用25%训练患者标签适配
31k参数学生模型支持EEG/EOG实时分期
reason: 方法有新意且面向临床人群，但仅患者内交叉验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Automatic sleep staging models are predominantly developed on healthy sleepers and generalize poorly to clinical populations with fragmented sleep. Across three cohorts (patients with stroke, isolated REM sleep behaviour disorder, and other sleep disorders), we observe 2-3x more awakenings per hour, nearly twice as much N1, and less REM sleep than in healthy sleepers. We propose a label-efficient teacher-student framework for wearable-scale sleep staging. SleepGPT (136M parameters), adapted using labels from 25% of training patients, supervises a causal CNN-GRU (31k parameters; 122 KB) that stages EEG, EOG, or both in real time. We introduce Gcv-TAD, a new black-box transition-aware distillation loss. It emphasizes uncommon stage transitions while discounting those that vary across patients, using a prior estimated from labelled patients. In patient-wise 10-fold cross-validation, Gcv-TAD improves per-patient macro F1 over supervised training on the same labels by +3.2 to +7.6 points on average. Gains are largest on N1, and performance approaches full-label training.
zh_abstract: 自动睡眠分期模型主要在健康睡眠者上开发，对睡眠碎片化的临床人群泛化能力差。在三个队列（卒中、孤立性REM睡眠行为障碍和其他睡眠障碍患者）中，我们观察到每小时觉醒次数比健康睡眠者多2–3倍，N1睡眠几乎多一倍，REM睡眠更少。我们提出一种标签高效的教师-学生框架，用于可穿戴规模睡眠分期。SleepGPT（136M参数）使用25%训练患者的标签进行适配，监督一个因果CNN-GRU（31k参数；122 KB），实时对EEG、EOG或两者进行分期。我们提出Gcv-TAD，一种新的黑盒过渡感知蒸馏损失。它强调不常见的睡眠阶段转换，同时降低那些在患者间存在差异的转换的权重，所用先验由有标签患者估计。在按患者划分的10折交叉验证中，Gcv-TAD相较于在相同标签上进行监督训练，将每位患者的宏平均F1平均提高+3.2至+7.6个百分点。增益在N1上最大，性能接近全标签训练。

title: Validating LLM-Based Essay Scorers: A Comparative Analysis in Critical Online Reasoning in Medical Education
zh_title: 医学教育中LLM作文评分器的验证比较
summary: 在医学教育写作任务上比较11个自动评分系统与8个大语言模型相对人工评分的表现。
key_points: 评估668份学生作答、12项任务与2076条评价
考察通用大模型是否可替代领域微调模型
讨论自动评分辅助或替代人工标注的可行性
reason: 医学教育场景实证比较，样本中等、为预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Automated essay scorers (AES) based on large language models (LLMs) promise human-level accuracy. However, training, fine-tuning, and evaluating LLMs for specific assessment tasks is costly. In particular, the question arises whether these AES should be trained for specific domains or whether models based on generic LLMs might be sufficient. Human annotations, by contrast, are often more valid but far more expensive. This study evaluates whether ensembles of AES systems based on general-purpose LLMs can approximate human ratings of medical-education writing tasks by leveraging encoded linguistic and conceptual knowledge. The goal is to assess whether general-purpose models are applicable for assisting or potentially replacing human annotation in this domain. We experiment with 11 AES systems and 8 different LLMs and evaluate 668 student responses to 12 tasks, using \numprint{2076} evaluations by 7 human annotators. These ratings are aggregated to create consistent performance levels that can be used as target classes for classifiers trained on AES outputs. Our results show that learner classes based on human ratings can be accurately reconstructed using a linear SVM trained on a small set of AES features. A single classifier generalized well across tasks and domains, with reasoning and content features being most predictive. This suggests that out-of-the-box LLMs, even without domain-specific fine-tuning, can support automatic essay grading in medical education. While individual AES systems are insufficient alone, their combination approximates human evaluators, pointing to a reduced need for manual scoring or its supplementation with automated methods.
zh_abstract: 基于大语言模型（large language models，LLMs）的自动作文评分器（automated essay scorers，AES）有望达到人类水平的准确率。然而，针对特定评估任务训练、微调和评估 LLMs 成本高昂。特别是，问题在于这些 AES 应针对特定领域进行训练，还是基于通用 LLMs 的模型可能已经足够。相比之下，人工标注通常更有效，但成本高得多。本研究评估基于通用 LLMs 的 AES 系统集成能否通过利用其编码的语言和概念知识，近似医学教育写作任务的人工评分。目标是评估通用模型是否适用于在该领域辅助或可能替代人工标注。我们实验了11个 AES 系统和8个不同的 LLMs，评估668名学生对12项任务的回答，使用7名人工标注者进行的2,076次评估。将这些评分聚合以创建一致的性能水平，可用作在 AES 输出上训练的分类器的目标类别。我们的结果表明，基于人工评分的学习者类别可以通过在少量 AES 特征上训练的线性 SVM 准确重建。单个分类器在任务和领域之间泛化良好，其中推理和内容特征最具预测性。这表明，即用型 LLMs 即使没有领域特定微调，也可以支持医学教育中的自动作文评分。虽然单个 AES 系统单独使用不足，但它们的组合可近似人类评估者，表明对人工评分的需求减少，或可用自动化方法对其进行补充。

title: Scribble Once, Segment the Sequence: Bidirectional Temporal Consistency for Weakly Supervised Segmentation in Echocardiography Sequences
zh_title: 单次涂鸦标注的超声心动图序列弱监督分割
summary: 提出基于冻结二维视觉基础模型的弱监督框架，利用双向时序一致性从单帧涂鸦标注分割超声心动图序列。
key_points: 每段序列仅需一帧涂鸦标注，降低时序标注成本
冻结2D基础模型提供空间先验，补充双向时序一致性
目标是缓解稀疏监督带来的时序不稳定
reason: 方法有新意且切中标注成本问题，但预印本、验证信息有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Temporal medical image segmentation relies on pixel-wise annotations, which are prohibitively expensive for long image sequences. Existing weakly-supervised methods reduce the annotation burden per frame but still require repeated annotations across the sequence. Furthermore, sparse supervision can result in temporally unstable representations. Addressing both challenges requires a model that can leverage strong spatial priors from large-scale pretraining while minimizing reliance on dense annotations. Frozen 2D vision foundation models provide a promising basis for this by offering transferable spatial representations with low trainable parameters. However, their lack of explicit temporal modeling limits their ability to propagate reliable information across anatomical sequences. To address this, we present a weakly-supervised framework for temporal segmentation from a single scribble-annotated frame, with all remaining frames left unlabeled. The framework combines parameter-efficient adaptation of DINOv3 encoders present in the mean-teacher architecture. Furthermore, a set of complementary losses, including a temporal loss helps generate reliable segmentation priors for the unlabeled frames. This formulation decouples annotation costs from sequence length while retaining the transferable spatial knowledge of the pretrained encoder. Extensive experiments on the publicly available CAMUS and CardiacNet datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms other scribble-supervised methods. These results show that accurate and temporally consistent segmentation can be achieved from extremely sparse supervision, substantially reducing annotation requirements for temporal echocardiographic segmentation and providing a practical framework for scalable clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: 时序医学图像分割依赖逐像素标注，而对于长图像序列，这种标注成本高得令人难以承受。现有弱监督方法减轻了每帧的标注负担，但仍需要在序列中重复标注。此外，稀疏监督可能导致表示在时间上不稳定。应对这两个挑战需要一种模型，既能利用大规模预训练带来的强空间先验，又能尽量减少对密集标注的依赖。冻结的二维视觉基础模型通过以较低的可训练参数量提供可迁移的空间表示，为此提供了有前景的基础。然而，它们缺乏显式时序建模，限制了其在解剖序列中传播可靠信息的能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种弱监督框架，仅从单个涂鸦标注帧进行时序分割，其余所有帧均不标注。该框架结合了均值教师架构中 DINOv3 编码器的参数高效适配。此外，一组互补损失（包括时序损失）有助于为未标注帧生成可靠的分割先验。该公式将标注成本与序列长度解耦，同时保留预训练编码器的可迁移空间知识。在公开可用的 CAMUS 和 CardiacNet 数据集上进行的大量实验表明，我们的方法优于其他涂鸦监督方法。这些结果表明，从极其稀疏的监督中即可实现准确且时间一致的分割，大幅降低时序超声心动图分割的标注需求，并为可扩展的临床部署提供实用框架。

title: MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding
zh_title: MedJev：单次前向的医学视觉语言决策模型
summary: 提出MedJev，将医学图像、问题与候选答案在一次多模态前向中直接映射为决策，省去自回归生成文本的推理开销。
key_points: 去除上层语言层与生成输出通路，保留完整视觉通路与视觉token
决策头用预训练查询-键匹配对候选答案打分并轻量精修
目标是避免自由文本解析带来的延迟与决策错误
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，效率导向明确，但摘要未示外部验证与开源，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens. These unnecessary tokens make the inference cost scale with the response length and force the answer to be parsed from free-form text, incurring avoidable latency and decision errors. To this end, we introduce \textsc{MedJev}, a \emph{system one} vision-language decision model that maps medical images, questions, and candidate answers directly to decisions in a single multimodal forward pass, without any autoregressive generation process. For fast inference, \textsc{MedJev} removes the upper language layers and the generative output pathway, while keeping the full vision pathway and all visual tokens. On this shortened backbone, a decision head scores each candidate by pretrained query--key matching and refines the scores with a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP) residual, coupling the pretrained matching structure with task-specific nonlinear discrimination. Built on Qwen3.5-4B, \textsc{MedJev}-4B improves both accuracy and speed over the original model on each of four medical image classification and visual question answering benchmarks, with an absolute accuracy gain of \textbf{7.93\%} and a \textbf{6.04$\times$} end-to-end speedup. Further comparison with 20 cutting-edge models shows that \textsc{MedJev}-4B achieves state-of-the-art performance and inference speed among 4B--9B general and medical VLMs, indicating that direct multimodal decision making is an effective route to fast and effective medical image understanding.
zh_abstract: 使用视觉语言模型（vision-language models，VLMs）进行医学图像理解通常依赖自回归生成推理和答案词元。这些不必要的词元使推理成本随响应长度增长，并迫使从自由形式文本中解析答案，带来可避免的延迟和决策错误。为此，我们提出MedJev，一种系统1（system one）视觉语言决策模型，它在单次多模态前向传播中直接将医学图像、问题和候选答案映射为决策，无需任何自回归生成过程。为实现快速推理，MedJev移除了上层语言层和生成式输出通路，同时保留完整视觉通路和所有视觉词元。在这个缩短的骨干网络上，决策头通过预训练查询-键匹配对每个候选答案打分，并用轻量级多层感知机（multilayer perceptron，MLP）残差细化分数，将预训练匹配结构与任务特定非线性判别相结合。MedJev-4B构建于Qwen3.5-4B之上，在四个医学图像分类和视觉问答基准中的每一个上，相较原始模型同时提高了准确率和速度，绝对准确率提升7.93%，端到端加速6.04×。进一步与20个前沿模型比较表明，MedJev-4B在4B–9B通用和医学VLM中实现了最先进的性能和推理速度，表明直接多模态决策是实现快速有效医学图像理解的有效途径。

title: Medical question answering collapses in Hausa: a pre-registered pilot on three small open models
zh_title: 豪萨语医学问答性能大幅下降：预注册小样本试验
summary: 在配对英-豪萨语MedMCQA题集上，三个3–4B小模型准确率显著下降，回译可部分恢复差距。
key_points: 无读题基线在豪萨语医学多选题上即胜过多个小模型
三个指令微调模型准确率落差经Holm校正后均显著
回译英文可挽回约一半至三分之二的差距，医学适配模型不确定
reason: 预注册设计有新意，但仅三个小模型、试点规模，属值得一看档
abstract: A system that reads nothing and always answers the most frequent letter scores \BaselineP{} on our Hausa medical multiple-choice set. \NBelowBaseline{} of the \NModels{} small open models we evaluate do not beat it. We lead with that because the usual summary of a multilingual result -- a percentage-point drop from English -- does not say whether what survives the drop is performance at all. On a paired English--Hausa set of \NEval{} MedMCQA items, three instruction-tuned models of 3--4B parameters lose between \GapMedGemma{} and \GapQwen{} points of accuracy, every gap significant after Holm correction. Back-translating the Hausa items into English recovers between half and two-thirds of the gap for the two general-purpose models but not demonstrably for the medically adapted one, so the deficit is substantially, though not wholly, a matter of the language of presentation. Answers are also far less stable: agreement across three option orderings falls from \ConsEnQwen{} to \ConsHaQwen{} in the worst case. An exploratory error analysis of \ENRows{} discordant items attributes most of the damage to medical vocabulary lost in translation (\ETerm{}, 95\% CI \ETermLo{}--\ETermHi{}), usually in the question stem. A fourth registered hypothesis proposed closing the gap with self-generated preference pairs. Its pilot gate found nothing to train on: asked to reason in Hausa rather than to pick a letter, the model echoes the prompt back, switches into Swahili, or simply stops without answering; only \GateParse{} of chains are parseable. We report that intervention as not run, which is itself the sharper result -- a forced-choice benchmark cannot see a model that has no generative command of the language at all. All hypotheses, thresholds and decision rules were registered before any model was run, and all deviations are logged.
zh_abstract: 一个什么也不读、总是回答最常见字母的系统，在我们的豪萨语（Hausa）医学多项选择题集上得分为 \BaselineP{}。我们评估的 \NModels{} 个小型开放模型中，有 \NBelowBaseline{} 个未能超过它。我们首先报告这一点，是因为多语言结果的通常总结——即相对英语的百分点下降——并不能说明下降后留存下来的到底是否还是性能。在一个由 \NEval{} 个 MedMCQA 条目组成的英—豪萨语配对集上，三个参数规模为 3--4B 的指令微调模型准确率下降 \GapMedGemma{} 到 \GapQwen{} 分，每个差距在 Holm 校正后均显著。将豪萨语条目回译成英语后，两个通用模型可恢复该差距的一半到三分之二，但医学适配模型未能明显恢复，因此这一缺陷在很大程度上、但并非完全，是呈现语言的问题。答案也远不稳定：在最坏情况下，跨三种选项排序的一致性从 \ConsEnQwen{} 降至 \ConsHaQwen{}。对 \ENRows{} 个不一致条目的探索性错误分析将大部分损害归因于翻译中丢失的医学词汇（\ETerm{}，95% CI \ETermLo{}--\ETermHi{}），通常位于题干中。第四个注册假设提出用自生成偏好对来弥合差距。其试点门槛没有发现可训练的内容：当要求用豪萨语推理而不是选择一个字母时，模型会把提示原样回显、切换到斯瓦希里语（Swahili），或干脆停止不作答；只有 \GateParse{} 的推理链可解析。我们将该干预报告为未运行，而这本身就是更尖锐的结果——一个强制选择基准无法看见一个对该语言完全没有生成能力的模型。所有假设、阈值和决策规则均在任何模型运行之前注册，所有偏离均已记录。

title: EEGProbe: Do Vision-Language Models Really Understand EEG? A Benchmark for Signal-Grounded EEG Signals Evaluation
zh_title: EEGProbe：视觉语言模型能否真正理解脑电信号的基准
summary: 发布EEGProbe基准，含620道题、13个子任务，评估通用视觉语言模型对原始通道级脑电的提取与推理能力。
key_points: 覆盖脑电分类、跨模态对齐与神经生理推理三类能力
保留时间结构、减少基准引入的处理并做信号必要性检验
评测11个开源与闭源代表性视觉语言模型
reason: 新公开评测基准且含专家核验，但规模仅620题、尚无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal capabilities across scientific and biomedical domains, yet their ability to understand electroencephalography (EEG) signals remains unclear. We introduce EEGProbe, a signal-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether general-purpose VLMs can extract and reason from minimally processed, channel-wise EEG without task-specific feature engineering or EEG-specific adaptation. EEGProbe contains 620 EEG-centered questions across 13 subtasks and three capability categories: EEG Signal Classification, EEG Cross-modal Alignment, and EEG Neurophysiological Reasoning. To reduce shortcut-based answering, EEGProbe preserves the temporal structure of the recordings where possible, minimizes benchmark-induced processing, and applies signal-necessity testing followed by expert verification. We evaluate 11 representative open- and closed-source VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The strongest model, GPT-5.6 Sol, achieves an overall score of only 41.63\%, with cross-modal EEG alignment emerging as a major bottleneck. We further examine model behavior from a neurophysiological perspective and analyze how temporal, spectral, spatial, and physiological EEG structure relates to model successes and failures. Inference-time neurophysiological guidance can reshape model predictions by helping models recognize the neurophysiological patterns present in the input and connect them with relevant neurological knowledge, narrowing the gap between general multimodal competence and EEG understanding. EEGProbe provides a testbed for current VLMs and a basis for developing future multimodal models that can interpret EEG evidence more reliably. The EEGProbe benchmark will be publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/2122ZHU/EEGProbe.
zh_abstract: 视觉语言模型（Vision-language models, VLMs）已在科学和生物医学领域展现出强大的多模态能力，但它们理解脑电图（electroencephalography, EEG）信号的能力仍不清楚。我们提出 EEGProbe，一个以信号为基础的基准，用于评估通用 VLMs 是否能够在没有任务特定特征工程或 EEG 特定适配的情况下，从经过最小处理、按通道组织的 EEG 中提取信息并进行推理。EEGProbe 包含 620 个以 EEG 为中心的问题，覆盖 13 个子任务和三个能力类别：EEG 信号分类（EEG Signal Classification）、EEG 跨模态对齐（EEG Cross-modal Alignment）和 EEG 神经生理学推理（EEG Neurophysiological Reasoning）。为减少基于捷径的回答，EEGProbe 尽可能保留记录的时间结构，最小化基准诱导的处理，并应用信号必要性测试，随后进行专家核验。我们在统一的零样本协议下评估了 11 个具有代表性的开源和闭源 VLMs。最强的模型 GPT-5.6 Sol 仅取得 41.63% 的总分，EEG 跨模态对齐成为主要瓶颈。我们进一步从神经生理学视角考察模型行为，并分析 EEG 的时间、频谱、空间和生理结构如何与模型的成功和失败相关。推理时的神经生理学引导可以通过帮助模型识别输入中存在的神经生理学模式，并将其与相关神经学知识联系起来，从而重塑模型预测，缩小一般多模态能力与 EEG 理解之间的差距。EEGProbe 为当前 VLMs 提供了测试平台，并为开发能够更可靠地解释 EEG 证据的未来多模态模型提供了基础。EEGProbe 基准将在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/2122ZHU/EEGProbe 公开提供。

title: Multimodal LLM for Breast Cancer Radiotherapy Target Auto-Contouring and Planning
zh_title: 多模态大模型用于乳腺癌放疗靶区自动勾画与计划
summary: ClinicalTrials.gov 新注册一项计划纳入5.1万例的观察性研究，评估多模态大模型用于乳腺癌放疗靶区勾画与计划。

计划样本量5.1万例
目标为靶区自动勾画与计划设计

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Xiaohui Zhao; conditions: Breast Cancer, Radiotherapy; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 51000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Breast cancer remains the most prevalent malignancy among women worldwide, with a continuously increasing incidence. As a crucial component of comprehensive cancer treatment, radiotherapy plays a key role in reducing local recurrence rates and improving overall survival outcomes. However, traditional radiotherapy target volume contouring and treatment planning design rely heavily on clinician expertise, presenting challenges such as prolonged processing time, significant inter-observer variability, and high subjectivity in dose optimization. Although artificial intelligence has made substantial progress in automated contouring and planning, conventional single-modal models still face major limitations. These models struggle to effectively integrate clinical text, tumor biological characteristics, and dose distribution factors, resulting in restricted generalizability. Therefore, developing an intelligent radiotherapy assistance system capable of multimodal data fusion is of high clinical significance to enhance precision and efficiency in breast cancer radiotherapy. This study aims to develop an innovative breast cancer radiotherapy assistance system based on a multimodal large language model. By integrating multimodal imaging data (including CT, MRI, and ultrasound), pathology reports, and structured electronic health record text, the system realizes end-to-end intelligence from target volume contouring to treatment plan generation. Employing a multicenter, ambidirectional cohort design, the study collects comprehensive clinical data from breast cancer patients who have undergone breast-conserving surgery or mastectomy. Technologically, the system innovatively combines the natural language processing capabilities of large language models with the image analysis strengths of deep learning, utilizing attention mechanisms to achieve deep fusion and interactive comprehension of heterogeneous medical data. Notably, the system breaks through traditional radiotherapy planning workflows by jointly optimizing target contouring and dose planning as a unified pipeline, applying reinforcement learning algorithms to dynamically balance target volume coverage with organ-at-risk protection. The outcomes of this study will provide an important paradigm for the clinical application of AI in radiation oncology and advance the field of precision radiotherapy.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Xiaohui Zhao；疾病：乳腺癌、放疗；类型：观察性；入组人数：51000；状态：尚未招募] 乳腺癌仍是全球女性中最常见的恶性肿瘤，发病率持续上升。作为综合癌症治疗的关键组成部分，放疗在降低局部复发率和改善总生存结局方面发挥重要作用。然而，传统放疗靶区勾画和治疗计划设计严重依赖临床医生专业知识，存在处理时间延长、观察者间差异显著以及剂量优化高度主观等挑战。尽管人工智能在自动勾画和计划方面取得了实质性进展，但传统单模态模型仍面临重大局限。这些模型难以有效整合临床文本、肿瘤生物学特征和剂量分布因素，导致泛化能力受限。因此，开发能够融合多模态数据的智能放疗辅助系统，对于提高乳腺癌放疗的精准性和效率具有重要临床意义。本研究旨在开发一种基于多模态大型语言模型的创新乳腺癌放疗辅助系统。通过整合多模态影像数据（包括 CT、MRI 和超声）、病理报告和结构化电子健康记录文本，该系统实现从靶区勾画到治疗计划生成的端到端智能化。研究采用多中心、双向性队列设计，收集接受保乳手术或乳房切除术的乳腺癌患者的综合临床数据。在技术上，该系统创新性地结合大型语言模型的自然语言处理能力与深度学习的图像分析优势，利用注意力机制实现异构医学数据的深度融合与交互理解。值得注意的是，该系统突破传统放疗计划工作流程，将靶区勾画和剂量计划作为一个统一流程联合优化，应用强化学习算法动态平衡靶区覆盖与危及器官保护。本研究结果将为人工智能在放射肿瘤学中的临床应用提供重要范式，并推动精准放疗领域发展。

title: AI-Based Anatomy Recognition in Minimally Invasive Kidney Surgery
zh_title: AI解剖识别用于微创上尿路手术的注册研究
summary: 解放军总医院注册1700例观察性研究，评估AI软件在微创上尿路手术中辅助识别解剖结构。
key_points: 观察性研究，计划入组1700例
尚未开始招募，无结果
评估AI辅助识别关键解剖结构
reason: 仅有试验注册信息、无任何结果，样本量尚可，属增量档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Chinese PLA General Hospital; conditions: Kidney (Renal Cell) Cancer, Ureteropelvic Junction Obstruction, Upper Urinary Tract Carcinoma; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 1700; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study aims to evaluate whether an artificial intelligence (AI) based software system can assist surgeons in identifying key anatomical structures during minimally invasive upper urinary tract surgery. During these procedures, surgeons operate while viewing images from laparoscopic endoscope. Key anatomical structures, such as the kidney, renal artery and vein, ureter, renal pelvis, inferior vena cava, and left reproductive vein, as well as surgical targets such as tumors, may sometimes be difficult to distinguish because of bleeding, surgical smoke, tissue movement, changes in tissue appearance, or obstruction by surgical instruments. The study team has developed an AI-based image recognition system that analyzes surgical video in real time and identifies and outlines relevant anatomical structures on the screen during surgery. The study has two main goals (primary endpoints): 1. To evaluate how accurately the AI system can identify and delineate key anatomical structures in surgical videos collected from different hospitals, surgeons, surgical procedures, and imaging systems. 2. To evaluate the real-time performance and technical reliability of the AI system in the operating room, including processing latency, frame rate, system failure rate, and the proportion of time during surgery in which AI-generated results are successfully displayed. The study will include adults aged 18 years or older who undergo one of five types of minimally invasive upper urinary tract surgery: partial nephrectomy, radical nephrectomy, radical nephroureterectomy, inferior vena cava tumor thrombectomy, or pyeloplasty. The study will be conducted at 11 hospitals in China. In the first phase, surgical videos recorded between 2015 and 2025 will be used to develop, validate, and test the AI system. In the second phase, approximately 100 patients will be prospectively enrolled from internal centers, and the AI-generated anatomical recognition results will be displayed on a monitor during surgery. Overall, approximately 1,600 retrospective surgical cases and 100 prospective cases are planned for inclusion. The AI system is designed solely as an assistive tool for anatomical recognition. It does not make clinical decisions, provide autonomous surgical instructions, or control any surgical equipment. Surgeons remain fully responsible for all clinical and surgical decisions, and the AI display can be turned off at any time. All participants will receive standard clinical care. Parti
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：中国人民解放军总医院；疾病：肾（肾细胞）癌、输尿管肾盂连接处梗阻、上尿路癌；类型：观察性；入组：1700；状态：尚未开始招募] 本研究旨在评估基于人工智能（AI）的软件系统能否辅助外科医生在微创上尿路手术中识别关键解剖结构。在这些手术中，外科医生通过观察腹腔镜内窥镜图像进行操作。关键解剖结构，如肾脏、肾动脉和肾静脉、输尿管、肾盂、下腔静脉和左侧生殖静脉，以及肿瘤等手术目标，有时可能因出血、手术烟雾、组织移动、组织外观变化或手术器械遮挡而难以区分。研究团队开发了一种基于AI的图像识别系统，可实时分析手术视频，并在手术过程中于屏幕上识别和勾勒相关解剖结构。本研究有两个主要目标（主要终点）：1. 评估AI系统在不同医院、外科医生、手术操作和成像系统采集的手术视频中识别和描绘关键解剖结构的准确性。2. 评估AI系统在手术室中的实时性能和技术可靠性，包括处理延迟、帧率、系统故障率，以及手术期间AI生成结果成功显示的时间比例。研究将纳入18岁及以上、接受以下五类微创上尿路手术之一的成人：部分肾切除术、根治性肾切除术、根治性肾输尿管切除术、下腔静脉癌栓切除术或肾盂成形术。研究将在中国11家医院开展。第一阶段将使用2015年至2025年间录制的手术视频来开发、验证和测试AI系统。第二阶段将从内部中心前瞻性入组约100名患者，并在手术期间将AI生成的解剖识别结果显示在监视器上。总体计划纳入约1,600例回顾性手术病例和100例前瞻性病例。AI系统仅设计为解剖识别的辅助工具。它不作出临床决策、不提供自主手术指令，也不控制任何手术设备。外科医生仍对所有临床和手术决策负全部责任，AI显示可随时关闭。所有参与者将接受标准临床照护。Parti

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Kepler University Hospital; conditions: Patient Safety; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 40000; status: RECRUITING] A key process in intensive care is the creation of transfer reports. These summarize the essential aspects of the treatment to date and ensure that information is passed on to the next treatment team in a structured manner. They contain, among other things, diagnoses, relevant examination results, and therapeutic measures that have been carried out. The aim of a transfer report is to document the patient's medical history and the course of treatment to date in a concise and complete manner. Incomplete transfer reports can lead to repeated examinations, which can potentially delay further therapy and endanger the patient, as well as incurring additional costs. In this context, a complete transfer report ensures continuity of treatment and contributes significantly to patient safety. Transfer reports are created from a synthesis of a large number of documents. In addition to medical facts from tables and free-text summaries, physicians also draw on their experience to pass on relevant information to future treatment teams in the synthesis of detailed documentation. This process naturally requires a great deal of time and concentration in patients receiving intensive care. Artificial intelligence methods, such as large language models (LLMs), could be used to learn how to create transfer reports and formulate drafts. LLMs can convert unstructured free text into a structured form, thereby facilitating the report creation process. This would make it possible to generate a pre-formulated draft that doctors could then review and supplement. At present, transfer reports are created by physicians with considerable effort and time. The methods currently available for automating report generation are limited to text modules that largely bundle data sources deterministically. Some of these methods are already commercially available, but they are not capable of creating individual reports beyond form letters. The automatic analysis of unstructured text data falls within a subfield of AI known as natural language processing (NLP), which also includes language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT and Gemini, which have been popular since 2022. A major milestone was reached with the development of the Transformer architecture in 2017, which, in addition to the availability of enormous amounts of training data (e.g., Wikipedia, news articles, or books), forms the basis for many groundbreaking language models. abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Institut de Chirurgie Reparatrice Locomoteur et Sports; conditions: Shoulder Arthroplasty, Patient Reported Outcome Measures, Shoulder Pain; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 846; status: RECRUITING] After shoulder replacement surgery, surgeons send questionnaires to their patients to learn how they are doing (pain, shoulder function, satisfaction). Many patients do not answer. This study tests the best way to obtain these answers. The study is nested in a multicenter study of pain after shoulder arthroplasty conducted in four French centers (host study RetroPAinRSACAll, supported by Ramsay Santé). The clinical results of the host study are not the subject of this registration: this study evaluates only the method used to collect the information. All patients first receive an email invitation (when an email address is available) and, the next day, a text message (SMS) with a personal link to the questionnaire and a phone number to answer at any time by talking with an automated voice assistant. Patients who have not answered two days after the first contact are randomly assigned to one of two follow-up strategies: (1) further digital reminders (SMS on day 3 and day 5, email on day 7), or (2) up to three phone calls from a conversational artificial intelligence (AI) voice agent on days 3, 5 and 7, which asks the same questions orally. In both groups, patients can answer at any time online or by calling the voice assistant, and contacts stop as soon as the questionnaire is completed or the patient refuses. The main outcome is the proportion of patients who complete the questionnaire within 14 days of the first contact.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Institut de Chirurgie Reparatrice Locomoteur et Sports；疾病/状况：肩关节置换术、患者报告结局指标、肩痛；类型：干预性；分期：不适用（NA）；入组人数：846；状态：招募中] 肩关节置换术后，外科医生向患者发送问卷以了解其情况（疼痛、肩功能、满意度）。许多患者未作答。本研究检验获取这些回答的最佳方式。本研究嵌套于一项在法国四家中心开展的肩关节置换术后疼痛多中心研究（主研究 RetroPAinRSACAll，由 Ramsay Santé 支持）。主研究的临床结果不是本注册的主题：本研究仅评估用于收集信息的方法。所有患者首先收到一封电子邮件邀请（在有电子邮件地址时），并在次日收到一条短信（SMS），其中包含问卷的个人链接以及一个电话号码，可随时通过与自动语音助手通话作答。首次接触后两天仍未作答的患者被随机分配至两种随访策略之一：（1）进一步的数字提醒（第3天和第5天发送短信，第7天发送电子邮件），或（2）在第3、5和7天由对话式人工智能（AI）语音代理最多拨打三次电话，以口头方式询问相同问题。在两组中，患者可随时在线作答或致电语音助手作答；一旦问卷完成或患者拒绝，联系即停止。主要结局是首次接触后14天内完成问卷的患者比例。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Fujian Provincial Hospital; conditions: Critical Illness, Traumatic Brain Injury, Subarachnoid Hemorrhage, Intracerebral Hemorrhage, Intracranial Hypertension; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 100; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Mortality prediction in neurocritical care relies on scores computed at admission, which cannot update as the clinical course evolves. We previously developed a landmark-based machine learning model that converts hourly physiological data, including intracranial pressure, into an updating risk of death. The model was developed in a large public database and validated retrospectively in a second, independent one. This prospective multicentre study will test the model in consecutive patients at participating hospitals in Fujian Province, China. Physiological data will be collected as part of routine care. The model will generate risk estimates that are recorded for analysis but not shown to treating clinicians, and no treatment decision will be influenced by the study. The primary analysis will assess discrimination and calibration of the model for death during the intensive care stay. Secondary analyses will compare the model with severity scores in routine use and examine performance by aetiology.
zh_abstract: ［新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：福建省立医院；疾病：危重症、创伤性脑损伤、蛛网膜下腔出血、脑内出血、颅内高压；类型：观察性；入组：100；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）］神经重症监护中的死亡预测依赖于入院时计算的评分，这些评分无法随着临床病程演变而更新。我们此前开发了一种基于地标（landmark）的机器学习模型，该模型将包括颅内压在内的每小时生理数据转化为更新的死亡风险。该模型在一个大型公共数据库中开发，并在第二个独立数据库中进行回顾性验证。这项前瞻性多中心研究将在中国福建省参与医院中的连续患者中检验该模型。生理数据将作为常规诊疗的一部分收集。该模型将生成风险估计值，记录用于分析但不向治疗临床医生显示，且研究不会影响任何治疗决策。主要分析将评估模型对重症监护住院期间死亡的区分度和校准度。次要分析将把模型与常规使用的严重程度评分进行比较，并按病因检查性能。

abstract: [The Journal of surgical research] Integrated plastic surgery is a small, competitive field in which guidance travels through mentors and home programs, and published evidence comes largely from program-director surveys. The American Council of Educators in Plastic Surgery maintains a free library of recorded application-advice sessions that has not previously been systematically quantified. Eligible sessions published between April 2020 and July 2026 were transcribed, and speaker roles were identified. Recommendations were extracted and coded for topic, advice pattern, actionability, and resource requirements using Claude Opus 5. A stratified 250-sentence sample was coded by two investigators. The actionability rule was revised after an audit and all units were recoded by the model, the human comparison used labels from the original rule. Seventy-four of 79 sessions provided match advice (63.2 h), yielding 8069 model-extracted recommendations; 70.5% were actionable. Actionability among advice sentences identified by the two human coders was 48.6%-63.4%, a descriptive sample range rather than a corrected corpus estimate. Actionable advice was more likely to be detected, which may increase its proportion in the model-extracted set. Personal-statement guidance emphasized self-presentation, general-strategy guidance emotional well-being, and mentorship guidance advocacy. Resource requirements affected 12.4% of recommendations. At the precondition-instance level, 722 assumptions of access versus 106 alternatives yielded a ratio of 6.8:1 (95% confidence interval, 5.60-8.76). The American Council of Educators in Plastic Surgery library covers multiple stages of the application process and includes advice that depends on resources applicants may not have. Guidance within this library should offer practical alternatives when recommended strategies require mentorship, money, or home-program access.

abstract: [Annals of African medicine] Good oral hygiene is mandatory for orthodontic patients. This study was done for evaluating how well an artificial intelligence (AI)-based supervising system could improve oral hygiene during orthodontic procedures. A total of 44 patients who were undergoing for permanent orthodontic procedures were split into two groups of 22 each: Group I as the control, and Group II as the AI monitoring test group. The test group's patients were instructed to get routine intraoral scans using Scanbox (Dental Monitoring®). For all groups, the Orthodontic Plaque Index and Marginal Gingival Index (MGI) were measured at baseline (T0), 2 weeks later (T1, T2, and T3, respectively), and at 3 months (T4). A statistical analysis was performed on the collected data. Subjects in the test group showed a considerable decrease in gingival inflammation and plaque score in contrast to the control group. Plaque and gingival irritation are reduced during orthodontic treatment when a remote monitoring system is used. By using this technique, patients are able to maintain the greatest possible dental health.
zh_abstract: [Annals of African medicine] 良好的口腔卫生对正畸患者是必须的。本研究旨在评估基于人工智能（AI）的监督系统在正畸治疗过程中能多大程度改善口腔卫生。共44名接受固定正畸治疗的患者被分为两组，每组22人：I组为对照组，II组为AI监测试验组。试验组患者被指导使用Scanbox（Dental Monitoring®）进行常规口内扫描。所有组均在基线（T0）、2周后（分别为T1、T2和T3）以及3个月时（T4）测量正畸菌斑指数和边缘牙龈指数（MGI）。对收集的数据进行了统计分析。与对照组相比，试验组受试者的牙龈炎症和菌斑评分显著降低。使用远程监测系统时，正畸治疗期间菌斑和牙龈刺激减少。通过使用该技术，患者能够维持最大可能的牙齿健康。

abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing diagnostic radiology, but education and training have not kept pace. This narrative review brings together current evidence on AI-supported learning in radiology education and how such learning can move into clinical innovation. Surveys from different countries point to the same gap: in a 25-country international survey of radiographers, radiologists, and students, only 10.3% had received formal AI training; in one national survey of Turkish residents, 84.5% had received none. The review maps competency frameworks and curriculum models that define AI literacy and support staged integration into residency. It also assesses AI as a teaching tool, including AI-assisted case-based learning, computer-aided diagnosis training, precision-education knowledge recommenders, and virtual, augmented, and extended reality. Controlled and randomized studies show measurable gains: computer-aided diagnosis training raised resident scores above self-study controls (mean score 52 vs. 38 on a 100-point scale), while an AI-based knowledge recommender shortened reporting time by 162 s per case and relative improvement in graded reporting accuracy scores of 14% (95% CI 8.1-19.8%). Large language models are promising but limited: GPT-4 approaches board-style examination performance (80.6%) yet remains poor at image-based reasoning (47.8%). The review closes by considering how education can feed clinical innovation, along with algorithmic and automation bias, ethical governance, and future research needs. AI education should therefore span the full continuum-from undergraduate training to continuing professional development-if radiology is to innovate safely, effectively, and equitably.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] 人工智能（AI）正在改变诊断放射学，但教育和培训尚未跟上。本叙述性综述汇集了关于放射学教育中 AI 支持的学习以及此类学习如何转化为临床创新的当前证据。来自不同国家的调查指向同一差距：在一项涵盖 25 个国家的放射技师、放射科医生和学生国际调查中，只有 10.3% 接受过正式 AI 培训；在一项针对土耳其住院医师的全国调查中，84.5% 未接受过任何培训。该综述梳理了定义 AI 素养并支持分阶段整合到住院医师培训的能力框架和课程模型。它还评估了 AI 作为教学工具，包括 AI 辅助的基于病例的学习、计算机辅助诊断培训、精准教育知识推荐器，以及虚拟、增强和扩展现实。对照和随机研究表明可测量的获益：计算机辅助诊断培训使住院医师分数高于自学对照（100 分制平均分 52 对 38），而基于 AI 的知识推荐器将每例报告时间缩短 162 秒，并使分级报告准确性评分的相对改善达 14%（95% CI 8.1-19.8%）。大语言模型前景可期但有局限：GPT-4 接近委员会式考试表现（80.6%），但在基于图像的推理方面仍然较差（47.8%）。综述最后讨论了教育如何促进临床创新，以及算法和自动化偏倚、伦理治理和未来研究需求。因此，如果放射学要安全、有效和公平地创新，AI 教育应覆盖从本科培训到持续专业发展的完整连续体。

abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Regulatory entry and public experience describe different aspects of artificial intelligence-enabled healthcare access. This health policy study compares institutional arrangements in China, the United States, and the European Union, examines the coverage of equity-related evidence, and analyses an online Chinese survey. Of 480 submissions, 430 passed an attention check, including 32 respondents without reported functional contact and 398 entering the experience models. The institutional comparison identifies differences in regulatory objects, information recipients, and responsibility allocation. The coverage analysis distinguishes institutional information and hospital governance from measured portal use and service experience. In the survey, lower-capability respondents reported greater entry and operational barriers; 79 of 159 reported reducing or abandoning use because of barriers. Among contacted respondents, functional contact intensity was positively associated with perceived process ease (standardized β = 0.496), which was associated with perceived health-service responsiveness (standardized β = 0.381). The contact-by-capability interaction was negative (B = -0.254), contrary to the hypothesized direction. The findings highlight entry and operational barriers alongside differences in experience among existing users, supporting evaluation of both access conditions and service encounters.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 监管准入与公众体验描述了人工智能赋能医疗保健可及性的不同方面。这项卫生政策研究比较了中国、美国和欧盟的制度安排，考察了公平相关证据的覆盖范围，并分析了一项中国在线调查。在480份提交中，430份通过了注意力检查，包括32名未报告功能性联系的受访者和398名进入体验模型的受访者。制度比较识别出监管对象、信息接收者和责任分配方面的差异。覆盖分析将制度信息和医院治理与测量到的门户使用和服务体验区分开来。在调查中，能力较低的受访者报告了更大的准入和操作障碍；159人中有79人报告因障碍而减少或放弃使用。在有联系的受访者中，功能性联系强度与感知流程便捷性呈正相关（标准化β = 0.496），而感知流程便捷性又与感知卫生服务响应性相关（标准化β = 0.381）。联系与能力的交互作用为负（B = -0.254），与假设方向相反。研究结果突出了准入和操作障碍以及现有用户之间的体验差异，支持对可及条件和服务接触两方面进行评估。

abstract: [Acta medica portuguesa] Acute stroke is a leading cause of death and long-term disability in Portugal. Rapid and accurate imaging is critical to guide acute stroke management, and artificial intelligence has shown growing potential to support triage, quantification, and therapeutic decision-making. This study aimed to characterize the current use of artificial intelligence in acute stroke imaging workflow in Portuguese public hospital neuroradiology departments, and to identify perceived benefits, implementation barriers and prospects. A descriptive, cross-sectional study was conducted using an online questionnaire distributed between January and April 2026 to neuroradiology departments of Portuguese public hospitals with stroke intervention units. The questionnaire covered department characterization, current use of artificial intelligence, and perceptions regarding future applications. Responses were analyzed descriptively. Ten hospitals from the North, Centre, Lisbon Metropolitan Area, South and insular regions were included. All operated under a stroke code protocol, used computed tomography as the first-line modality, and provided 24-hour neuroradiology coverage through a combined on-site and teleradiology model. Only two hospitals used dedicated artificial intelligence software, and one was in an implementation phase. Three additional centers used computational tools with artificial intelligence functionalities without identifying them as such. Prior contact with artificial intelligence was reported by 80% of respondents, and all anticipated its integration into routine practice. The most frequently cited applications were automated ASPECTS, core/penumbra quantification, large vessel occlusion identification and hemorrhage detection. Faster time-to-treatment and support for teleradiology workflows were the most perceived benefits. Opinions on funding were divided between the hospital institution and the state. Formal staff training was reported only by one center. Despite high awareness and a well-established organizational framework, adoption of artificial intelligence remains limited. Coordinated procurement strategies, structured training programs and shared operational definitions of artificial intelligence are needed to enable broader and more equitable integration into stroke care.
zh_abstract: [Acta medica portuguesa] 急性卒中是葡萄牙的主要死亡原因和长期残疾原因。快速且准确的成像对于指导急性卒中管理至关重要，而人工智能在支持分诊、量化和治疗决策方面已显示出日益增长的潜力。本研究旨在描述葡萄牙公立医院神经放射科在急性卒中成像工作流程中当前使用人工智能的情况，并识别其感知益处、实施障碍和前景。采用描述性横断面研究，于 2026 年 1 月至 4 月期间向设有卒中干预单元的葡萄牙公立医院神经放射科发放在线问卷。问卷涵盖科室特征、当前人工智能使用情况以及对未来应用的看法。对回答进行描述性分析。共纳入来自北部、中部、里斯本都会区、南部和岛屿地区的十家医院。所有医院均在卒中代码协议下运行，使用计算机断层扫描作为一线模态，并通过现场与远程放射学相结合的模式提供 24 小时神经放射学覆盖。仅两家医院使用专用人工智能软件，其中一家处于实施阶段。另有三个中心使用了具有人工智能功能的计算工具，但未将其识别为人工智能。80% 的受访者报告此前接触过人工智能，所有人都预期其将整合到常规实践中。最常提及的应用是自动化 ASPECTS、核心/半暗带量化、大血管闭塞识别和出血检测。更快的治疗时间和支持远程放射学工作流程是最受感知的益处。关于资金来源的意见分为由医院机构和州政府承担两派。仅一个中心报告了正式员工培训。尽管认知度高且组织框架完善，人工智能的采用仍然有限。需要协调采购策略、结构化培训项目以及人工智能的共享操作定义，以实现更广泛和更公平地整合到卒中照护中。

title: Human-Agentic AI Collaboration Workflow for Trend Analysis of ChatGPT Applications in Healthcare

summary: medRxiv预印本：结合领域专家与LLM智能体，系统检索PubMed与Web of Science梳理ChatGPT医疗应用研究趋势。

abstract: Background: With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI), large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT have demonstrated strong potential to transform healthcare research and practice. However, LLMs are probabilistic and generate inherently variable outputs, which create risk and uncertainty in healthcare applications. Therefore, analyzing the current research landscape of ChatGPT applications is imperative to understand applied techniques and related concerns and to facilitate their practical integration into healthcare information systems. Objective: Leveraging LLM-based agentic AI with domain experts to analyze trends in ChatGPT healthcare applications and to examine the collaborative and interpretative capacities of LLM agents in broader contexts beyond narrowly defined topics. Methods: The review used a systematic search of the PubMed and Web of Science databases, following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, and focused on ChatGPT applications, associated concerns, applied techniques, and usage factors. To support the review process, an adaptive, iterative LLM-based agentic AI with a human-in-the-loop mechanism was employed for automated metadata extraction, identification, classification, and knowledge synthesis. The extracted information was subsequently used for temporal and thematic analyses, citation network construction, and main-path analysis. Results: Across 192 papers, the review identified 511 ChatGPT application types, 690 concern items, and 368 influence usage factors distinct from traditional IT, achieving a metadata error rate of 1.04%. The human-agentic AI workflow enabled efficient synthesis of contextual information across studies, addressing the growing challenge of timely evidence integration in medical knowledge. The findings provide insights into the evolving trajectories of ChatGPT applications in healthcare and demonstrate the value of an expert-validated human-agentic AI workflow in supporting literature analysis and streamlining review processes. Conclusion: This review provides a comprehensive overview of emerging ChatGPT applications, associated concerns, applied techniques, and usage factors in healthcare. The study further provides meaningful insights into the operational mechanisms of agentic AI, demonstrating the potential of human-AI collaboration for medical informatics research.
zh_abstract: 【背景】随着人工智能（AI）的快速发展，ChatGPT等大语言模型（LLM）已展现出改变医疗保健研究与实践的强大潜力。然而，LLM具有概率性并产生本质上可变的输出，这在医疗保健应用中带来风险与不确定性。因此，分析ChatGPT应用的当前研究图景十分必要，以理解所应用的技术及相关关切，并促进其实际整合到医疗保健信息系统中。【目的】利用基于LLM的智能体式人工智能（agentic AI）与领域专家合作，分析ChatGPT在医疗保健应用中的趋势，并在超越狭义主题的更广泛情境中考察LLM智能体的协作与解释能力。【方法】本综述遵循PRISMA-ScR指南，对PubMed和Web of Science数据库进行系统检索，聚焦ChatGPT应用、相关关切、所应用技术及使用因素。为支持综述过程，采用具有人机回环（human-in-the-loop）机制的自适应、迭代式基于LLM的智能体式AI，用于自动元数据提取、识别、分类和知识综合。提取的信息随后用于时间与主题分析、引文网络构建和主路径分析。【结果】在192篇论文中，本综述识别出511种ChatGPT应用类型、690项关切条目，以及368个不同于传统信息技术（IT）的影响使用因素，元数据错误率为1.04%。人-智能体AI工作流程能够高效综合跨研究的上下文信息，应对医学知识中及时证据整合日益增长的挑战。研究结果提供了对ChatGPT在医疗保健中应用演变轨迹的洞见，并证明了经专家验证的人-智能体AI工作流程在支持文献分析和简化综述流程方面的价值。【结论】本综述全面概述了医疗保健中新兴的ChatGPT应用、相关关切、所应用技术及使用因素。研究进一步对智能体式AI的运行机制提供了有意义的洞见，展示了人-AI协作在医学信息学研究中的潜力。

abstract: The automated segmentation of unstained kidney brightfield microscopy images remains a significant challenge in medical imaging. In conventional histopathology, staining provides crucial structural and molecular contrast, allowing renal compartments and structures to be readily distinguished. The absence of staining markedly reduces this contrast, obscuring the fine architectural details that are essential for diagnosis. Addressing this gap would reduce reliance on staining protocols, reduce technical and interpretive variability, and preserve valuable tissue for downstream molecular or multi-omics analyses. Ultimately, automation of unstained image segmentation could enable faster, more objective tissue analysis while preserving samples for further molecular testing. In this work, we provide a comprehensive review of state-of-the-art segmentation methods applied to renal brightfield microscopy images. Current findings highlight a predominance of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based architectures for semantic segmentation approaches while recent trends point to the growing application of transformer-based and instance-segmentation strategies. However, the field is still hampered by the scarcity and poor annotation of publicly available renal datasets. Aiming to further contribute to the enhancement of the field, a dataset of 18 Whole Slide Images (WSIs) of unstained human kidney tissue is made publicly available. Additionally, in the dataset, we provide 543 annotated tiles extracted from the WSIs, facilitating further research into stain-independent segmentation approaches. As a third contribution, we present a preliminary case study, evaluating state-of-the-art deep learning segmentation architectures, including U-Net and Segment Anything Model (SAM). Our preliminary results indicate that deep learning models demonstrate promising segmentation performance in unstained kidney biopsies. In alignment with these findings, advanced customised loss functions and data augmentation were integrated into the supervised training of the promising U-Net, DeepLabv3+, and TransUNet models, achieving significant improvements compared to the baseline experiments. To exploit the abundance of unlabelled data, we further tested FixMatchSeg, a semi-supervised learning method; however, its segmentation performance remained slightly behind the supervised methods. Taken together, these contributions establish a foundation for future research in stain-independent Computationa
zh_abstract: 未染色肾脏明场显微镜图像的自动分割仍是医学成像中的重大挑战。在传统组织病理学中，染色提供关键的结构和分子对比度，使肾脏分区和结构易于区分。缺乏染色会显著降低这种对比度，掩盖诊断所必需的精细结构细节。填补这一空白将减少对染色方案的依赖，减少技术和判读变异性，并为下游分子或多组学分析保留宝贵组织。最终，未染色图像分割的自动化可以实现更快、更客观的组织分析，同时保留样本用于进一步分子检测。在本工作中，我们全面综述应用于肾脏明场显微镜图像的最先进分割方法。当前研究结果突显卷积神经网络（CNN）架构在语义分割方法中占主导地位，而近期趋势表明基于 transformer 和实例分割策略的应用日益增多。然而，该领域仍受制于公开可用肾脏数据集的稀缺和标注质量差。为进一步促进该领域发展，公开提供一个包含 18 张未染色人肾脏组织全切片图像（WSI）的数据集。此外，我们在该数据集中提供从 WSI 中提取的 543 个标注图块，促进对不依赖染色的分割方法的进一步研究。作为第三项贡献，我们提出一项初步案例研究，评估最先进的深度学习分割架构，包括 U-Net 和 Segment Anything Model（SAM）。我们的初步结果表明，深度学习模型在未染色肾脏活检中展现出有前景的分割性能。与这些发现一致，我们将先进的定制损失函数和数据增强集成到有前景的 U-Net、DeepLabv3+ 和 TransUNet 模型的监督训练中，与基线实验相比取得了显著改善。为利用大量未标注数据，我们进一步测试了半监督学习方法 FixMatchSeg；然而，其分割性能仍略落后于监督方法。总之，这些贡献为未来不依赖染色的 Computationa 研究奠定了基础。
