title: Quantum Machine Learning for Missense Variant Pathogenicity Prediction in the KCNQ Gene Family

abstract: Missense variants in the KCNQ family of voltage-gated potassium channel genes are associated with a broad spectrum of neurological and cardiac disorders for which computational tools capable of differentiating benign and pathogenic variants are essential. Here, we present, to our knowledge, the first application of quantum machine learning (QML) to missense pathogenicity prediction. We employ a hybrid quantum framework combining data re-uploading quantum neural networks with quantum support vector machines and applied it to pathogenicity classification across the full KCNQ gene family. Systematic exploration of circuit architectures revealed that optimal hyperparameter choices enable the proposed quantum model to achieve predictive performance superior to or comparable to state-of-the-art classical machine learning approaches, reaching AUC-ROC values of approximately 0.94 across the full dataset. Although no clear quantum advantage is observed at present, these results demonstrate that quantum feature representations can effectively capture biologically relevant patterns in variant data and establish QML as a viable framework for future applications in computational genomics and precision medicine.
zh_abstract: 电压门控钾通道基因 KCNQ 家族中的错义变异与广泛的神经和心脏疾病相关，因此能够区分良性变异和致病性变异的计算工具至关重要。在此，据我们所知，我们首次将量子机器学习（QML）应用于错义致病性预测。我们采用一种混合量子框架，将数据重上传（data re-uploading）量子神经网络与量子支持向量机相结合，并将其应用于整个 KCNQ 基因家族的致病性分类。对电路架构的系统探索表明，最佳超参数选择使所提出的量子模型能够达到优于或相当于最先进经典机器学习方法的预测性能，在整个数据集上 AUC-ROC 值约为 0.94。尽管目前尚未观察到明确的量子优势，但这些结果表明，量子特征表示能够有效捕捉变异数据中具有生物学相关性的模式，并确立 QML 作为未来计算基因组学和精准医学应用的可行框架。

title: Pharmacophore-Inspired Virtual Receptor: Generating Realistic Peptide Binding Data for Machine Learning
zh_title: 药效团启发的虚拟受体生成肽结合数据
summary: VReceptor框架生成序列依赖的肽结合数据，用PrRP数据集初步验证可近似结合行为。
key_points: 结合药效团加权与氨基酸相似度
在PrRP数据集上验证结合行为
面向计算肽设计与主动学习
reason: 单一数据集验证的预印本方法工具，证据有限，属增量档
abstract: VReceptor is a virtual receptor simulation framework that generates realistic, sequence-dependent binding data for peptide-based therapeutics. It combines pharmacophore-inspired weighting schemes with amino acid similarity metrics to evaluate peptide design strategies in a controlled environment. Validation using the Prolactin-Releasing Peptide (PrRP) dataset confirms VReceptor's ability to approximate binding behaviours and optimize experimental planning. This framework empowers researchers in computational peptide design and active learning workflows while highlighting areas for further refinement.
zh_abstract: VReceptor 是一个虚拟受体模拟框架，可为基于肽的治疗药物生成真实、序列依赖的结合数据。它结合受药效团启发的加权方案与氨基酸相似性度量，在受控环境中评估肽设计策略。使用催乳素释放肽（Prolactin-Releasing Peptide, PrRP）数据集进行的验证证实，VReceptor 能够近似结合行为并优化实验规划。该框架为计算肽设计和主动学习工作流中的研究人员提供支持，同时指出了有待进一步改进的方面。

title: Unsupervised Multi-modal Medical Image Registration via Invertible Translation
zh_title: 基于可逆翻译的无监督多模态医学图像配准
summary: INNReg用图像翻译将多模态转为单模态，再由配准网络对齐并保持几何一致性。
key_points: 可逆神经网络保障翻译后几何一致
配准网络在翻译后的单模态图像上对齐
方法名为INNReg，属无监督框架
reason: 方法类预印本，摘录未体现外部验证或公开数据，属增量档
abstract: In medical imaging, the alignment of multi-modal images plays a critical role in providing comprehensive information for image-guided therapies. Despite its importance, multi-modal image registration poses significant challenges due to the complex and often unknown spatial relationships between different image modalities. To address this, we introduce a novel unsupervised translation-based multi-modal registration method, termed Invertible Neural Network-based Registration (INNReg). INNReg consists of an image-to-image translation network that converts multi-modal images into mono-modal counterparts and a registration network that uses the translated mono-modal images to align the multi-modal images. Specifically, to ensure the preservation of geometric consistency after image translation, we introduce an Invertible Neural Network (INN) that leverages a dynamic depthwise convolution-based local attention mechanism. Additionally, we design a novel barrier loss function based on Normalized Mutual Information to impose constraints on the registration network, which enhances the registration accuracy. The superior performance of INNReg is demonstrated through experiments on two public multi-modal medical image datasets, including MRI T1/T2 and MRI/CT pairs. The code is available at https://github.com/MeggieGuo/INNReg
zh_abstract: 在医学影像中，多模态图像的对齐在为图像引导治疗提供全面信息方面起着关键作用。尽管其重要性不言而喻，但由于不同图像模态之间复杂且常常未知的空间关系，多模态图像配准仍面临重大挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种新颖的基于无监督翻译的多模态配准方法，称为可逆神经网络配准（Invertible Neural Network-based Registration, INNReg）。INNReg 由一个图像到图像翻译网络和一个配准网络组成，前者将多模态图像转换为单模态对应图像，后者使用翻译后的单模态图像来对齐多模态图像。具体而言，为确保图像翻译后几何一致性的保持，我们引入可逆神经网络（Invertible Neural Network, INN），其利用基于动态深度卷积的局部注意力机制。此外，我们设计了一种基于归一化互信息的新型屏障损失函数，以对配准网络施加约束，从而提高配准准确性。通过在两个公开多模态医学图像数据集（包括 MRI T1/T2 和 MRI/CT 对）上的实验，证明了 INNReg 的优越性能。代码可在 https://github.com/MeggieGuo/INNReg 获取。

title: SimAI: Mechanistic User Simulation through Psychological Network Models
zh_title: 基于心理网络模型的心理治疗用户模拟
summary: SimAI用图重构奖励建模心理因素交互，并构建含516例心理治疗案例、18576条画像网络的PSYCHE数据集。
key_points: 以图重构目标监督开放式对话模拟
PSYCHE含516例治疗案例的18576条画像网络对
自动评测显示模拟与行为多样性优于既有患者模拟器
reason: 预印本，心理健康模拟新方法与新数据集，但缺临床结局验证，属增量偏上
abstract: Realistic user simulation enables the study of human interactions when direct experimentation is costly or potentially harmful. However, existing simulators largely overlook the psychological mechanisms that drive user behavior. We introduce SimAI, a framework for mechanistic user simulation that models how psychological factors interact to shape user responses. To overcome the challenge of supervising open-ended behavior, we propose a graph reconstruction objective that provides graph-level rewards based on how well simulated conversations reflect the underlying psychological relationships. To support this approach, we construct PSYCHE, a dataset of 18,576 profile-network pairs derived from 516 psychotherapy cases. Automatic evaluations show that SimAI achieves greater simulation and behavioral diversity than existing patient simulators while maintaining strong profile alignment. In an interactive study with 30 mental-health professionals and trainees, SimAI receives the highest average ratings for conversational authenticity, realistic help-seeking behavior, and clinical training utility. Beyond simulation quality, SimAI enables realistic clinical training and uncovers safety failures in prolonged AI interactions with vulnerable users. Code is available at https://github.com/behavioral-data/ANGEL-UserSim.
zh_abstract: 当直接实验成本高昂或可能有害时，现实用户模拟使研究人类互动成为可能。然而，现有模拟器在很大程度上忽视了驱动用户行为的心理机制。我们提出SimAI，一个用于机制性用户模拟的框架，用于建模心理因素如何相互作用以塑造用户反应。为克服监督开放式行为的挑战，我们提出图重建目标，该目标根据模拟对话反映潜在心理关系的程度提供图级奖励。为支持该方法，我们构建了PSYCHE，一个包含18,576个档案-网络对的数据集，这些数据对源自516个心理治疗案例。自动评估显示，SimAI比现有患者模拟器实现更高的模拟多样性和行为多样性，同时保持很强的档案对齐。在一项与30名心理健康专业人员和受训者进行的交互研究中，SimAI在对话真实性、现实求助行为和临床培训实用性方面获得最高平均评分。除模拟质量外，SimAI使真实临床培训成为可能，并揭示与弱势用户长时间AI互动中的安全失效。代码见 https://github.com/behavioral-data/ANGEL-UserSim。

title: LeViT-UNet++: Towards Balanced Fine-Grained Details and Context for Efficient Medical Image Segmentation
zh_title: LeViT-UNet++：兼顾细节与上下文的高效医学图像分割
summary: 提出编码器-解码器架构，用小波多尺度下采样平衡细节与全局上下文以提升分割效率。
key_points: 提出Haar小波多尺度下采样模块
在有限算力下兼顾局部细节与全局上下文
预印本摘要未报告外部验证结果
reason: 预印本方法改进，摘要无数据集与对照细节，属增量档
abstract: Efficient medical image segmentation is essential for clinical applications requiring fast and accurate delineation, such as surgical navigation, radiation therapy, and real-time image-guided intervention. Despite substantial advances in convolutional neural networks and Transformers, attaining high accuracy under limited computational resources remains difficult, because reducing model complexity often sacrifices fine-grained structural details and global context modeling, yielding an unfavorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. To address this, we propose LeViT-UNet++, an efficient encoder-decoder architecture that better balances local detail preservation and global context modeling. Specifically, we introduce a Haar Wavelet Multi-Scale Downsampling (HWMD) module that decomposes feature representations into low- and high-frequency components to extract multi-scale structural information, thereby mitigating detail loss during downsampling. We further develop a depthwise convolution-based decoder that integrates multi-scale global representations from Transformer blocks with local spatial features, enabling progressive feature refinement while reducing computational overhead. Evaluated on four benchmarks (Synapse, ACDC, LA2018, and MSD Heart) under both 2D and 3D settings, LeViT-UNet++ achieves competitive accuracy with a compact parameter footprint and fast inference. On Synapse, for instance, it attains a DSC of 76.57% with only 8.025M parameters and 241.72 FPS, confirming a favorable accuracy-efficiency balance. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining wavelet-based multi-scale feature extraction with lightweight local-global feature fusion for efficient medical segmentation. The source code is available at https://github.com/apple1986/levit_unet_pp.
zh_abstract: 高效医学图像分割对于需要快速准确勾画的临床应用至关重要，例如手术导航、放射治疗和实时图像引导介入。尽管卷积神经网络和 Transformer 已取得重大进展，但在有限计算资源下获得高准确率仍然困难，因为降低模型复杂度通常会牺牲细粒度结构细节和全局上下文建模，导致不利的准确率-效率权衡。为解决此问题，我们提出 LeViT-UNet++，一种高效的编码器-解码器架构，能够更好地平衡局部细节保留与全局上下文建模。具体而言，我们引入 Haar 小波多尺度下采样（Haar Wavelet Multi-Scale Downsampling, HWMD）模块，将特征表示分解为低频和高频分量，以提取多尺度结构信息，从而减轻下采样过程中的细节损失。我们进一步开发了基于深度卷积的解码器，将来自 Transformer 块的多尺度全局表示与局部空间特征相结合，在减少计算开销的同时实现渐进式特征细化。在 2D 和 3D 设置下，在四个基准（Synapse、ACDC、LA2018 和 MSD Heart）上评估时，LeViT-UNet++ 以紧凑的参数规模和快速推理实现了具有竞争力的准确率。例如，在 Synapse 上，它仅以 8.025M 参数和 241.72 FPS 达到 76.57% 的 DSC，证实了良好的准确率-效率平衡。这些结果证明了将基于小波的多尺度特征提取与轻量级局部-全局特征融合相结合用于高效医学分割的有效性。源代码可在 https://github.com/apple1986/levit_unet_pp 获取。

title: Fine-Grained Japanese Clinical Named Entity Recognition: A Controlled Comparison of BERT and Open-Weight Large Language Models
zh_title: 日语临床命名实体识别：BERT与开源大模型对比
summary: 在含113类实体的iCorpus上，对比2个微调BERT-CRF与9个开源大模型的日语临床实体抽取表现。
key_points: iCorpus含113类实体，训练1672句、测试433句
大模型用零样本提示、JSON约束与QLoRA微调评估
零样本最佳宽松F1仅0.337
reason: 预印本对比研究，测试集仅433句、无外部验证，属增量证据档
abstract: Background: Generative large language models (LLMs) offer an alternative to encoder-based clinical named entity recognition (NER), but their performance on fine-grained Japanese extraction tasks and sensitivity to generation settings remain uncertain. Methods: We compared two fine-tuned BERT-CRF baselines with nine open-weight LLMs on iCorpus, which defines 113 entity categories. The evaluation used 433 sentences from 36 test documents; 1,672 sentences were used for training. LLMs were evaluated using zero-shot prompting with and without JSON Schema constraints and three-seed QLoRA fine-tuning. Fine-tuned models were assessed under different output-token limits, including 900 and larger model-specific limits of 2,600 or 4,096 tokens. Performance was measured using sentence-level label-surface matching with relaxed and exact-surface F1. Results: The highest zero-shot relaxed F1 was 0.337, compared with 0.836-0.841 for the BERT baselines. At the larger output limits, all eight fine-tuned LLMs with at least 13B total parameters exceeded both BERT baselines (relaxed F1, 0.882-0.914; exact-surface F1, 0.840-0.880). Across three-seed means, increasing the output limit improved relaxed F1 by 0.052-0.085, alongside higher recall and fewer length-limited outputs. JSON Schema constraints changed relaxed F1 by -0.014 to +0.008 among seven models outside the two reasoning-oriented configurations, while medical-general model pairs showed no consistent advantage for medical specialization. Conclusions: On this historical Japanese case-report benchmark, task-specific fine-tuning combined with adequate generation capacity was associated with stronger LLM extraction performance. Output-token limits materially affected comparisons with BERT, whereas enforcing output structure alone did not overcome low zero-shot accuracy.
zh_abstract: 【背景】生成式大语言模型（LLMs）为基于编码器的临床命名实体识别（NER）提供了一种替代方案，但其在细粒度日语抽取任务上的性能以及对生成设置的敏感性仍不确定。【方法】我们在iCorpus上比较了两个微调的BERT-CRF基线与九个开放权重LLMs，iCorpus定义了113个实体类别。评估使用来自36份测试文档的433个句子；训练使用1,672个句子。LLMs采用零样本提示进行评估，分别在有和无JSON Schema约束条件下，并进行三随机种子QLoRA微调。微调模型在不同输出token上限下评估，包括900以及更大的模型特定上限2,600或4,096个token。性能采用句子级标签表面匹配，以宽松和精确表面F1衡量。【结果】最高的零样本宽松F1为0.337，而BERT基线为0.836-0.841。在更大的输出上限下，所有八个总参数至少为13B的微调LLMs均超过两个BERT基线（宽松F1，0.882-0.914；精确表面F1，0.840-0.880）。按三随机种子均值计，提高输出上限使宽松F1提高0.052-0.085，同时召回率更高、长度受限输出更少。在两种面向推理的配置之外的七个模型中，JSON Schema约束使宽松F1变化-0.014至+0.008，而医学模型-通用模型配对未显示医学专业化具有一致优势。【结论】在这个历史日语病例报告基准上，任务特定微调结合足够的生成容量与更强的LLM抽取性能相关。输出token上限实质性影响与BERT的比较，而仅强制输出结构并未克服低零样本准确率。

title: Leveraging Segmentation Representations for Efficient Classification: A Self-Configuring Framework Based on nnU-Net
zh_title: 复用分割表征的nnU-Net自配置分类框架
summary: 把nnU-Net工作流扩展到3D医学影像的联合分割与分类，复用分割模型的编码器特征与预测概率做图像级分类。
key_points: 比较冻结骨干与部分微调两种共享策略
引入ROI信息、前景体积与分割置信度
五折实验显示更复杂配置未持续提升
reason: 方法为现有流程的增量扩展，五折内部实验，属增量档
abstract: We propose a self-configuring framework that extends the nnU-Net workflow to both segmentation and classification in 3D medical imaging. Building on nnU-Net's self-configuring method, the framework reuses representations learned by a segmentation model for image-level classification. Its encoder features and predicted segmentation probabilities are used by a lightweight classifier. Two information-sharing strategies are investigated. In the frozen-backbone branch, features are augmented with region-of-interest information, predicted foreground volume, and segmentation confidence. In the adaptation branch, the final encoder stage is partially fine-tuned for classification, with an auxiliary segmentation loss to preserve segmentation-related information. Additional five-fold experiments showed that more complex configurations did not consistently improve classification performance. On the public validation leaderboard, our selected framework achieved an Overall score of 0.8056. In the official FLARE 2026 Task 2 final evaluation, our framework ranked first overall, achieving the highest DSC, NSD, and AUROC across all four testing tasks, including two hidden testing tasks. Local inference measurements also remained below the challenge limits of $60 \mathrm{s}$ per case and $4 \mathrm{GB}$ GPU memory. These results demonstrate the practical value of reusing segmentation representations for classification while maintaining a simple and efficient framework.
zh_abstract: 我们提出一种自配置框架，将 nnU-Net 工作流扩展至 3D 医学影像中的分割和分类。该框架基于 nnU-Net 的自配置方法，复用分割模型学习到的表示进行图像级分类。其编码器特征和预测的分割概率被轻量级分类器使用。研究了两种信息共享策略。在冻结主干分支中，特征通过感兴趣区域信息、预测前景体积和分割置信度进行增强。在适配分支中，编码器最后阶段针对分类进行部分微调，并辅以分割损失以保留分割相关信息。额外的五折实验表明，更复杂的配置并未一致地提升分类性能。在公开验证排行榜上，我们选定的框架取得 0.8056 的总分。在官方 FLARE 2026 任务 2 最终评估中，我们的框架总排名第一，在包括两个隐藏测试任务在内的全部四个测试任务中取得最高 DSC、NSD 和 AUROC。本地推理测量也保持在挑战赛限制之内：每例 60 s 和 4 GB GPU 显存。这些结果证明了在保持简单高效框架的同时，复用分割表示进行分类的实际价值。

title: DynSurvX: Time-Resolved Explanations for Dynamic Survival Predictions
zh_title: DynSurvX：动态生存预测的时间分辨解释框架
summary: 提出模型无关的可解释框架，为含纵向协变量的动态生存预测提供随时间更新的Shapley解释。
key_points: 两阶段分层策略：先筛选关键纵向特征，再细化时间重要性
解释随新患者数据更新，可降低计算开销
在模拟数据与两个临床数据集上验证，性能更好的模型与理论重要性更一致
reason: 方法学贡献为主，仅模拟与两个临床数据集验证，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Recent survival models integrating longitudinal data achieve strong predictive performance, but their predictions are often difficult to interpret, limiting their clinical use. We propose DynSurvX, a model-agnostic explainability framework for dynamic survival prediction with mixed static and longitudinal covariates. Based on Shapley values, DynSurvX introduces a hierarchical two-phase strategy that first identifies influential longitudinal features and then adaptively refines their temporal importance, enabling fine-grained explanations while reducing computational cost. The framework provides time-resolved explanations that evolve as new patient data become available. Experiments on simulated and two clinical datasets show varying agreement with theoretical importance across prediction models, with closer agreement for better-performing models, alongside clinically interpretable insights in real-world settings. It remains robust across prediction settings and reduces computation time by 41--80\% relative to the temporal explanation baseline, making dynamic explanations practical.
zh_abstract: 近期整合纵向数据的生存模型取得了很强的预测性能，但其预测往往难以解释，限制了临床应用。我们提出 DynSurvX，一个模型无关的可解释性框架，用于包含静态和纵向混合协变量的动态生存预测。基于 Shapley 值，DynSurvX 引入分层两阶段策略，首先识别有影响力的纵向特征，然后自适应地细化其时间重要性，从而在降低计算成本的同时实现细粒度解释。该框架提供随时间分辨的解释，并随着新的患者数据可用而演变。在模拟数据集和两个临床数据集上的实验显示，不同预测模型与理论重要性的一致性存在差异，性能更好的模型一致性更接近，同时在真实世界环境中提供了具有临床可解释性的洞见。它在各种预测设置下保持稳健，并且相对于时间解释基线将计算时间减少41–80%，使动态解释变得实用。

title: Fix, Don't Retake: Physics-Simulated Training for Correcting Patient Positioning Errors in Dental Panoramic Radiographs
zh_title: 物理仿真训练修正牙科全景片的患者摆位误差
summary: 用物理仿真生成成对的正确与错误摆位全景片，比较五种方法对已有影像的摆位误差校正效果。
key_points: 基于CBCT体数据仿真单独与组合摆位误差
比较U-Net、pix2pix、条件扩散、误差条件模型与专家混合
所有方法均改善图像相似度并降低几何误差，U-Net与两种误差感知方法更优
reason: 单中心仿真数据、回顾性评估，无临床结局或外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Patient-positioning errors can distort panoramic radiographs and lead to repeat examinations. This study investigated artificial intelligence for correcting these errors in existing images. A physics-based simulator generated paired correctly positioned and mispositioned panoramics from cone-beam computed tomography volumes, with controlled individual and combined positioning errors. Five approaches were compared: U-Net, pix2pix, conditional diffusion, an error-conditioned model, and a mixture of error-specific specialists. Evaluation used image similarity and geometric metrics across three test sets. All approaches improved mean image similarity and reduced geometric errors, with U-Net and the two error-aware approaches outperforming pix2pix and conditional diffusion.
zh_abstract: 患者体位错误会使全景放射影像发生畸变，并导致重复检查。本研究探讨了利用人工智能在现有图像中校正这些错误。一个基于物理的模拟器从锥形束计算机断层扫描（cone-beam computed tomography，CBCT）体积生成配对的正确体位与错误体位全景图像，并对单独和组合的体位错误进行控制。比较了五种方法：U-Net、pix2pix、条件扩散模型、错误条件化模型，以及错误特异性专家模型的混合。评估在三个测试集上使用图像相似度和几何指标。所有方法均改善了平均图像相似度并减少了几何误差，其中 U-Net 和两种错误感知方法优于 pix2pix 和条件扩散模型。

title: Risks and Ethical Concerns of Artificial Intelligence in Plastic Surgery.
zh_title: 整形外科中人工智能的风险与伦理问题
summary: 发表于《Clinics in Plastic Surgery》的综述讨论整形外科中AI输出失真、人群与审美偏见、图像隐私及人类监督减弱等风险与防护措施。

abstract: [Clinics in plastic surgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly shaping patient assessment, communication, and clinical decision-making in plastic surgery. Its potential benefits are accompanied by risks of plausible but inaccurate outputs, demographic and esthetic bias, compromised image privacy, and weakened human oversight. These risks become more consequential as systems move from providing information to recommending and executing clinical actions. This review examines the implications for patient safety, informed consent, equity, and professional accountability and outlines safeguards that scale with clinical risk and autonomy, emphasizing validation, continuous monitoring, and preservation of independent surgical judgment.
zh_abstract: [《整形外科临床》(Clinics in plastic surgery)] 人工智能（AI）正日益塑造整形外科中的患者评估、沟通和临床决策。其潜在益处伴随着以下风险：输出看似合理但不准确、人口学与美学偏见、图像隐私受损以及人为监督被削弱。随着系统从提供信息转向推荐和执行临床行动，这些风险变得更具影响。本综述审视其对患者安全、知情同意、公平性和专业问责的影响，并概述随临床风险和自主性而扩展的防护措施，强调验证、持续监测以及维护独立的外科判断。

abstract: [Clinics in plastic surgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly transformed education, including plastic surgical training through adaptive learning platforms, automated competency assessment and intraoperative performance analytics. These platforms support competency-based medical education by enabling continuous objective evaluation, personalized feedback, trajectory predictions, and scalable simulation environments. Emerging applications include virtual patients, plastic surgery-specific adaptive question banks, surgical video analysis, and augmented-reality operative guidance. Despite promising gains in efficiency and educational precision, implementation will require careful validation, transparency, and sustained expert oversight. Strategic AI integration into training programs offers the potential to enhance technical skill acquisition, standardize evaluation and expand access to high-quality surgical education globally.

title: FM-Recon: Exploring Foundation Model Features for Accelerated Cardiac Cine MRI Reconstruction
zh_title: 基础模型特征用于心脏电影MRI重建
summary: FM-Recon将冻结基础模型图像编码器特征融入展开式重建网络，在CMRxRecon2023上系统评估不同重建设置。
key_points: 冻结编码器特征经细化后接入展开重建网络
在含伪影输入上仍可提取有效表征
基于CMRxRecon2023数据集完成系统实验
reason: 预印本探索性工作，仅公开数据集内部评测，无外部验证，属增量偏上
abstract: Foundation models have demonstrated strong feature extraction capabilities across various medical imaging tasks, yet their potential for MRI reconstruction remains largely unexplored, particularly within unrolled reconstruction networks and under artifact-corrupted inputs. In this work, we explore whether and how features from pretrained foundation models can benefit accelerated cardiac cine MRI reconstruction. To this end, we propose FM-Recon, a framework that refines and integrates extracted features from frozen image encoder of foundation models into an unrolled reconstruction network. Through extensive experiments on the CMRxRecon2023 dataset, we systematically evaluate foundation model features across different reconstruction settings. Our results show that foundation models can extract informative representations from artifact-corrupted inputs and improve reconstruction performance, particularly at moderate acceleration factors. These findings demonstrate the potential of foundation model features for accelerated MRI reconstruction and provide insights into their effective integration into unrolled reconstruction networks.
zh_abstract: 基础模型（foundation models）已在多种医学影像任务中展现出强大的特征提取能力，但其在 MRI 重建中的潜力仍很大程度上尚未被探索，尤其是在展开式重建网络（unrolled reconstruction network）中以及伪影损坏输入条件下。在本工作中，我们探究预训练基础模型的特征是否以及如何有益于加速心脏电影 MRI 重建。为此，我们提出 FM-Recon，一个将从基础模型冻结图像编码器中提取的特征进行精炼并整合到展开式重建网络中的框架。通过在 CMRxRecon2023 数据集上的大量实验，我们系统评估了不同重建设置下的基础模型特征。结果表明，基础模型能够从伪影损坏输入中提取有信息量的表示，并改善重建性能，尤其是在中等加速因子下。这些发现证明了基础模型特征用于加速 MRI 重建的潜力，并为其有效整合到展开式重建网络中提供了见解。

title: Does the Voice Matter? Evaluating Frustration Detection on Deployed Clinical Voice-Agent Calls
zh_title: 语音是否重要？真实临床语音智能体挫败检测
summary: 在已部署临床语音随访智能体的真实通话上评估逐轮挫败检测，发现仅用转录文本在单词轮次上不优于随机。
key_points: 真实通话患者发言约59%仅一两个词
标注150轮+扩展714轮，含表演语料对照
单词轮次上纯文本检测不排除随机水平
reason: 真实部署场景有新意，但样本小、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Autonomous voice agents now conduct routine clinical follow-up calls, so some automated triage is unavoidable. A patient becoming frustrated is one thing that triage should catch. These systems typically read only the transcript the speech-to-text stage produces, not the voice, and whether that is enough is largely untested on real clinical speech. We study per-turn frustration detection on real patient calls from a deployed clinical voice agent: 150 turns from six calls labelled by three annotators, with a length-matched acted corpus as a control, and 714 turns from 30 calls. Patient turns are overwhelmingly short: across the deployed calls, roughly 59% are one or two words, against 13% in the full acted corpus, and a corpus accuracy gap remains even after the acted set is length-matched. On one-word turns, transcript-only detection does not exclude chance. Across five audio-capable language models, the transcript flags 3 or 4 of the 39 frustrated one-word turns in the 30 calls, and a classifier given only the word count reaches 57.3%. Whether audio helps depends on the model and on the instruction. Asked to attend to delivery, two Gemini 2.5 models gain 3.0 pp over the transcript across 30 calls (-1.0 to 7.5 pp). Of the turns they confidently clear, 6.9% were in fact frustrated for audio against 13.0% for the transcript, a difference of 6.1 pp (2.2 to 10.4 pp). Across the 30 calls, given one prompt identical for both inputs, no model's audio-text interval excludes zero. Under the input-specific prompts, a newer Gemini model and two smaller open models do worse with audio than with the transcript (-3.5, -8.6 and -10.6 pp). A WavLM probe trained on the clinical calls matches the best prompted model overall (71.6%) but misses every frustrated one-word turn in the 24 added calls. When a patient's turn is short, the transcript alone is not enough to rule out frustration.
zh_abstract: 自主语音代理现已执行常规临床随访电话，因此一定程度的自动分诊不可避免。患者变得沮丧是分诊应捕捉的情况之一。这些系统通常只读取语音转文字阶段生成的文本转录，而不读取声音，且这在真实临床语音中是否足够基本未经检验。我们研究部署中的临床语音代理的真实患者通话中的逐轮沮丧检测：来自6次通话的150轮由三名标注者标注，并以长度匹配的表演语料作为对照，另有来自30次通话的714轮。患者话轮绝大多数很短：在部署通话中约59%为一两个词，而完整表演语料为13%，即使对表演集进行长度匹配后仍存在语料准确率差距。对于单词话轮，仅文本检测不能排除随机水平。在五个具备音频能力的语言模型中，转录在30次通话的39个沮丧单词话轮中标记出3个或4个，而仅给定词数的分类器达到57.3%。音频是否有帮助取决于模型和指令。要求关注表达方式时，两个Gemini 2.5模型在30次通话中相较转录提升3.0个百分点（-1.0至7.5个百分点）。在它们有把握判为不沮丧的话轮中，音频条件下实际有6.9%为沮丧，而转录条件下为13.0%，差异为6.1个百分点（2.2至10.4个百分点）。在30次通话中，当给两种输入相同的同一提示时，没有任何模型的音频-文本区间不包含零。在输入特定提示下，一个较新的Gemini模型和两个较小的开源模型使用音频比使用转录表现更差（-3.5、-8.6和-10.6个百分点）。在临床通话上训练的WavLM探针总体与最佳提示模型相当（71.6%），但在新增的24次通话中漏掉了所有沮丧的单词话轮。当患者话轮很短时，仅靠转录不足以排除沮丧。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Aesthetic Surgery.
zh_title: 人工智能在美容整形外科中的应用综述
summary: 综述AI在美容整形外科的应用，涵盖大语言模型、三维模拟与生成式图像、手术规划及运营工具，并讨论验证与局限。
key_points: 覆盖聊天机器人、临床决策支持与影像模拟平台

abstract: [Clinics in plastic surgery] This article surveys artificial intelligence (AI) applications across aesthetic plastic surgery, spanning large language models (publicly available software, practice chatbots, and clinical decision support tools), simulation technologies (3 dimensional imaging platforms like Vectra and Crisalix, generative adversarial network-based and diffusion-based image generation), surgical planning, and operational tools for documentation, billing, scheduling, and marketing. It highlights validation evidence where available, alongside persistent limitations including training data bias, hallucinations, black-box opacity, and unresolved regulatory and liability questions. Despite AI's expanding capabilities, individualized surgical judgment remains irreplaceable, positioning AI as a decision-support tool that enhances, rather than substitutes, the surgeon-patient relationship.
zh_abstract: [Clinics in plastic surgery] 本文综述了人工智能（AI）在美容整形外科中的应用，涵盖大型语言模型（公开可用软件、诊所聊天机器人及临床决策支持工具）、模拟技术（如 Vectra 和 Crisalix 等三维成像平台、基于生成对抗网络和基于扩散模型的图像生成）、手术规划，以及用于文书、计费、排程和营销的运营工具。文章强调了现有可获得的验证证据，同时也指出了持续存在的局限性，包括训练数据偏倚、幻觉、黑箱不透明性以及尚未解决的监管与责任问题。尽管 AI 的能力不断扩展，个体化手术判断仍不可替代，因而 AI 被定位为一种决策支持工具，用于增强而非替代外科医生与患者之间的关系。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: The Hospital for Sick Children; conditions: Developmental Dysplasia of Hip, DDH, Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip, Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip (DDH), Hip Dysplasia; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 88; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) is a condition in which a baby's hip joint does not develop normally. Ultrasound is commonly used to assess the hips of young infants for DDH, but these examinations usually require trained ultrasound staff and specialist interpretation. The purpose of this study is to determine whether a handheld ultrasound device combined with artificial intelligence (AI) can be used by non-specialist health care personnel to obtain and assess ultrasound images of infant hips. Infants attending the Baby Hip Clinic at The Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids) will undergo their usual clinical ultrasound as part of their standard care. They will also have an additional research ultrasound performed using the handheld device. Researchers will compare the research ultrasound with the standard clinical ultrasound. The study will assess the quality of the images obtained using the handheld device and compare the AI-assisted assessment with the diagnosis from the standard ultrasound and assessments made by experienced reviewers. The research ultrasound and AI results will not be used to make treatment decisions for participating infants.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：The Hospital for Sick Children；疾病：发育性髋关节发育不良（Developmental Dysplasia of Hip）、DDH、发育性髋关节发育不良（Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip）、发育性髋关节发育不良（Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip, DDH）、髋关节发育不良（Hip Dysplasia）；类型：观察性（OBSERVATIONAL）；入组人数：88；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 发育性髋关节发育不良（developmental dysplasia of the hip, DDH）是一种婴儿髋关节发育不正常的疾病。超声常用于评估年幼婴儿的髋关节以筛查 DDH，但这些检查通常需要训练有素的超声人员和专科解读。本研究的目的是确定非专科卫生保健人员是否可以使用手持超声设备结合人工智能（AI）来获取和评估婴儿髋关节超声图像。在 The Hospital for Sick Children（SickKids）的婴儿髋关节门诊（Baby Hip Clinic）就诊的婴儿将作为其标准诊疗的一部分接受常规临床超声检查。他们还将额外接受一次使用手持设备进行的研究性超声检查。研究人员将把研究性超声与标准临床超声进行比较。该研究将评估使用手持设备获得的图像质量，并将 AI 辅助评估与标准超声的诊断以及经验丰富的审阅者所作评估进行比较。研究性超声和 AI 结果不会用于为参与婴儿做出治疗决策。

title: Eye-to-Eye: Gaze detection as a proxy for medical doctor behaviour during virtual and in-person appointments
zh_title: 用注视检测比较线上与线下问诊医生行为
summary: 预印本以低成本桌面设备检测14名医生在面对面与线上问诊中的注视行为，比较注视患者时长与频率。

reason: 单中心小样本观察性预印本，无临床结局，属增量档
abstract: The gaze direction of the physician during consultations plays an important role in patient satisfaction, with several studies pointing to the positive correlation between the amount of time the physician spends looking at the patient and patient satisfaction. Additionally, the effects of the virtual consultation environment on the gaze behaviour of the doctor have yet to be studied. Therefore, this study aims to assess the impact of the virtual consultation environment by comparing the amount of total time the doctor spends looking at the patient between face-to-face and virtual consultations, as well as the average duration during the consultation and the gaze frequency. The study population consisted of 14 doctors divided between 4 medical specialties: Gynaecology/Obstetrics (4), Neurology (3), Endocrinology (3) and General and Familiar Medicine (4). A low-cost desktop that runs an appearance-based gaze estimation pipeline was implemented in the clinical setup. Each doctor recorded 20 face-to-face consultations and 20 virtual consultations, which were then processed by the pipeline to obtain the percentage of time the doctor spent looking at the patient during the consultation. Overall, we found that doctors look more at the patient in virtual consultations compared to face-to-face consultations, both in total time and average duration during the consultation. Within medical specialties, three out the four specialties involved presented clear tendencies to look more at the patient in virtual consultations when compared to face-to-face consultations.
zh_abstract: 医生在诊疗过程中的注视方向对患者满意度具有重要作用，多项研究指出医生注视患者的时间量与患者满意度呈正相关。此外，虚拟诊疗环境对医生注视行为的影响尚待研究。因此，本研究旨在通过比较面对面诊疗与虚拟诊疗中医生注视患者的总时间，以及诊疗期间的平均持续时间和注视频率，评估虚拟诊疗环境的影响。研究人群包括14名医生，分属4个医学专科：妇产科（4名）、神经内科（3名）、内分泌科（3名）和全科与家庭医学（4名）。在临床环境中部署了一台运行基于外观的注视估计流程的低成本台式设备。每位医生记录了20次面对面诊疗和20次虚拟诊疗，随后由该流程处理，以获得医生在诊疗期间注视患者的时间百分比。总体而言，我们发现与面对面诊疗相比，医生在虚拟诊疗中注视患者更多，无论是总时间还是诊疗期间的平均持续时间均如此。在各医学专科内，涉及的4个专科中有3个表现出明显倾向：与面对面诊疗相比，在虚拟诊疗中更多注视患者。

title: Anticipating or Speculating? Making Futures Pay in AI Ethics
zh_title: 医生与AI意见分歧：通用决策规则受质疑
summary: 哲学论证认为医生与医学AI分歧属情境化经验问题，无法用统一决策规则处理。
key_points: 主张通用决策规则会抹去关键情境
将其联系到技术伦理中的预期与臆测之争
概念论证，无实证数据

abstract: Philosophers have recently been trying to develop uniform decision rules for instances in which physicians' judgments diverge from the recommendations of medical artificial intelligence (AI) systems. I argue that this effort is fatally flawed because the performance and appropriate use of algorithmic recommendation systems by physicians are highly context-specific, empirical medical matters rather than epistemological ones. In such instances, general decision rules can be stipulated only to the extent that they abstract away from relevant, indeed determinative, contextual circumstances. The alleged problem of physician-AI disagreement, and others like it, play into longstanding disputes in technology ethics about the viability and utility of envisioning possible futures: is this useful "anticipation" or wasteful "speculation"? I suggest that the two may be distinguished. Anticipation explores plausible futures to help inform present actions under irreducible uncertainty. Speculation abstracts away uncertainty, developing formal solutions to stipulated circumstances whose relationship to the real present is often quite unclear. Efforts to develop crisp philosophical solutions to physician-AI disagreement, among other problems, fall into the latter category. Technology ethics should remember that fruitful futures thinking must both begin from and return to the messy, uncertain present.
zh_abstract: 哲学家最近一直试图为医生判断与医学人工智能（AI）系统建议不一致的情形制定统一的决策规则。我认为这一努力存在致命缺陷，因为医生对算法推荐系统的使用及其表现是高度依赖情境的经验性医学问题，而非认识论问题。在此类情形中，一般决策规则只能在其抽离相关且实际上具有决定性的情境条件时才可被规定。所谓的医生-AI分歧问题及类似问题，卷入了技术伦理中关于设想可能未来是否可行和有用的长期争议：这是有用的“预期”还是浪费的“推测”？我提出二者可以区分。预期探索合理的未来，以在不可化约的不确定性下帮助指导当前行动。推测则抽离不确定性，为规定情境制定形式化解决方案，而这些情境与真实当前的关系往往相当不清楚。为医生-AI分歧等问题制定清晰哲学解决方案的努力属于后一类。技术伦理应记住，富有成果的未来思维必须从混乱、不确定的当前出发，并回到这一当前。

abstract: [Clinics in plastic surgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) offers surgical leaders a means of augmenting-not replacing-the craft of leadership. This article outlines practical applications across strategic vision, such as innovation and problem-solving, recruitment and faculty development, meetings and decision-making, project execution, academic productivity, and regulatory governance, while delineating where AI reliably fails: judgment, accountability, and contextual nuance. It introduces the throughput asymmetry that arises when AI-accelerated leaders outpace an unequipped implementing organization, and addresses the heterogeneous AI exposure spanning AI-native trainees and appropriately skeptical senior faculty. Governance should be constructed as an iterative loop rather than a static policy.
zh_abstract: [Clinics in plastic surgery] 人工智能（AI）为外科领导者提供了一种增强——而非替代——领导技艺的手段。本文概述了在战略愿景中的实际应用，例如创新与问题解决、招聘与教师发展、会议与决策、项目执行、学术生产力以及监管治理，同时界定了AI始终无法胜任之处：判断、问责和情境细微差别。它引入了当AI加速的领导者超越未配备相应能力的执行组织时产生的吞吐量不对称，并讨论了从AI原生受训者到持有适当怀疑态度的资深教师之间异质性的AI接触程度。治理应构建为迭代循环，而非静态政策。
